description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Great Forest, offering middle- and long-distance runners, as well as amateur runners, the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and to provide racing opportunities for different age groups and categories. Traditionally, the series supports runners’ winter training and strengthens the running community in the Great Forest, with its natural, runner-friendly terrain.
course_highlights: Run on the runner- and joint-friendly terrain of Debrecen’s Great Forest
Multi-lap courses from 1.5 km to 10 km for different age groups
Parking available in the car park next to the cemetery
additional: You only need to register once per year for the series, and your registration is valid for all races in that season. If your race bib is lost or damaged, you can purchase a replacement for HUF 2,000. There is also a team competition, with teams of at least 4 and no more than 8 members competing regardless of gender or age. Race results are available on sportstopper.hu the day after each event. The 2026/2027 season is the cup’s 20th-anniversary edition. Registration is required once per season; teams of 4–8 may enter the team competition. Details of the specified January 23 race are not included in the available season announcement.

name: TIHANY TRAIL
location: Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Csokonai utca 73, Tihany, Hungary
description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands. The course is especially distinctive because participants run along the rim of the caldera and on a rocky cliff edge, making for an exciting and scenic race. Participants can choose from 5, 10 and 15 km distances, and aid stations provide hydration and energy. This is a real treat for trail runners, attracting running enthusiasts even in winter.
course_highlights: Varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands
Running along the rim of the caldera, on a rocky cliff edge and along narrow trails
Aid stations with water, energy drink, glucose tablets and salted pretzels
additional: Race-pack collection takes place from 8:00 to 9:50, followed by a warm-up with Gabi Piros at 9:50. Refreshments are available at two points on the course and at the event centre. There will be no cups at the aid stations, so participants must bring a flask or cup. On the 15 km course, the first aid station is at the Forest School (approximately 6.9 km) and the second is beside the Apáti Church (approximately 10.3 km). <i:am> mineral+ energy drink and cherry-flavoured hypotonic drink are also available on the course. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with anti-slip aids if needed; road-running shoes are not suitable for the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The event centre is at Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. The organisers recommend trail-running shoes and, if needed, anti-slip aids. Participants must bring their own cup or flask for the aid stations.

name: ORADEA CITY TRAIL RUN
location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: VASI TEREPFUTÓ SOROZAT
description: The first race of the 2027 Vasi Trail Running Series will take place in Cák, on the beautiful trails of the Kőszeg Mountains. The race offers varied, exciting courses where participants can enjoy being close to nature and the challenge of trail running. Runners can expect a friendly atmosphere, professional timing and live results. Category winners will receive valuable gifts, and the series will conclude with overall awards for the top runners.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Kőszeg Mountains
Exciting, clearly marked courses
Electronic timing with the KORIM system
additional: Bib and chip pickup is from 9:30 to 10:50; on-site registration is available. Bibs are made of strong, tear-resistant paper. Runners are asked to bring them to every race and reuse them. Chips are provided free of charge, but a compensation fee of HUF 20,000 is payable if one is lost. Professional photos from the race are available to download free of charge. The awards ceremony is at 13:00, after the S, M and L distances. Parking is at the Cák football pitch car park and must be arranged individually. The race takes place on trails and requires appropriate physical and mental preparation. The stated date of January 24, 2027, is not confirmed by the available race page, which lists the 2026 race. According to a previous race announcement, parking was by the Cák football pitch and electronic timing was used.

name: Витоша Ски и Дъски
location: Aleko Hut, Vitosha Nature Park, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Ski and Board is an event organized by the Sofia Mountain Club Association, held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut. The competition offers two main routes—the short “Zaeka” and the long “Cherni Vrah”—which start at 09:17. This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.
course_highlights: “Zaeka” course – short course
“Cherni Vrah” course – long course
Held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut

description: The Oxygen Cup is a winter running series in Debrecen’s Nagyerdő, offering middle- and long-distance runners and amateur athletes the opportunity to compete. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, while providing opportunities to race during the winter. The course runs along the trails of Nagyerdő, which have a runner- and joint-friendly surface and provide an ideal setting for participants. The series is traditionally very popular, and participants include both amateurs and registered athletes.
course_highlights: Trails in Nagyerdő with a runner- and joint-friendly surface
Distances: 1.5 km, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km laps
Parking available in the car park next to the cemetery
additional: There is no per-race entry fee for the series; registration is valid for one year. Teams must have a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 8 members, regardless of gender or age. Competitors’ points are calculated using the formula applied in the team competition, and results are available on sportstopper.hu the day after the race. Registration is valid for the remaining races of that season. Teams of 4–8 may also enter the team competition.

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he once traveled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances of varying difficulty and elevation are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths traveled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Registration is open until 09.02.2026. Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while those who are not registered can submit entries by email or phone. Bib numbers can be collected from the secretariat by 11:00, and on-site registration is possible until 10:30 if bib numbers are available. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the starting point and run along red markings. The Masters start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; advance entries are accepted, and on-site registration is possible if bib numbers are available. The date listed in the 2026 sources is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22 and 44 km—as well as a 700-metre children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo mayor’s office and organised by the Plovdiv and Rhodope Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Club.
course_highlights: Courses of 8, 12, 22 and 44 km in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains
Aid stations with water, electrolytes, fruit, snacks and special food
Well-marked and secured routes with timing and electronic results tracking

The 8 km race includes a designer headband; the 12 and 22 km races include a designer organic cotton T-shirt; and the 44 km race includes a designer fleece vest. A headlamp is mandatory equipment. name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast sections through forests, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two peaks of Kablar, offering beautiful views of the West Morava and surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the "Kablar" Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a four-hour time limit for competitors in the PSS National Series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good race management, clear course markings, and safety throughout the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Nature Center in Ovčar Banja; it is listed as certified for 1 ITRA point. That page lists the date as April 4, 2026, not April 10, 2027.

The event offers four races: half marathon (21 km), cross-country race (11 km), sprint (6 km) and Family Run (3 km), so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The varied routes include trails, dirt roads and asphalt, offering an enjoyable experience in nature, with well-positioned refreshment points. Băneasa Forest Run is about the joy of running in the forest, whether you run competitively or for fun with your family.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with trails, dirt roads and asphalt

description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

It is a unique Backyard Ultra race, with a single 6.706 km event alternating between two different courses, one by day and one by night. The challenge is to complete the course in under 60 minutes and be present for every hourly start; the last competitor remaining in the race is declared the winner.

In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.

additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on the hiking trails of the Zărand Mountains, between the localities of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the area’s natural and historical heritage, linking Șoimoș and Șiria fortresses, as well as other points of interest, along its routes. The courses offer an adventurous experience amid spring scenery and a medieval atmosphere, and are suitable for both amateur and professional runners. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendars.
course_highlights: Mountain routes featuring hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads

additional: Participant kits are guaranteed for registrations made by April 12, 2026. The routes are marked with tape and arrows, and participants must pass through all checkpoints. Medical assistance and route monitoring are provided. On-site registration is available only for the 9 km cross-country race and the 22 km half marathon, without a guaranteed kit. Cancellations made by 28.02.2026 receive a 50% refund of the participation fee. The routes include hiking trails in the Zărand Mountains, with details about registration and participation requirements; the event takes place on April 18, 2026.

description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, a scenic area in Romania. The marathon course has 1,600 metres of positive elevation gain. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and offers participants a unique experience in nature on routes that showcase the beauty of Dobrogea’s nature reserves. In addition to the marathon, other races are held, including a half marathon, a cross-country race, a family race, and the Cheile Circuit, catering to a broad range of runners. The marathon has a tradition and a story inspired by the Argonauts, heroes of Greek mythology, which adds a special charm to the competition.

The routes are promoted as part of Dobrogea’s natural and tourist heritage. The event promotes local tourism and Dobrogea’s natural beauty, with varied routes and multiple race categories.

Relay teams must have at least 2 members, with handovers every 2.5 km. Women’s and mixed relays are offered, and school relays have a separate category. The entry fee for the first school relay team will be covered if it enters by April 10. The event takes place in Szombathely, near Erkel utca 39, and features awards, live results, photos, and various categories, including school teams.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: UFM Aréna, Mosonmagyaróvár, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The 23rd Motherson Szigetköz Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Mosonmagyaróvár that promotes recreational sport. The race is part of the Olympic Five-Event Challenge and offers the chance to earn points in the 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21.1 km) distances. The start and finish are at the UFM Arena, which has changing rooms, showers and a cloakroom. Chip timing is provided, and there is a time limit for the longest distance. Entrants can have their name or nickname printed on their race bib if they register by April 10.
course_highlights: Individual chip timing for the 2, 5, 10 and 21 km distances
Half-marathon time limit: 2 hours 30 minutes
Name or nickname printed on the race bib if requested by April 10
additional: Race bibs must be worn at the front, at chest height. Triathlon race-bib belts are permitted. A chip is attached to the back of the race bib; it must not be removed or folded. Timing is provided by Agni-Timing. There is a time limit for the longest distance: the 21.1 km must be completed within 2 hours 30 minutes, or the runner will be disqualified. The small bridge in front of the UFM Arena will be closed on race day from 8:30 to 12:00. Registration is online and is open until April 11; the race is open to everyone, from beginners to professional runners.

name: Maratonul Argonautilor
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in the Dobrogea Gorges, Dobrogea, offering a unique experience on routes with 1,600 metres of positive elevation gain. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and promotes the natural beauty of the Cheile and Gura Dobrogei area, inviting runners to discover spectacular landscapes and nature reserves. The route is suited to both experienced runners and those who want to enjoy nature and outdoor sports. The marathon has a tradition that evokes the legend of the Argonauts, the heroes who set out in search of the Golden Fleece, adding a mythological touch to the competition.
course_highlights: Route with 1,600 metres of positive elevation gain
Route through Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, areas with nature reserves
Spectacular landscapes and promotion of the local tourist route
additional: The route includes gorges and nature reserves. Registration and the rules are available on the website. The event takes place on April 19, 2026.

description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition taking place on April 19, 2026, in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forestry roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked course with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded out by an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch at the finish. The start is scheduled for 10:00, after a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting exercise in nature.
course_highlights: Varied-terrain course: forest trails and forestry roads
Course clearly marked with tape, arrows, and signs
Checkpoints with time limits for each race
additional: Check-in and race-pack pickup between 08:00 and 09:30. Last-minute registration is available for only 20 spots, without a starter kit, for a fee of 250 lei. Mandatory equipment for the races: mobile phone, clearly visible race bib, liquid container (minimum 0.5 liters) for the 21 km race, and a survival blanket. Champions’ lunch of beans with sausages after the runners finish. Awards ceremony at 14:30. The event ends at 16:00 with group photos and socializing. The course includes trail terrain, registration details, the event schedule, and post-race activities.

description: Brăila 10K is a running event held in Monument Park in Brăila on April 19, 2026, offering an energetic and welcoming experience for runners of all ages. The event includes 10.5 km, 7 km and 3.5 km races, children’s races, and a 1.5 km Family Fun Run, making it ideal for setting a personal best on a fast, well-marked course. The festival atmosphere, music, prizes and activities for the whole family make Brăila 10K a celebration of outdoor exercise and health. The organizers emphasize safety and the smooth running of the competition, with volunteers and referees along the course.

Courses clearly marked and monitored by referees and volunteers
1.5 km Family Fun Run for the whole family

No race-day registration is available for the competitive events. The event includes a warm-up led by specialized instructors before the starts. Participants can receive medals, prizes and surprises, and the event offers activities for the whole family, with course and registration details available on the official website.

description: In 2026, the Ultrabalaton will be held for the 20th time. It is Hungary’s most popular mass-participation sporting event. The race is a single-loop running event around Lake Balaton, the longest running race in Central Europe, and can be completed individually or in a team, on foot or by bicycle. The distance is 209 kilometers, open to solo participants and teams of 2–6 people. The event has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and offers activities that appeal to runners, their supporters, and cyclists alike.
course_highlights: A 209-kilometer single loop around Lake Balaton
The longest running race in Central Europe
Take part individually or in a team of 2–6
additional: Race office address: 1134 Budapest, Tüzér utca 9-11; opening hours: Monday and Tuesday, 10:00–13:00. #PROJEKT418 support, aid stations, and a split calculator are available to participants in StafétApp. Activities are also available for supporters accompanying runners and for cyclists. The registration deadline is September 27, 2025. The event takes place April 23–26, 2026, with the start on April 25, 2026. Participants can collect their race packs at the event center, and the lap-time calculator is available in the StafétApp app.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletic talents. The tournament takes place at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of different ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series
Memorial tournament honoring Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Khristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail: Trail of Strength is a demanding race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 m of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija’s hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Zamah course: 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain
Highest point: Cerovi Peak at 775 m; lowest point: 330 m
additional: Race-pack collection is available only on race day, from 08:00 to 09:45 in the start area. Time limits are 5h30min for Prkos and 3h30min for Zamah. The race pack includes a medal, a dry-fit shirt, a chip-equipped race bib, refreshments, professional photos, a marked course, aid stations, and a surprise lunch. Prizes are prepared for the top finishers on the shorter course, separately for men and women. The event is scheduled for 25 April 2026, at Kragujevac / Adžine Livade. More information will be available on the organizer’s Instagram page.

description: Staza snage is a trail race in the beautiful natural surroundings of Adžine Livade, for runners who want to push their limits and experience challenging terrain. The race has two courses: Prkos, 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, and Zamah, 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain. The course combines steep climbs and technical descents down water channels, requiring sure footing, concentration, and courage. At the finish, the winner is not the fastest runner, but the one who has conquered the course and its strength. The race starts on April 25, 2026, in Adžine Livade: the longer course starts at 10:00 and the shorter one at 10:30.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Zamah course: 8.0 km with 450 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Technical descents down water channels requiring sure footing and concentration
additional: Each participant receives a race pack with a race number and chip, a T-shirt, refreshments at checkpoints and the finish, a marked course, a GPX track, and a finisher medal. No additional registration is available after registration closes or on race day. Course distances: 17.5 km and 8 km; elevation gain up to 1,000 m; technical terrain; registration via the MyRace.rs platform. Race packs include T-shirts, medals, and a marked course.

description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometres long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 metres, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.

Mountain terrain in western Serbia

location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running event organized by the Csepel Municipality as part of the Actively for Csepel program series. The race takes place on the beautiful Csepel Danube waterfront, starting from the Kolonics György Recreation Centre, and offers four distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, a 400 m children’s race, and a special race for people with disabilities. The event aims to share the joy of community and exercise with all age groups, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Race bibs must be worn for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The course follows Kolonics Promenade along the Danube.
Chip timing and overall men’s and women’s podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances.
The children’s race course passes under the two-hole bridge; parental accompaniment is permitted.
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are encouraged to bring their own soft cup, water bottle, or cup. The youngest participants will receive a medal, while older children will find a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish. Strollers are permitted only at the participant’s own risk. The special race is a fun run for people with disabilities, where walking is also allowed. Multiple distances; registration required; environmentally friendly; chip timing; awards; family and special categories; route along the Danube; outdoor event; rain or shine.

The event has a friendly atmosphere and takes place in a lakeside setting, offering participants both a challenge and an enjoyable experience. The start is at 10:00, and registration is open until 18:00 on April 23.

Scenic surroundings on Tópart Promenade in Tata
Race distances available by age group and gender

description: Backyard Ultra Esztergom 2026 is a special ultrarunning race that continues until only one runner remains. Competitors complete a 6,706-metre loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded in 11 age groups. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete distances of up to 160 kilometres may also receive recognition.

A last-runner-standing race: runners must finish before the next start to continue
An age-group championship with 11 categories for female and male competitors
additional: The race is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded in 11 age groups. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer; for bank transfers, a payment request will be sent. The Backyard MINI event consists of 6 laps (40.236 km), with gold medals awarded to the fastest female and male runners. Competitors can earn multiple medals and trophies. On-site registration may be available if places remain, at a higher price. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya; detailed registration and award information can be found on the official website. The race is a celebration of perseverance and community, where runners can push their own limits.

description: La Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by the Alergotura Sports Club Association in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances on scenic routes through the Petro Vaselo vineyard. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience on well-marked courses with aid stations, in a friendly and well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, offered on presentation of their race number.
course_highlights: Nature running routes through the vineyard, with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km
The 28 km route consists of two laps of the 14 km route, with the second lap run in the opposite direction
The routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at direction-change points
additional: Participants should arrive at least 30 minutes before the start at Petrovaselo Winery. The 14 km and 28 km races start at 09:00, and the 5 km race starts at 09:15. Each race has a finish time limit (5 km – 10:15, 14 km – 11:05, 28 km – 13:00). After the race, participants receive goulash and wine on presentation of their race number. Depending on the weather, parts of the routes may be muddy. Transfers between races are permitted before the start, subject to availability. Participants can register and check the participant list online; the event combines sport with the vineyard scenery of the Recaș area.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run Bucharest is an untimed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are showered with colored powder at every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the finish. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas, offering a festive experience for all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, featuring special moments such as the colored powder cloud and live music.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along Bd. Unirii and the surrounding areas of Bucharest
Colored-powder stations at every kilometer
A colored powder cloud at the finish, accompanied by music
additional: Race kits can be picked up at Mega Mall Bucharest between April 18 and 24, with extended hours. Access to the event area begins at 12:00, staggered starts take place between 14:00 and 14:20, and the colored powder cloud takes place from 16:00 to 16:15. Children aged 0–6 can participate for free without a kit, and multiple participants can be registered by adding them to the form. The event is untimed and open to all ages; people with disabilities also receive free access. The route includes urban areas; registration includes medals and colored powder; the event has multiple start waves and kit pickup points.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The 5th edition of Maratonul Codrului is an event organized by Club Sportiv Pro Racers and the Romanian Cycling Federation, taking place on 25 April 2026 at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition for both amateurs and professionals, featuring MTB and Trail Run events on spectacular forest routes, with challenges for all levels. The event offers new, more challenging MTB routes, as well as hobby events with shorter routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants receive a race pack, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, a pasta party, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, without the road section in the final 5 km
Varied Trail Run routes from 6 km to 43.5 km, with significant climbs
Kids Race for children, with a 2 km route and 70 m of elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes a race pack with a race number and sponsor products, on-course photos, hydration points along the route and at the finish, emergency medical and mountain rescue services, timing, a finisher medal, and a pasta party. Routes may be modified up until race day. MTB and Trail Run routes, age categories, online registration, finisher medals, technical T-shirts, an event for families and the community

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Str. Tudor Vladimirescu Nr.73, Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a moderately difficult trail running competition held in the deciduous forest near the city of Marghita. The event is organized by Clubul Sportiv Run For Freedom together with Clubul Sportiv XTERRA Sport Bihor and offers four different routes suited to various levels of runners. The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are clearly marked along forest roads. The competition promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes on properly marked forest roads
Moderate elevation gains: 460 m for the half marathon, 230 m for the cross, and 20 m for the mini
Start and finish at Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through registration; it costs 100 lei and must be purchased separately. Participants under 18 must present a medical certificate and parental consent. Organizers may withdraw competitors who are intoxicated or do not have appropriate equipment. Registration is available exclusively through the official webshop. Trail-running routes in the forest, three different routes, organized by local sports clubs, first edition in spring 2022

All funds raised from entry fees go toward completing the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department.
course_highlights: Running course along the Someș Promenade, Cluj-Napoca
3 km race (one lap of the course) and RotaRun 9 km (three laps of the course)
Long Run — a 2-hour endurance race
additional: T-shirt size is guaranteed for registrations made by April 10, 2026; after that date, sizes will be allocated in registration order, subject to availability. Participants receive a race bib and timing chip, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and supplements. The top three male and female finishers in each race will be awarded, both in the Open category and by age group. The event also supports the purchase of modern furniture and medical equipment for the Pediatric Oncology Department, as a community fundraising and awareness project.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charitable mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in the town of Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, ranging from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateur cyclists and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family Ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and may go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cutoff time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, supports social and educational causes, and promotes wine culture and local tourism.

Running and cycling events held on two separate days
Opportunity to visit local landmarks and enjoy evening entertainment between the event days
additional: The race includes children’s starts over short distances, cut-off times, and stops at set kilometre points for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). Cycling distances range from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at Acad. N. Haytov Square in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The events include mountain running and cycling over various distances; participation is subject to rules covering equipment and physical fitness. Online registration is available, with different participant categories.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000-Metre Track Championship in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s top athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometre track distance. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: A track race over the classic 10,000 m distance
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s national sports calendar
additional: The first national 10,000 m track championship in Hisarya is included in the 2026 sports calendar.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and no-kill shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to the 21 km half marathon. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social interaction.
course_highlights: Course: 50% asphalt and 50% gravel park paths
Aid stations at different kilometer points depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Race bib pickup is available April 21–23, from 9:00 to 19:00, in the South Wing of the Rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and awards ceremony. Games, raffles, opportunities for social interaction, and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and many prizes.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race taking place on April 26, 2026, starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened route, with plenty of uphill and downhill sections, offering both a challenge and the pleasure of enjoying the natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to take part and enjoy running together, the results, and socializing at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top runners are awarded cash prizes and trophies.
course_highlights: A 13.5 km road race starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac
A route through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened trail
Significant uphill and downhill sections
additional: Race-pack pickup from 7:00 to 8:30 in Gornji Milanovac. Organized transport to the start in Takovo at 8:30. Refreshments during and after the race. Awards ceremony at 12:30 in central Gornji Milanovac. Participants run at their own risk. The event includes timekeeping, medals, T-shirts, and other logistical arrangements for participants.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 8 km, 3.5 km, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.5 km
description: The 9th Miklósi Running Day is a family-friendly running race in Szigetszentmiklós, taking place on April 26, 2026. It offers several distances, from 500 metres up to the half marathon (21 km). The event starts in front of the City Sports Hall and follows the Szebeni Road, Petőfi Road and Gerincút route before returning to the sports hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available at the venue. The race aims to promote sport and community for all age groups.
course_highlights: Route starts in front of and returns to the City Sports Hall
Szebeni Road – Petőfi Road – Gerincút route
Distances: 500 m, 800 m, 1,000 m, 3.5 km, 8 km, 21 km (half marathon)
additional: Race-pack pickup and the information point are located at the entrance to the City Sports Hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available in the sports hall. There is no on-site registration or in-person late registration on race day. Registration is online only, with payment by bank card through the Barion system. Children under 6 may enter the 500 m distance only when accompanied by an adult. The organizers may limit the number of participants. The event offers categories for several age groups and types of runners; online registration is required to participate. The event includes timing, refreshment stations and parking.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: Monor, Strázsahegyi dűlő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will take place on April 26, 2026, in the Strázsahegyi dűlő area of Monor. Participants can choose from a 500-meter family run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon distances. Runners can tackle the courses on varied terrain in a nature-rich setting. The event aims to promote a love of sport and nature in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nature-rich trail routes around Monor
10 km and half-marathon distances available
A 500-meter family run for the youngest participants
additional: Entries are accepted until April 12. GPX maps of the 10 km and half-marathon routes are available on the race’s official website. Online registration is available, and the event welcomes participants with local food and wine in a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: STRÁZSA-HEGYI TRAIL
location: Szent Orbán tér, Monor, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III Strázsa-hegy Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will take place on April 26, 2026, at Szent Orbán Square in Monor. For the third time, runners will test their strength on varied terrain around scenic Strázsa Hill. The race offers a challenge for all participants in a welcoming atmosphere and a natural setting. The event celebrates sport and community, and welcomes running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural surroundings and varied terrain around Strázsa Hill
Challenging trail running routes
Start location: Szent Orbán Square, Monor
additional: The race will take place on April 26, 2026, from 08:00 to 15:00 at Szent Orbán Square in Monor. It is part of the Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race series and will be held for the third time. The event provides chip timing, free bus services, and parking. The registration deadline is April 12.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
location: Kőszeg Rőtfalva, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Hillclimb is a varied and memorable mountain running race, taking place on April 26, 2026, near Rőtfalva in Kőszeg. The race has a new start location in Bozsok and offers runners several distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses take participants across varied terrain, with beautiful views and aid stations, and require stamina and good physical preparation. The race also offers family-friendly activities, so even the youngest visitors can enjoy nature-conservation and interactive exhibitions.
course_highlights: A new start location in Bozsok as the race continues to evolve
A 23 km distance with 780 metres of elevation gain and wonderful views from the summit of Írottkő
The 102 km Alpokalja Ultra, taking in the most spectacular spots in the Kőszeg Mountains
additional: The race starts from a new location in Bozsok, and the course has several aid stations and water-refill points. The 23 km distance includes 780 metres of elevation gain, with panoramic views from the summit of Írottkő. The 102 km distance can also be completed as a team, making the shared finish a special experience. The youngest visitors can enjoy an interactive exhibition and nature-conservation activities. The race is semi-self-supported, and runners must carry mandatory equipment, such as a mobile phone, a water container, a windproof or rain jacket, a headlamp and a spare battery. The race showcases the natural beauty of the Kőszeg Mountains across varied terrain, with a new start in Bozsok, and offers people of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to take part.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: The Futapest Terepfutás Bér race is an exciting trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Bér, Virágospuszta. Runners can test their strength on varied routes close to nature, enjoying its beauty and the challenging terrain. The race is organized by Futapest Klub, which has supported trail running and cross-country running in Hungary for many years. All runners are warmly welcome to join this friendly, community-focused event.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature around Bér, Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections and forest trails
Scenic landscape and fresh air for runners
additional: The race offers several distances and is intended for people who enjoy nature and sport. Detailed information is available on the website.

name: URME PE PLAY
price_range: prima înscriere este gratuită, alte detalii nu sunt specificate
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. The marked routes include natural trails, forest roads, and asphalt, offering an authentic sub-mountain experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with races for each age group. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.
course_highlights: Routes along marked trails in Rășinari and the hills at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains
Varied terrain: asphalt, forest roads, natural trails, and meadows
Picturesque spring scenery at the foot of the mountains
additional: Participation is at your own risk, and participants must sign a liability waiver. The minimum age is 14 for the Fuguț race and 18 for the Cros, Semi, Maraton, and Ultra Maraton races. Children under 14 may participate in dedicated races. The registration pack is not mailed. The organizer may prohibit a participant from starting or continuing the race if they are not in suitable physical condition. The event also includes cultural activities, hikes, and a local products fair, offering an opportunity to discover the traditions and beauty of the Rășinari area.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is Bulgaria’s largest spring mountain running event, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a beginner-friendly 10 km race, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The courses pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, the Balkan Mountains, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by Begach Sports Club and attracts more participants every year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain through Lozen Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain to Mount Bachun
10 km courses with around 100 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Race kits can be collected on the Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. There are aid stations and medical assistance along the courses. The race provides no cups, so participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A bag drop is available, but the organizers are not responsible for lost belongings. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are stationed at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear their race bib on their chest or abdomen. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hiking; an event focused on nature and social activities; date: April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of Bankya and heading toward Ostra Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which features a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The figure-eight course starts on the northern outskirts of Bankya
Each loop is 6.4 km long with 217 m of elevation gain
Choose one or two loops (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course was designed by Miroslav Spasov. The race is held at the site of a spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar, alongside other events in Sofia and across the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The course crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is excellent strength and endurance training, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.
course_highlights: Start in the village of Bistritsa, with easy access by bus No. 98
Gradual but demanding climb with 500 m of elevation gain to the Kikish area
Panoramic views of Sofia and an opportunity to rest and refuel at Kamen Del Hut
additional: The route features varied surfaces, from forest trails to rocky sections, helping runners adapt to different conditions. In the Kikish area, the shelter offers cover and food on weekends. Running in nature provides a chance to recover away from the noise of the city. Terrain, marathon preparation, natural setting

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls takes place on April 26, 2026, in Bistritsa village, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain race for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors; communication is handled directly with them. The event is a tradition and attracts athletes looking for a competitive experience on mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill mountain race in the area of Bistritsa village, Sofia
Competition for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: Contacting the organizer is recommended for any questions. The competition is part of the national mountain running championship and takes place in Bistritsa village, Sofia. It is part of the national mountain running series, focuses on uphill running, and offers participation opportunities for different age groups.

name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: EtyekRUN is a unique running race in the rolling hills of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region, its vineyards, rows of vines and spring scenery accompany participants every step of the way. The race is part of the Garmin WTF series, which celebrates the joy of movement and the diversity of athletic achievements, with both shorter road distances and longer trail-running routes. The event is family-friendly, and sustainability, consistency and enjoyment are at the heart of the community. Participants will have a unique experience amid the beauty of nature and the wine region.
course_highlights: A route through the rolling hills of Etyek, among rows of vines and vineyards
Spring scenery and the atmosphere of the wine region
Mixed terrain: road and trail running
additional: Discounted family registration is available, allowing one adult to register up to 5 family members. Family registration does not include a medal by default, but one can be ordered for an additional fee. Registration cannot be cancelled, but it can be transferred to another race no later than 21 days before the event. The registration system automatically sends an invoice, and several payment methods are available. The Garmin WTF series puts sustainability and a sense of community first. Participants can choose from several distances, and free Pilates classes, local wines and food will be available in connection with the event. The race is an ideal event for lovers of vineyards and nature.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
location: Mór, Szent István tér, Mór, Hungary
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon will take place on May 1, 2026, in Mór, at Szent István Square. The event offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). Runners can take on the routes through beautiful vineyards across varied terrain, with climbs and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes younger participants with children’s races. Finishers are rewarded with refreshments and a finisher’s medal. The event’s distinctive atmosphere comes from the local wine region and the sense of community.
course_highlights: 5 km route within Mór, with minimal elevation gain on easy terrain
10 km route through vineyards, following a hilly and varied course
21 km half marathon with long climbs, views of Csókakő Castle, and downhill sections
additional: The start area is in front of Mór Town Hall. Start times: half marathon at 10:00, 5 km at 10:05, and 10 km at 10:10. The entry fee includes participation, a finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments, a fröccs station, coffee, and ice cream at the finish. The race is cup-free as part of its commitment to environmental protection. Children’s races will also take place in Szent István Park, with separate age groups and awards. The half marathon uses chip timing, with a UHF chip attached to the back of the race bib. Technical and cotton T-shirts can be ordered for an additional fee during advance registration. Scenery: park and city streets. Advance registration is open until April 20; on-site registration is available at higher fees. Children’s races. A finisher’s medal is not guaranteed for on-site registrations.

name: 50. Komárom-Komárno Nemzetközi Utcai Futóverseny
location: Komárom, Szabadság tér, Komárom-Esztergom megye, Hungary
description: The 50th Komárom-Komárno International Street Race is a traditional international running event held in two countries within one city. Participants can choose between 5.5 km and 10 km races, as well as a children’s race. The event is open to both competitive and recreational runners. The race starts at Szabadság Square in South Komárom and finishes at the sports hall in North Komárom. Its aims are to promote running, strengthen the running community, and support a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of North and South Komárom, crossing two countries within one city
5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 200-metre children’s race
The finish is at the sports hall in North Komárom
additional: Race-pack collection is available on race day: by 9:15 at the latest for the 10 km race and by 9:45 for the 5.5 km race. The children’s race is for participants aged 10 or younger. The time limits are 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km race and 45 minutes for the 5.5 km race. The awards ceremony takes place at 11:30 at the sports hall in North Komárom. The participant limit is 1,500. Several thousand people take part in the event, and registration is open until April 25. The race is part of the Komárom Days events and the course passes several points around the city, including the area around Szabadság Square and the North Komárom Municipal Sports Hall.

name: KOMÁROM – KOMÁRNO FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Komárom-Komárno International Street Running Race is an open, recreational running event held on the streets of the cities of North and South Komárom—two countries, one city. The event offers 5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as children’s races, and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners. Its aim is to promote running, strengthen the sense of belonging to the running community, and support healthy living. The start is at Szabadság Square in South Komárom, and the finish is at the City Sports Hall in North Komárom. The event is a longstanding international tradition that also strengthens cooperation between the two cities.
course_highlights: Street course through the districts of North and South Komárom, in two countries
5.5 km and 10 km distances, plus children’s races
Start: Szabadság Square, South Komárom; finish: City Sports Hall, North Komárom
additional: Race-pack pickup on race day: by 9:45 at the latest for the 5.5 km distance and by 9:15 for the 10 km distance. The event aims to strengthen the running community and promote healthy living. The mayors of the two cities are the event’s patrons. Race directors and local race coordinators oversee the organization. The event takes place on May 1, 2026; registration is open, and detailed information is available on the official websites. The event brings together the local community and international runners.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: “Fut az Üllő” is a traditional urban running race held in the city center of Üllő. The race aims to promote sport and community life and is open to all age groups. A limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. The event is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures its success with the support of the local community.
course_highlights: Running course in the city center
Community-oriented, family-friendly event
On-site registration available on race day
additional: Online registration closes on April 26, 2024, at 12:00 p.m., but a limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. Race date: 2026-05-01; registration deadline: 2024-04-26; location: City Center, Üllő

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: The II Mohácsi Gőcze Trail is a recreational running event taking place on May 2, 2026, at the Szőlőhegyi event grounds in Mohács. The race follows the trails of the Mohács Hills and offers various distances for all age groups, from an 500-meter children’s race to a 22 km distance. The family-friendly event offers medical coverage and prizes, and participants can have their times recorded by chip timing. Runners can take part in a group warm-up before the start. Participation is at the runner’s own risk.
course_highlights: Trails of the Mohács Hills
Distances from 500 m to 22 km, for all age groups
Start and finish at the Szőlőhegyi event grounds
additional: Chip timing with a 2,000 Ft deposit. Prizes for the top three finishers in each distance and gender category. Participants in the children’s races receive a finisher’s medal. Register online and pay by bank transfer. Registration changes: fussajovodert@gmail.com. Littering is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The event may be postponed in extreme weather. Terrain: trails of the Mohács Hills; Registration: online, through the Facebook event; chip timing, prizes, medical coverage, children’s races

name: MOHÁCSI GÖCZE TRAIL (2.)
location: Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytér, Mohács, Baranya County, Hungary
description: The Mohács Gőcze Trail is a trail-running race held at the Mohács Szőlőhegyi Event Venue. Every finisher receives a metal finisher’s medal, and the top three finishers in each distance and gender category receive special prizes, including in the children’s races. The event promotes the power of running and community, and offers participants high quality at low prices. The race includes a 21 km distance that earns Ötpróba points. The organizers emphasize the positive effects of running on physical and mental health.
course_highlights: 21 km trail-running distance
Every finisher receives a metal finisher’s medal
The top three finishers in each distance and gender category receive special prizes
additional: On-site registration is available on race day. The race venue is the Mohács Szőlőhegyi Event Venue. The race is part of the Ötpróba program; the 21 km distance is worth 4 points. Children’s races also include prizes. Distances: 500 m, 1 km, 6 km, 10.5 km, 22 km; venue: Mohács, Szőlőhegyi Event Venue; online and on-site registration; medical coverage; children’s races; changes may be made depending on the weather.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon

description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

name: Subcarpați Trail Run
location: Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, Cocorăștii Mislii, Prahova, Romania
distance_verbose: 50 mile, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Semimaraton, Semimaraton, 5 km
