description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is a trail-running event held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture and fun, offering an opportunity to escape the everyday and enjoy the beauty of nature with loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony and themed workshops for all ages.
course_highlights: Routes through nature reserves, hills and meadows
Areas with waterfalls and caves unique to the region
Natural setting between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, at an altitude of 700–1,400 m
additional: Race kit distribution on race day from 07:00 to 08:30. Starts in order: Crosul Liliecilor (15 km) at 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) at 09:30, and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m) at 10:00. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00. The event includes themed workshops for children and adults during breaks. Participation includes various race categories, with details about registration requirements and the schedule; all are scheduled for May 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional run organized in the heart of the Târgoviște Citadel, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, in Tricolorului Square, bringing together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and the race celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.
course_highlights: Start in Tricolorului Square, in the historic center of Târgoviște
Urban course with views of the Citadel and Chindia Tower
Event for all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The start area is in Tricolorului Square, Târgoviște. The event has a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, with a recommendation to bring suitable shoes and plenty of stamina. The event is part of Carpat Race and is supported by the local community, offering an opportunity to promote health and physical activity in Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail-running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a friendly atmosphere, music, and a bar on site. It’s a great opportunity for running enthusiasts and others to test themselves in a natural, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly terrain known as “Világlátó”
1.6 km lap with 60 m of elevation gain
2-, 4-, or 6-hour challenge, with a Nordic walking option
additional: Nordic walking poles are available in limited quantities by requesting them via email. There will be music and Wunderbar on site. Each participant receives a starter pack with a race bib and other promotional materials. The event combines running with a mental challenge, with participants aiming to complete as many laps as possible within their chosen time. A trail challenge with 1.6 km loops and running or Nordic walking options, held as part of Szent György Napok.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and runs through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized course with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat course suitable for all levels
Runs alongside the Maritsa River and relaxation areas with water views
The 10 km course consists of 2 laps of the park
additional: Race packs can be collected in advance on May 1 from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. The starts are on May 2: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and the 1 km children’s run at 10:20. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at 11:40. 40% of entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, while the winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. Sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a prize raffle are planned. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kodzha Kaya is the first fully self-supported ultramarathon in Bulgaria, held in the village of Bilka, in the area of Mount Kodzha Kaya. The race offers a range of distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. It is an event for adventure and mountain-running enthusiasts that leaves a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4,400 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
42 km marathon with over 2,700 m of elevation gain and no aid stations
30 km Sky with 1,950 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
additional: All distances are fully self-supported, with no aid stations. There is also an additional challenge: a vertical climb up Kodzha Kaya, 3.6 km with 500 m of elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural setting rich in flora and fauna, offering stunning views and challenging terrain. The race is held on May 1–2, 2026, and participants can choose from a range of distances suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to age 14, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, paths, river, relaxation area, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children’s race, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is available online or on site on the event day, subject to the availability of race bibs. Late registration is available after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and cash and in-kind prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children’s race and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and the community.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: The 24th Self-Transcendence Marathon will take place on May 3, 2026, at Malomvölgyi Lake in Pécs. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, this family-friendly race follows a loop course and offers marathon and half-marathon distances. The course runs on compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain, giving participants varied terrain to race on. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and the aid stations provide plenty of refreshments.
course_highlights: 5.2 km loop course; the marathon covers 8 laps
Compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain
A combination of the walking path around the lake and a marked course
additional: Chip timing uses a chip attached to the back of the bib. The aid station at the start/finish offers isotonic drinks, water, sweet and savoury biscuits, sandwiches, fruit, vegetables and chocolate. Field limit: 250 participants. A T-shirt can be ordered separately for HUF 3,500 until April 15. Cut-off times: 5.2 km — 50 minutes; 10.4 km — 1 hour 40 minutes; half marathon — 3 hours; marathon — 6 hours. Bib and T-shirt collection is available on race day between 7:00 and 7:45; on-site registration is also available during this time. Multiple distances, a forest course, chip timing, on-site and online registration, a participant limit (max. 250), cut-off times and awards by distance, and nearby accommodation offers.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is an atmospheric trail-running race along the vineyard slopes of Farkasmály in Gyöngyös, among vineyards and wine cellars. The event offers challenges over several distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer 8.5 km loop with climbs. Runners can enjoy being close to nature, visits to wine cellars, and varied terrain suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, which has decades of experience running sporting events.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3,000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 loops among the vineyard slopes, with a wine-cellar visit
Farkasmály Loop: 8,500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 loops with climbs and wine-cellar visits
Relay race: 4 × 1,500 m; Spritzer Run for teams of 3, with an 800 m distance and spritzer drinking stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00; on-site registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant race. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the Szilue Hotel. Race location GPS coordinates: 47.805908, 19.955025. Registration for the race is open from April 10 to April 30; prizes and a wine tasting await participants.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts in Zalaegerszeg and finishes in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. Along the way, participants run through the beautiful landscapes of Zala County, with ten relay points, and the entire route is timed using chip timing. The event gives special support to premature babies, and includes a separate run for them. Teams can cross the finish line together to share the experience and the achievement. The start and pasta party venue is the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track. The run takes place on Sunday, May 3.
course_highlights: 66 km between Zalaegerszeg and Keszthely
10 relay points and a refreshment point at the Göcseji Village Museum
The route is marked with small teddy-bear signs and ribbons approximately every 200 metres
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib. The time limit for the distance is 8 hours 30 minutes. The pasta party takes place at the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track on May 2 at 17:00. The route also crosses two railway crossings; participants are escorted by an ambulance across the first one. The run for premature babies takes place on May 3 at 16:00, from the castle park in Keszthely to Fő tér. The event includes several related activities, including registration, race-pack collection, relay points and the finish, and offers the option to enter individually or as a team.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria

description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gain, challenging participants with a true mountain experience. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and in-kind prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain ranging from 420 m to 1,640 m
Start and finish at Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Race packets will be distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at Olympic Square. Participants under 16 may take part only in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and the prizes for the top three places are cash and in-kind prizes. Participants are advised to complete the participation declarations in advance. Payment is currently accepted only by bank transfer. The distances are 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km, with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1,640 m, respectively; the start and finish are at Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses run through mountain and forest terrain.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as boys and girls under 20, under 18 and under 16, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18 and 16
Held in the scenic area of Chepelare
additional: For any questions, participants should contact the organizer directly at the email address provided to them. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is held with official support. It is part of the national mountain running calendar and offers the opportunity to compete in different age categories.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow competitors.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop
Held in St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance: 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Each race day starts at 8:00. Each participant must wear a visible race number on the front. Laps are counted by a judge, who changes every six hours. A camera-based backup counting system is also in place. If a participant pauses the race or leaves the course, they must inform the judge. A “hotel lap” may be counted when leaving and rejoining the course at designated points. Alcohol consumption, smoking, and drug use are prohibited in the camp and on the course. A minimum running dress code applies in the park, and running shirtless is not permitted. Official results are published the following day at around 9:00 on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Course: paved track, 785 m; registration until 1 April 2026; personal assistant fee: 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race aims to bring together people from the corporate world and everyone interested in a shared active experience, where both individual achievement and team spirit take centre stage. Runners can choose from three options: a 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), or a 2 km walking stadium tour. Music, a party and street food accompany the event, making it an unforgettable experience even after the run.
course_highlights: The iconic running track at the National Athletics Centre
Three distance options: 5 km individual run, 3 × 2.7 km relay, and a 2 km walking stadium tour
Run near the Danube, enjoy the stadium experience and soak up the fantastic party atmosphere
additional: Payment at the event is possible by bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires a BSI account. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. After the race, participants can enjoy a fantastic party, music and street food. Each runner in the 3-person relay completes approximately 2.7 km. Free online training and a charity option are also available at the event. Distances: 5 km, 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), stadium tour (2 km walking). The event takes place at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. Participation is possible with online or on-site registration.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event taking place on May 6, 2026, at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The event welcomes not only people from the corporate world but everyone interested in coming together to get active, take on a challenge and celebrate. There are three distances: an individual 5 km, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km) and a 2 km stadium walking tour. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal, and music, street food and an evening party will provide the entertainment.
course_highlights: The iconic track at the National Athletics Centre
3 distances: individual 5 km, 3 × 2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walking tour
A special riverside location on the Danube
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card and SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. Music, street food and an evening party await participants. Contact details for the registration office are available on the website. Music, street food and a festive atmosphere await participants at the National Athletics Centre, where community activities will also take place alongside the running event.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Haydushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete to climb the iconic path from its starting point to the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel. The route offers several variations of differing difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who climbs the path in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for lovers of mountain running and nature.
course_highlights: Climb the iconic Haydushka Path in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with several variations—the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder’s name is added to a special sign at the start of the path. Results for participants with a time under 1 hour are published on the website of the Old Elm Foundation. The event features trail running on different routes and has no categories or prizes, with an emphasis on personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 takes place in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honour of Haji Dimitar’s birthday and St. George’s Day—the Day of Bravery. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a vojvoda. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park, with alpine-type terrain
The course follows ancient hajduk trails and passes near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
An area with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the Old Elm Foundation’s traditional patriotic initiatives and is held in honour of historical figures and events connected with the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Sinite Kamani Nature Park Information Centre; competitions include stone and knife throwing. Participants are encouraged to wear traditional folk costumes.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding courses and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurous spirits, offering a unique experience across forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, promise a great atmosphere and smooth organization for all participants.
course_highlights: Courses through the forests and mountains of Western Serbia
Challenging climbs and technical sections of the course
Beautiful natural landscapes and unspoiled nature
additional: The organizer is West Serbia Trails, known for putting on the best trail parties in Western Serbia.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men in each distance receive special prizes. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and luggage storage. Runners are advised to use a headlamp and hydration pack. The atmosphere and proximity to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill
Unique wooden finisher’s medal for every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Changing rooms and luggage storage at the base. A working, fully charged headlamp is mandatory. Your mobile phone must be charged, switched on and have the volume turned up. You must use a hydration pack, bottle or cup, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. This trail-running event welcomes runners with excellent organization and participant services, including photos, prizes and equipment recommendations.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL

description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the scenic surroundings of Naszály. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance, and the top finishers are awarded special medals. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and baggage storage. For a safe race, runners are advised to use a headlamp and a hydration pack. The atmosphere and closeness to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in Naszály’s natural surroundings
Unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, fantastic photos available the day after the race. Special medals for the first three female and male finishers at each distance. Changing rooms and baggage storage at the base. A headlamp is mandatory; it must be in working order and fully charged. Bring a fully charged, switched-on, working mobile phone with the volume turned up. A hydration pack, bottle or cup is recommended, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. An ID card or a legible copy is required for registration. This trail-running event offers participants plenty of refreshments, safety equipment and memorable experiences.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nighttime sporting experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting with a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km distances
Night run in Cluj-Napoca
Urban course accessible to all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked courses, online registration, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race through the unique landscape of Deliblato Sands, giving participants the chance to choose from three distances: a 5 km recreational race, a challenging 12 km race, and a 21 km trail half marathon. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, in Čardak, and is intended for everyone who loves nature and running, whether beginner or experienced. The course is carefully designed to offer an authentic trail-running experience, with fitting challenges and the beauty of the sands.
course_highlights: The course winds through the unique landscape of Deliblato Sands
Three distances: 5 km, 12 km, and a 21 km trail half marathon
Aid stations with water, fruit, and other refreshments
additional: One aid station on the course will offer water, fruit, peanuts, and sugar. There are two drinking fountains along the course for additional hydration. Registration is open until April 22, 2026; the event is intended for trail-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY
location: Lázár cár tér, Szentendre, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: 111 km, 50 miles, 50 km, Maraton, 30 km, Félmaraton
description: The Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary’s most prestigious trail-running race, consisting of six separate distances and attracting around 1,500 trail runners in total. The race takes place across varied terrain, including dense, dark forests, with challenging climbs. The longest distance is 111 km, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, 9 aid stations, 2 drop bags, and a 20-hour cutoff. The race is held in Szentendre, with the start and finish at Lázár cár Square. A detailed map and an information center are available to runners and their accompanying supporters to help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4,200 m of elevation gain
9 aid stations and 2 drop bags on the longest distance
Dense, dark forests and varied terrain
additional: The race has a maximum capacity of 1,600 participants, with 300 places available on the longest distance. The race’s Google map shows the aid stations, start and finish locations, and race headquarters. There are staffed crossings along the course where supporters are not allowed to cheer. The Dömös and Pap-rét aid stations cannot be reached by car and require a 30-minute walk. Registration for the race opens on November 2, 2025, with various entry options and activities associated with the event.

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS

organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is a unique running race along the cellar row in Farkasmály, Gyöngyös, taking place on May 2, 2026. Participants run through beautiful vineyards and wine cellars on varied terrain with some small hills. The race includes a shorter, less hilly loop and a longer loop with more elevation, so everyone can find a suitable distance. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, one of the region’s leading sports clubs.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 laps, through vineyards and wine cellars
Farkasmály Loop: 8500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 laps, hilly terrain and visits to cellars
Relay race and fröccs race for teams, with special wine-fröccs drinking stations

At the end of each lap, the course passes through cellars; runners climb a small hill towards the finish arch. Trail running, routes between cellars, wine tasting, advance and on-site registration, awards, open cellars, refreshments, and awards ceremony.

The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to test themselves over different distances. The race takes place in a natural setting, providing participants with an enjoyable running experience. The organizers offer professional timing and convenient registration options.

A variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21 and 42 km
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: Beat the Cogwheel! is a traditional sporting event in Budapest’s 12th district, welcoming runners, cyclists, and relay teams in 2026. The aim is to reach the finish before the Cogwheel Railway while tackling an approximately 4 km climb with 325 metres of elevation gain in the Buda Hills. The race challenges athletes of all fitness levels and is also a great group activity for families and colleagues. The event is organised by Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Kft. and Városmajori Tanuszoda.
course_highlights: Approx. 4.0 km distance
325 metres of elevation gain
Scenic surroundings in the Buda Hills
additional: Participants can enter in running, cycling, and relay categories. Rules on wearing race numbers and using chips, along with the privacy notice and terms and conditions, are available among the official documents. Competitors can enter age groups for those under and over 18, and results from previous years can be viewed in the archive. The race is known as an extreme challenge and offers prizes, individual and relay options, and registration details on the official website.

name: Krones Charity Run

description: The Krones Charity Run is a charity running event taking place on May 9, 2026, in Debrecen, on the grounds of the Southern Industrial Park. The full amount of the entry fees, along with donations doubled by Krones Hungary, will be donated to the foundation. Participants can choose from several distances, and everyone who finishes receives a unique finisher’s medal. A MIZUNO event T-shirt and full BioTechUSA refreshments are provided, and the Athletes Garden will welcome runners at the end of the event.
course_highlights: 10 km individual race, on a 4-lap course
Held in the Southern Industrial Park, where Krones Hungary was the first company to move in
MIZUNO event T-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments at the aid stations
additional: Registration takes place through the StafétApp mobile app, which is available free of charge. Race packs are also collected using StafétApp. Every runner who finishes within the time limit receives a unique finisher’s medal. The Athletes Garden will provide an on-site program at the end of the event. Eco-friendly, ÖKO race packs are used, and plastic use is reduced. The full amount of the entry fees will be donated to charity. Online and on-site registration are both available, and the participation package includes a MIZUNO T-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Pest County, Hungary
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a family-friendly recreational trail-running event organized by the EDUSPORT Sports Association. No elevation gain; distances are easy to complete
Children’s races and team races for families

The entry fee includes timekeeping, a race number, a finisher’s medal, a finisher’s pack, and refreshments. Changing rooms, toilets, and bag storage are available at the event. Children’s races, team races, Color Run, prize draw, online and on-site registration, detailed routes, refreshment stations, commemorative medal, finisher’s pack

name: EDURACE
location: Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő, Pest County, Hungary

Participants run to stay ahead of the Virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed until everyone is caught. The event in Oradea, Romania, on 10 May 2026, takes place on a 1.7 km paved circuit in the heart of the Nokian Tyres factory. All entry fees and donations go entirely toward spinal cord injury research.

Open to runners and wheelchair users
The Virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed

Participants can run any distance, with no fixed finish line, and can register through the app. Participants can run individually or in groups, and all funds raised go toward spinal cord injury research.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 invites you to run in the heart of Transylvania, through the center of Târgu Mureș, on May 10, 2026. The event offers a range of races: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4x5 km relay, and a children’s race. All start and finish in the central area, making it ideal for support from family and friends. Participants will discover the city’s notable tourist attractions in a vibrant spring atmosphere, enjoying prizes, medals, and good energy every step of the way. The organizer is Mureș Runners Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and community through sport.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș, passing notable tourist attractions
Start and finish in Piața Teatrului, in the city center
A range of events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4x5 km relay, and children’s race

Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, relay, and children’s race. The event promotes physical activity and local tourism in Târgu Mureș.

name: Budureasa Mountain Running
description: Budureasa Mountain Running is a mountain running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Budureasa Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes two main races: the 8 km Eco Cross and the 16 km Cross, intended for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The routes start and finish in front of the Budureasa Cultural Center, offering a mountain experience with climbs and descents on gravel roads, trails, and paved roads. Refreshment points along the course provide water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. The race is open to all runners who are fit to participate, with special conditions for participants under 18.
course_highlights: The 8 km Eco Cross and 16 km Cross share a route until km 4.5, where there is a refreshment point
Steep climbs and significant elevation changes, including a 450 m climb with 170 m of positive elevation gain
The final kilometers are on paved roads, with hydration points and gentle descents
additional: Race check-in takes place on Saturday from 16:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Budureasa Cultural Center. The technical briefing is on Saturday, 09.05.2026, from 19:00 to 19:30, and on race day at 10:00. There are 3 refreshment points on the 16 km Cross course and 1 on the 8 km Eco Cross course, providing water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. Registrations are validated only after payment of the entry fee, and changes or cancellations can be made in writing only until 26.04.2026. Athletes suspended for doping are not eligible to participate. The route may be modified due to weather conditions; online registration is open until 3 May 2026, and registration may also be available on site; restrictions apply to minors; anti-doping rules apply.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run across the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vast sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature lovers and runners seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km of rugged coastal beauty with an endless horizon
17 km along breathtaking cliffs with a sea breeze
7 fast and impressive kilometres along the coast
additional: Race packs are collected in the cities of Varna and Shabla, with a signed participation declaration. To collect a race pack for another participant, their signed declaration is required. Participants under 18 need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, the waves, and the journey, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from partner Villa Daros. The event features races over different distances, is supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amid the natural scenery of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to the cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot “Slancheto” in Borisova Gradina and take part using the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular “Slancheto” area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of paved park paths
1.2 km of dirt-and-gravel path, followed by 1.8 km of wide paved road
additional: The race is accessible to wheelchair participants. The virtual Catcher Car begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to take part and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or in person. The event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: the longer red course, 21 km with 1,400 meters of elevation gain, intended for seniors, and the shorter blue course, 10 km with 500 meters of elevation gain, for juniors. The courses pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race attracts competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series is governed by the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.

The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has fostered Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.

Organized transportation for participants
Medal for all participants
additional: Organized transportation to Somborica is available for participants; the contact person is Milan Kovačić. The celebration of ARK Somaraton’s 16th anniversary is part of the accompanying activities. Runners receive a medal for participating. The club has around 65 members, with active training sessions and support for runners of all levels. The event also includes organized city tours, cultural activities, and support during the race, and is open to all age groups.

The race takes place amid the breathtaking natural scenery of the Mátra, where you can take on this unique challenge alongside thousands of other runners. A unique medal awaits participants at the finish, making the day one to remember. The race is not only a test of physical endurance, but also a true adventure and experience. Everyone is warmly welcome.
course_highlights: 11.6 km course with 671 m of elevation gain
Run to the summit of Kékes, Hungary’s highest point
Beautiful natural scenery in the Mátra

The race is 11.6 km long, with 671 m of elevation gain, set in beautiful natural surroundings with panoramic views of the Mátra. Participants enjoy a unique experience as the steadily uphill route to the summit tests their endurance. Finishers receive a special medal, and participants can also make a charitable contribution when registering.

Beautiful natural surroundings in the Mátra Mountains
Steadily uphill, challenging terrain

Set amid the Mátra’s picturesque landscapes and stunning natural surroundings, it is a true challenge for runners looking to test their endurance and fitness. Runners come from hundreds of towns and villages, and finishers receive a unique medal to make the day memorable. The race is more than just a running event—it is also an inner journey where nature and the joy of achievement come together.

Run to Kékestető, Hungary’s highest point
Stunning natural surroundings and panoramic views in the Mátra

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
location: Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition featuring tests of strength, speed, agility, and skills, held at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition, scheduled for May 17, 2026, challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.
course_highlights: Obstacle course testing strength, speed, and agility
Location at Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park, Cluj-Napoca
Available distances: 6 km and 12 km
additional: The event includes technique and strength obstacles. Registration and participation details are available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Crosul Sport4All
location: Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, Lugoj, Timiș County, Romania
description: Crosul Sport 4 all is an annual running event held in Lugoj, open to all ages and fitness levels. It includes untimed races for children and a 2 km fun run, as well as timed 4 km and 6 km races for older participants. The courses loop around the Drăgan European University and along the city’s central streets, offering a pleasant urban experience. Participants receive finisher medals, and the timed races have age categories. The event is supported by Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University, with 400 free places offered by sponsor Mondial S.A.
course_highlights: Loop courses around Drăgan European University and along the central streets of Lugoj
Races for all ages, including untimed races for children and timed 4 km and 6 km races
Participation medals for all participants in the untimed races
additional: Register online by 10.05.2026 at 23:59 or until all 400 free places are filled. Race kits are distributed on Saturday and Sunday at Drăgan European University. The event includes an awards ceremony for the timed races, as well as warm-up sessions and a technical briefing before the start. Volunteers receive a volunteer kit and a volunteer agreement in accordance with the law. Races for children and adults, untimed and timed races, urban courses, online registration, race kit, medals and diplomas for participants, event organized in partnership with Lugoj City Hall and Drăgan European University.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is the largest cross-country cycling marathon in Romania, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, with a distance of approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no significant elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere, ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.
course_highlights: Approximately 55 km through forests and country roads
No significant elevation changes, making for an accessible experience
The classic Bucharest–Snagov route
additional: Race packs can be collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race at Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participants can expect a varied route with natural terrain and diverse scenery, making this a landmark mountain biking event in Romania.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professional runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The event brings together sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty: 3 km with 75 m of elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m of elevation gain, and 26 km with 1,514 m of elevation gain
Routes follow historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: The organizers are Apriltsi Municipality, the Troyan in the Future Association, and the National Society “Tradition” – 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with funds raised allocated to causes related to the fight against cancer and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event is organized to bring together sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different levels of difficulty and welcoming both professional runners and enthusiasts. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and scenic sea views. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon tests endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course runs along Varna’s coastline, with sea views
The race takes place in Bulgaria’s seaside capital
An atmosphere of support from local fans and international participants
additional: Late on-site registration is possible if places are available at the information center, which is open May 12–16, 2026. Race numbers can only be collected in person on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square, next to the Varna Opera House. The event also includes a 2 km city run with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; online and on-site registration; an event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Pleven Friendship Marathon is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. The organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a varied program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turn-around points
Refreshment stations every 5–6 km and water stations every 3 km and along the course
The course passes through Kaylaka Park and scenic parts of Pleven
additional: Race packets are distributed at the Children’s Activity Center on May 16 from 10:30 to 15:00 and on May 17 from 7:15 to 8:00. Personal energy products can be handed in on May 17 from 8:00 to 8:30. There is a medical station and an ambulance on the course. The awards ceremony is at 13:30, and a special run with BALIZ starts at 9:35. Registration is free for participants over 60 and people with disabilities upon request and submission of documents. Payment can be made via PayPal or bank transfer. Course, registration, charitable cause, children’s marathon

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held in the foothills of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event brings together sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: The Hobby route is 37 km with 1,274 m of elevation gain, suitable for cyclists of all levels.
The Difficult route is 47 km with 1,781 m of elevation gain, featuring challenging climbs and technical descents for advanced riders.
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the cycling route overlapping the Hobby route.
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, aid stations with food and drinks, a medical team, and festival activities at the start/finish area, including live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children’s race for children up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start/finish area. It includes a children’s race, a tent campsite, insurance, aid stations, and charitable giving.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This 21st anniversary race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in the men’s and women’s events and across age groups. Participants receive chipped bib numbers and “Joma” Dry Fit T-shirts, while the organizers provide transportation and a celebratory dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Bistrica, Petrovac na Mlavi
Chipped personalized bib number and “Joma” Dry Fit sports T-shirt
Transportation from the registration center to the race start and a celebratory dinner at the Olimpik swimming pools
additional: The participant package includes transportation from Belgrade (Arena) to Petrovac na Mlavi and back, with a tour leader. It is limited to 50 competitors who pay first. Participants receive a 50% discount on a day ticket to Ždrelo Spa. Special accommodation benefits are available for race participants at the Olimpic swimming pool. The race is part of the annual events honoring Dragutin Tomašević, with organization that includes timing, promotion, T-shirts, and medals for participants.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying distances and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural landscapes of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. The Golija PREMIUM race, starting at the summit of Golija, and the two-day ULTRA 66K stage race, which connects three mountains and offers a challenge for experienced runners, are particular highlights. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport and accommodation for participants, creating a welcoming and supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through spectacular landscapes featuring viewpoints, clearings and meadows
Race starts at elevations of 800 to 1833 meters above sea level
Electronic timing and staffed aid stations
additional: Free transport is provided for the Golija PREMIUM 29K race from Ivanjica to the start and from Kovilj back. ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race with overnight accommodation at a school in Kovilj, four meals, six aid stations and a gathering around a campfire. The first ULTRA 66K stage starts at 11h, and the second at 09h the following day. The race pack includes a race number, finisher’s medal, refreshments and lunch. Multiple distances, a two-day event, an available list of registered participants, technically challenging routes, electronic timing, and race packs with medals and meals.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for having been entered in the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we are running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, with the goal of taking part in a new Guinness World Record attempt in Serbia for the first time.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start across multiple countries and continents
Event with two Guinness World Records for the largest half marathon with a synchronized start
additional: Registration is at Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište from 08:00 to 11:30 in the tent. The race pack includes a race bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, live results, and a diploma in PDF format. The race program includes a warm-up at 12:45, the start of the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races at 13:30, and the awards ceremony at 15:30. The event features races of different distances, is open to all ages, and race packs and medals are available to participants. It takes place in the center of Veliko Gradište, with morning registration and afternoon races.

name: LÉLEKFUTÁS ÉS PIKNIK
description: The Soul Run and Picnic is a warm, community-focused event in Magyarpolány, centered on movement and renewal for body and soul. Runners of all ages take part, and the day is rounded off with delicious food and meditative activities such as walking the labyrinth and a gong sound bath. More than just a sporting event, it is a vibrant community celebration held in the embrace of nature. The event is organized by the Habitus Foundation and takes place as part of the Polány Pentecost event series.
course_highlights: A nature-focused running race for families and all ages
A meditative labyrinth walk offering a unique inner experience
A gong sound bath for inner calm and renewal
additional: The event is part of the Polány Pentecost event series. After the race, participants can enjoy a communal picnic and delicious food, including chili con carne and vegan salads. The program includes a gong sound bath and a meditative labyrinth walk offering a special inner experience. Several special prizes are also awarded, and the sense of community is a central part of the event. Participants can enjoy races, a family picnic, relaxation activities, refreshments, and spring water. Advance registration is required.

name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a relay race between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering 42.2 km in six stages for teams of 4–6. The route passes through scenic settlements, with runners completing the full distance in relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment stations and goulash at the finish, while cultural programs add to the day. The race takes place on August 23, 2025. Online registration is available until August 20; afterward, on-site registration is possible only if places remain.
course_highlights: A 42.2 km relay race in 6 stages, with legs of 5–7.8 km
Route through Salgótarján, Somoskőújfalu, Radzovce, Rátka, Trebeľovce, Hladký Majer, and Lučenec
Refreshment stations approximately every 5 km; goulash and cultural programs at the finish
additional: The relay is for teams of at least 4 and at most 6 runners, with handoffs at the relay points. Runners must be at least 15 years old. The full course runs alongside traffic, on the left-hand side, and traffic regulations must be followed. Members of the first 30 teams receive medals, and the top three finishers in each category win cups. The course passes through several towns, with refreshment stations every 5 km, online registration and the possibility of on-site registration, and cultural programs and concerts at the finish.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometre trail running race that is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna and includes the famous “two spikes,” which present runners with a special challenge. This race offers a unique finish-line experience in Hungary that only UTH can provide. It is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the atmosphere and trail-running challenges of Ultra-Trail Hungary.
course_highlights: 22-kilometre course around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna
The elevation gains of the dreaded two spikes
A unique finish-line experience in Hungary
additional: Registration was open until noon on 1 May 2026; registration transfers and distance changes could still be arranged on that day. The race is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary series, which offers several distances and races. The event is supported by sponsors at several levels and media partners. The race venue is Dömös, Szentfa-Kápolna; bus transfer is included in the entry fee; there is no water available at the start location.

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail-running race that starts at the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and finishes in downtown Szentendre. Runners pass through the most beautiful and challenging-to-reach parts of the Visegrád Hills, on varied and demanding terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for both nature lovers and trail-running enthusiasts. The event is traditionally of a high standard, with well-organized support provided for participants along the course.
course_highlights: 30 km from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád to Szentendre
The most beautiful and challenging-to-reach parts of the Visegrád Hills
Varied terrain and natural surroundings
additional: Registration has closed because the maximum capacity of 1,600 participants has been reached. The race headquarters and expo are at the Ferences Sports Hall, Áprily Lajos tér 3, Szentendre. Bag storage is in the Reformed Secondary School building. The race is supported by several well-known brands, including Salomon, TUI, Leki, Petzl, Garmin, and Rudy Project. Lists of the different distances, registration, volunteering opportunities, sponsors, and media partners.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania

price_tiers.distance: Pași pentru oraș by Bilstein 3.35 km

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba, Romania
price_range: 50 lei donație pentru acces la zonele Food & Drinks (pentru ediția Harvest) sau 120-150 RON pentru cursele de alergare
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The event combines running and cycling on scenic routes through the Jidvei vineyards, offering participants spectacular views and an authentic experience surrounded by nature. It includes races for all fitness levels, from children to adults, as well as recreational and food-and-wine activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through vineyards and ancient forests
Spectacular scenery in the Jidvei vineyards, in the heart of Transylvania
Event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle
additional: Race kits for the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, as well as the 1 km and 2 km children’s races. Prizes for the youngest runners. Relaxation activities and food-and-wine experiences are included in the event. The organizers are preparing a fun-filled world and creative workshops for children in a safe, friendly setting. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races. The event also includes a grape-picking competition, guided tours, activities for children, charitable donations, and wine and traditional food tastings.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, taking place on May 23, 2026, in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports. The event brings together the local community and amateur athletes, offering a half-marathon race and other sporting events. The route starts in Central Square and passes through the city’s main thoroughfares. The event is held under the patronage of Prince Radu, with support from several local institutions and associations. Participants are encouraged to read the regulations, register, and donate in support of the cause.
course_highlights: Urban route starting and finishing in Central Square, Bistrița
Passes through the city’s main streets: Dornei Street, Șincai Street, Mihai Eminescu Street, Republicii Boulevard, and Barbu Șt. Delavrancea Street
Event dedicated to commemorating Heroes’ Day and promoting mass-participation sports
additional: Online registrations are validated until May 1, 2026; the event is organized by the Invictus Volunteers Association – Bistrița Branch, under the High Patronage of Prince Radu; participants can receive the official Invictus T-shirt and related merchandise; the event includes other sporting events in addition to the half marathon; participants are advised to read the regulations for details about equipment, timing, and prizes. Four different routes, simplified registration, a donation required for the T-shirt, an event for all ages, and activities promoting solidarity and gratitude.

name: Obciniada Night Run

description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area around Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, and is dedicated to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked courses and significant elevation gain, set in picturesque natural surroundings. The organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the event’s competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon course: 44 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
MTB Race course: 34 km with 930 m of elevation gain
Trail Running Half Marathon course: 25 km with 990 m of elevation gain
additional: The courses have significant elevation gain, ranging from 184 m for the Fun Run (6 km) to 1,180 m for the MTB Marathon (44 km). Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian to register. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. Telephone contact: +40-743-419443. Registration is exclusively online, and the event includes courses ranging from 6 km to marathon distance, suited to different fitness levels.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultramarathon held in Ion Creangă Children’s Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a 1,222.75-meter paved course, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and enthusiasts of endurance running, offering a transformative experience and an exceptional mental and physical challenge. There are also 50 km and 100 km races, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: A 1,222.75-meter paved course in Ion Creangă Children’s Park
The course is illuminated at night for runners’ safety
Two hydration and nutrition stations along the course, offering water, glucose, electrolytes, fruit, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal gear, food, and sleeping bags. Race kits must be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except relays. The event includes a runners’ briefing and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved, illuminated course, with the option to participate in several distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race held in Timișoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting wounded military personnel. The event promotes a winning spirit and national values through sport as part of the Invictus Romania project. The fourth edition continues the tradition of bringing runners and supporters together in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support wounded military personnel.
course_highlights: Symbolic courses in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
An event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition spanning more than a decade
additional: The event is part of a broader Invictus Romania project, which also includes other sporting competitions and activities supporting wounded military personnel. Official Invictus Heroes Half Marathon T-shirts are available for supporters. No details were found about start times, distance options, or registration prices. The event takes place in May 2026 in Timișoara and includes a half marathon and commemorative activities.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its founding in 2026. Held in the village of Sinemorets, it offers trail running distances of 42, 21, and 13 km, plus a 3 km children’s race, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The routes follow the scenic trails of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Strandzha Nature Park
Loop courses starting and finishing at Veleka Beach
Aid stations with fresh fruit, vegetables, and isotonic drinks
additional: The running races start on May 23, with time limits for each distance. Mountain biking takes place on May 24, with two distances. Starts and finishes are at Veleka Beach (North). The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Tibužde
Two distances: 27 km and 7 km
Views and challenging terrain
additional: The race runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous. Registration: online. Categories: multiple, including a children's race. After the race, there is a get-together with lunch and music.

name: SALOMON SZENTENDRE TRAIL
description: The Salomon Szentendre Trail is a 54-kilometer trail-running race held in and around Szentendre, with 1,800 meters of elevation gain. Runners cross the Apátkúti Stream twelve times and pass through beautiful landscapes, including Visegrád and Kálvária. The finish is in Szentendre’s main square and along the Danube promenade, where tourists applaud the finishers. This race offers a unique experience where nature meets the urban environment.
course_highlights: 54 km distance, 1,800 meters of elevation gain
Twelve crossings of the Apátkúti Stream
Beautiful views in Visegrád and at Kálvária
additional: 54 km, 1,800 meters of elevation gain, trail, registration, volunteer opportunity, multiple distances also available (30k, 42k, 84k, 111k)

The race starts at dawn, and participants run across the misty Sikáros Meadow as the cuckoo welcomes them. Before reaching the finish, runners are also cheered on by tourists along the pedestrian streets and in the Main Square. This challenge offers an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail-running enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: The steepest climbs in the Visegrád Mountains
A route across the misty Sikáros Meadow
Finish in Szentendre’s Main Square, where tourists cheer on the runners

The event offers races tailored to different age categories, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed, competitive races for the older age groups. It is a race full of energy and joy, with support from parents, where every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.
