name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, ranging from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a unique experience for mountain-running enthusiasts, combining narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridgelines. Races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special keepsakes for those who finish within the time limits.
course_highlights: Mountain trails featuring narrow paths and ancient forests
Routes across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines in the Bucegi Mountains
Start and finish near Bran Castle, an iconic landmark
additional: Previous experience on mountain trails is required for registration, with different requirements depending on the distance. After 1 May 2026, SportHG technical T-shirts will be replaced with neck gaiters. Places are limited, and registrations are confirmed after online payment and verification of previous experience. The event also includes other mountain races, such as a skyrace and a half marathon, and offers prizes and finisher mementos.

Participants can choose 6-, 12- or 24-hour events, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, aiming to cover the greatest possible distance within the allotted time. The event is open to professional and amateur runners, offering a transformative experience and the opportunity to test their physical and mental limits. It is organised to high standards, with international recognition and dedicated participant facilities.

6-, 12- and 24-hour events, plus 50 km and 100 km races

additional: The course is measured and IAAF-certified, with individual distance tracking and chip timing. The event also includes a technical briefing and pasta party on the evening before the race. A paved, night-lit course and multiple duration and distance events for amateur and professional athletes.

description: The BUFF-CEUS 72H World Cup is an international ultrarunning race held at Füred Camping and Holiday Village in Balatonfüred. The event features races of several durations, including 72, 48, 24, 12, and 6 hours, as part of the Central European Ultra Series. The course is a 898-meter loop with a minimal elevation gain of 1 meter, making it ideal for long-distance runners. Participants can enter individual and team categories, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and a central refreshment table is available at the race centre.

Race centre on the east side of Füred Camping
Central refreshment table with water, hot tea, isotonic drink, squash, and coffee
additional: The event features races of several durations: the 72H World Cup and 48H European Cup start at 12:00 on 2026.05.28; the 24H European Cup starts at 12:00 on 2026.05.30; the 12H European Cup starts at 08:00 on 2026.05.30; and the 6H European Cup starts at 06:00 on 2026.05.31. The opening ceremony and technical briefing take place on 2026.05.27 from 17:00 to 18:30. Race-number pickup is available at several times before and during the event. Accommodation and parking spaces are available from 2026.05.27 at 12:00 until 2026.05.28 at 10:00; vehicle movement is restricted during the race. Participants can enter different distances, and the organizers provide runners with the necessary infrastructure and services.

description: Tour de Fruška is one of the region’s most attractive sporting events, held in the beautiful setting of Fruška Gora in Vrdnik. The event brings together sport, nature and tourism, offering participants a unique experience of cycling through unspoiled nature and beautiful landscapes. It draws cycling and active-holiday enthusiasts, promoting a healthy lifestyle and Vojvodina’s tourism potential.
course_highlights: Ride through Fruška Gora National Park
Beautiful landscapes and unspoiled nature
A variety of cycling trails and terrain
additional: The organizer is the Tourism Organization of Vojvodina. The event is held in Vrdnik, within Fruška Gora National Park. It promotes the combination of sport, nature and tourism in the region. Participants and visitors can enjoy a local-products market, activities for children and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle. Admission for visitors is free, while prices vary for the different competitive disciplines.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The trail passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations with numerous caves, including an ascent to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership book stamped for 2026 and appropriate hiking equipment.
course_highlights: Ascent of Mount Devica, with lush vegetation and limestone formations
Visit to Marko Polo Cave and ascent to Soko Grad
Golem Kamen viewpoint and forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall
additional: Departure from Nebojšina Street at 06:00. The planned return to Belgrade is around 22:00–22:30. Participants must bring a jacket, a light hat, lightweight gloves, a raincoat, high-top hiking boots, gaiters, trekking poles, a change of clothes, a flashlight, their own first-aid kit, energy bars or nuts, magnesium for muscle cramps, and at least 1.5–2 L of water. There is no water along part of the trail. Lunch will be organized after the ascent, or participants may bring food in their backpacks. Participants must have a hiking membership book stamped for 2026. Equipment should include a jacket, hat, gloves, high-top hiking boots, trekking poles, a flashlight, first aid, food, and water.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3

Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

A run close to nature

course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: Race kit pickup is on Friday 05.06.2026, between 15:00 and 22:00, for BBB Ultra 60; mandatory gear checks apply, and pickup is for participants only. For the other distances, kits can be picked up on Saturday 06.06.2026, between 7:00 and 9:30. The kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a single-use chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului is a sporting event dedicated to promoting outdoor activity, mountain running, and a healthy lifestyle. It welcomes participants of all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a variety of routes, from children’s races to a half marathon, in the authentic natural surroundings of Teiuș, Alba. It promotes inclusion, fair play, and active community participation, with free entry for all participants. A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.
course_highlights: The 21.1 km Half Marathon route through picturesque landscapes and unspoiled nature
The 11 km Cros X race for experienced runners
Short, accessible routes for families and children within the fairground
additional: Race kits can be collected on May 28–29, 2026, between 17:00 and 19:00, and on race day, May 30, 2026, between 07:00 and 08:00. Starts are scheduled from 08:15 for the Half Marathon and Cros X, while the children’s races and Family Run take place in the afternoon. The event offers age-category prizes and encourages families to take part together in the Family Run. Routes for all ages and levels include a half marathon, 11 km and 6 km races, Family Run, children’s races, and Kinder.

name: Thermal Trail Race
description: Thermal Trail Race is an outdoor running event that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event takes place in Băile 1 Mai, with the start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Two races are available: the 14 km Cross and the 7 km Mini, offering a trail-running experience in the natural landscape of the capital of thermal waters. This is the event’s 13th edition, bringing together running and nature enthusiasts in a friendly, active setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater)
14 km Cross course
7 km Mini course
additional: The event promotes outdoor exercise, a healthy lifestyle, and respect for nature. Start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Free entry. Outdoor trail-running terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

description: Baneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail running race in Băneasa Forest, Cluj-Napoca, offering an authentic nature experience. The event includes four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run for families. The race is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced, and focuses on the joy of running in the forest. Organized by a passionate team, the event also offers training plans and group training sessions to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest
Four races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Group training sessions with different paces and coordinators
additional: Group training sessions with different paces and coordinators. Training plans for all levels. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through Asociația Magic and Zi de Bine. A trail course with uneven terrain, roots, dirt roads, and forest paths; options for family and children's races; training sessions available.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that brings the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands to life through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances for beginners, experienced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with breathtaking views and challenges. This event combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature to create an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: 95K ultralong distance featuring challenging and scenic mountain trails
Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for the 12K and 20K distances
additional: The race offers distances from 6K to 95K, suitable for runners of different levels. There is a special race for children: DECATHLON Kids Run. A prize draw is held every month for registered participants. Multiple distances, mountain running, prize draw registration, children's race

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The Yordanka Arizanova Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament takes place at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes, who honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.
course_highlights: Events at Plovdiv Stadium
Events: 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 400 m hurdles
Traditionally attracts accomplished sprinters and runners
additional: The competition includes starts for children in the morning and for senior athletes in the afternoon. The winners are presented with awards by Yordanka Arizanova’s daughter, Angelina Petrova-Hristova. The tournament is annual and takes place at Plovdiv Stadium; it includes the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 400 m hurdles, with awards presented to the winners.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra is a mountain running event that brings the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands to life through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances for beginners, experienced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with impressive views and challenges. The unique Night Trail 6K and the DECATHLON Kids Run complete the program, turning the event into a true celebration of sporting spirit and love of nature. Organized by DECATHLON Plovdiv, the race promises excellent organization and unforgettable experiences in the beautiful area of Shiroka Laka, Smolyan.
course_highlights: 95K ultralong distance with challenging and scenic courses
Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for the 12K and 20K distances
additional: Every month, DECATHLON gives prizes to registered participants through a raffle. The event includes distances for all ages, from the 6K night run to the 95K ultra. The organizer is DECATHLON Plovdiv, with an excellent rating for organization. Courses for various distances, mountain running, raffle registration, children's race

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km circular race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s Memorial House and winds through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past forest streams and waterfalls, to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then passes through Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethnographic complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish line is located. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.
course_highlights: A 25 km circular course with 1,000 m of total elevation gain
Runs through the centuries-old Monastery Forests and past forest streams and waterfalls
Visits the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery and the Miličin Konak ethnographic complex
additional: A trail race focused on nature and cultural heritage. Participation is part of an international competition, and the race is intended for a wide range of runners.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: A 6.4 km main race in the outdoors
Children’s races with around 40 participants
A race in the natural surroundings of Mali Stapar
additional: Participants ranged in age from elementary school children to competitors over 70. The race is part of a sporting tradition and a prelude to larger sporting events in the region, such as the Friendship Race in Kula. It takes place in natural surroundings, with a focus on promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting camaraderie among participants of different age groups.

name: IX. TISZA-TAVI PROHUMAN ÖSSZEFUTÁS
description: The 9th Tisza-tavi Prohuman Run Together is a friendly, family-oriented running race in Sarud, on the shores of Lake Tisza. The event aims to let participants enjoy the beauty of nature and the joy of sport on a varied, well-marked route. The race is held in the spirit of recreational sport and community, and is open to all ages. Runners can complete the distances in the picturesque surroundings of Lake Tisza while becoming part of a close-knit running community.
course_highlights: Running route along the shore of Lake Tisza
Varied terrain close to nature
Family-friendly, community atmosphere
additional: Registration is required to take part in the race. The entry fee includes a technical T-shirt, medal, timing, and lunch. The deadline is April 20, 2026.

name: V. Kastélykör Flow 5 / 10 / 20
location: Károlyi kastély és kert, Füzérradvány, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The V. Kastélykör Flow running race is a family-friendly recreational event held in the scenic grounds of Károlyi Castle and its garden, in the Natura 2000 protected area in Füzérradvány. The race offers varied distances for all ages, with adult 5, 10 and 20 km loops as well as shorter children’s distances. Runners follow the castle garden’s famous paths, and running with a dog is also permitted under specific rules. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, and participants can use a range of amenities, including bag storage, a changing tent and restrooms.
course_highlights: 5 km loop with approximately 120 m of elevation gain
80% gravel paths, 20% forest dirt tracks
Run through the English garden of the Natura 2000 protected Károlyi Castle
additional: Running with a dog is permitted, but dogs must be on a leash or secured in a harness. Veterinary health books will be checked, and runners with dogs start after the rest of the field; their times are not included in the results. Trophies are awarded to the women’s and men’s podium finishers in each age group, with special prizes for the youngest, oldest and dog-running participants. Immediate online results and a finish-line video are provided. Parking is available in designated areas at the castle, with bag storage, a changing tent and restrooms on site. The race takes place within the Natura 2000 area; parking is permitted in the lots around the castle garden, and the event supports environmental protection and the local community.

description: Zsámbék Run is a family-friendly running race offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.2 km). The route passes through Zsámbék and Tök on paved and gravel roads, while the second half of the half marathon is a trail run in the Nyakas Hill area. The varied course offers beautiful views and several refreshment points. The event aims to help everyone find a distance that suits them while enjoying the natural beauty of the Zsámbék Basin.
course_highlights: Varied route on paved roads, gravel, and forest trails
5 refreshment points on the half-marathon course and 3 on the 10 km course
Beautiful views from Nyakas Hill and across the Zsámbék Basin
additional: The starts are staggered, but because the courses share an initial section, faster runners may catch up with slower ones. The race offers chip timing and a unique finisher medal. The entry fee includes a race number, medical services, and a finisher's gift. The participant limit is 550. Entries may be cancelled or transferred, and distances may be changed by email before specified deadlines. The course runs on firm surfaces throughout, with short cobblestone and gravel sections. Several refreshment points offer runners water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and biscuits. The race will take place on May 31 at Piactér, Zsámbék. Its main goal is to promote sport and tourism among participants.

name: KASTÉLYKÖR FLOW
organizer: Laktát Sport Team és Kállai Krisztina
description: The V. Kastélykör Flow is a charming running event in Füzérradvány, around Károlyi Castle. The race combines enjoying nature with the castle’s historic surroundings, making it an ideal choice for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is organised by Laktát Sport Team and Kállai Krisztina, who warmly welcome participants on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Run through and around the beautiful grounds of Károlyi Castle
Varied terrain close to nature
Cultural and historic surroundings
additional: The race takes place at Károlyi Castle. Registration is required, and detailed information is available on the Facebook event page.

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with varied climbs and descents
Beautiful natural views around the village of Zhelyava
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event is part of a series of trail races held in Bulgaria and is aimed at amateurs and professionals who want to test themselves in mountain conditions.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking competition in the cross-country marathon (XCM) discipline, held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying distances and elevation gain, suited to different categories of competitors, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes cross scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for moderately and well-prepared cyclists.
course_highlights: Murgash Epic – 62 km with 2,505 m of elevation gain
Murgash Classic – 40 km with 1,348 m of elevation gain
Zhelyava Trail – an iconic section with a 9.9 km climb
additional: The race includes junior boys’ and girls’ categories in different age groups, as well as an e-bike category with assistance up to 25 km/h. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes. Multiple routes of varying distances and elevation gain are suitable for different fitness levels, including an e-bike category.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
price_range: 8.000 dinara po timu (1.600 dinara po članu)
description: The charity IT race “Relay with Heart” will take place on June 5, 2026, at Niš Fortress. The event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, lead an active lifestyle, and give back to the community in the fortress’s beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at historic Niš Fortress
A charitable atmosphere and spirit of community
Bringing the IT community together through sport
additional: Registration is open, and all proceeds will be donated to Nurdor to improve accommodation facilities for parents of children with cancer. The event also includes a post-race music gathering in the garden of the Mountaineers’ Lodge.

name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain cycling and running competition set in the spectacular landscape of the Măcin Mountains. The courses offer a range of difficulty levels, from technical and demanding routes for experienced cyclists to more accessible routes for amateurs. The event emphasizes safety, fair play, and fun, making it suitable for outdoor sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and sporting challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers provide a well-organized and friendly experience.
course_highlights: The 54 km long course with 1,700 m of elevation gain is technical and difficult, with spectacular climbs and descents
The 32 km short course with 600 m of elevation gain is easy to moderately technical, with an approximately 6 km climb and a long 9 km descent
The 23 km half-marathon course is technical and difficult, while the 12 km cross-country course is easy to moderately technical and suitable for trail runners
additional: Registration is exclusively online from 1 March to 4 June 2026. Participants under 18 must present a statement signed by a parent or guardian. The courses are not artificially prepared and offer a variety of technical and physical challenges. Registration is confirmed after payment of the fee, which can be made by card or bank transfer. The organizers recommend following safety and fair-play rules on the course. Participants must have the required equipment, including a bicycle in good working order and a helmet. Registration is online, with the registration period running from 1 March to 4 June 2026. The event includes categories for different age groups and teams, as well as a corporate race.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Dušan Milošević, the first Serbian Olympian, and follows the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, with the aim of honoring his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. There are three courses: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more demanding Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and togetherness.
course_highlights: The Vihor course runs above Stragari, with views of Bukulja, Kosmaj, Avala, and the Ramać heights
The Rudnik course follows genuine trail paths and forest roads, with steep climbs and descents
There are 2 aid stations with food and drinks on the Vihor course, and 4 on the Rudnik course
additional: The Domaćinska course is a non-competitive event for those who do not want to race, and the race takes place on June 6. It is organized by the “Dušan Milošević - First Serbian Olympian” Association as a tribute to his courage and place in history. Three courses: 5 km Domaćinska (non-competitive), start and finish in Stragari, support organization, safe conditions, and a sporting and recreational character.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: Kup Fruške Gore 2026 is a traditional sporting, competitive and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of routes, including an ultra extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, a medium eastern marathon and novice routes, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and an opportunity to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide organized transport to the start, as well as extensive support throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points
Medium eastern marathon with 3 ITRA points
Novice routes with 1–2 ITRA points
additional: Organized transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is available from 6 a.m. on Saturday. On-site registration for the FUN routes is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packs are collected before the race. The event is supported by numerous patrons and sponsors. It includes various sporting challenges and outdoor activities, with opportunities for both recreational runners and competitors. Details about registration and programs will be available soon.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition bringing together elite and junior riders in men’s and women’s categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel in the beautiful setting of Andrevlje, it lasts four days, offering a fantastic atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked courses, and a generous race package with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines sporting passion with Serbia’s natural beauty.
course_highlights: Fully marked course with GPS navigation
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish
Electronic timing and a chip-equipped race number
additional: The race package includes a chip-equipped race number, electronic timing, an official race T-shirt for registrations received by 15.03.2026., a finisher medal, on-site support from the OTIS team, 3 professional photographers with free photos, a downloadable GPS track, and online results. The race time limit is 3 hours. Race-pack collection is from 09:00 to 11:30, and the awards ceremony is at 15:00. Participation includes electronic timing, bike washing, medical support, and parking; registration is open; the event lasts four days and features different races.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
location: Győr, Rónay Jácint u., Győr-Moson-Sopron, Hungary
description: The XXIV Büchl Night Run will take place on June 6, 2026, in Győr, at Tulipános Primary School. The event offers several distances, including a children’s race, individual 7, 14 and 21 km races, a three-person half-marathon relay, and 7 km Nordic walking. Runners receive a unique finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments and medical support. The courses are clearly marked and supported by police. Race packs are available to participants in the longer-distance races, and registration is confirmed once payment has been made by bank transfer.
course_highlights: Clearly marked route with course marshals and police support
7 km route on a designated loop through Sziget, the city centre and Révfalu
14 km and 21 km routes comprising two and three laps, respectively
additional: Registration is confirmed once the entry fee has been paid by bank transfer. On-site collection of race numbers in advance is available at two times: June 5, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00, and June 6, 2026, from 9:00 to 12:00, at 51 Dózsa György Quay. Participants registering on the day are not guaranteed this year’s unique finisher’s medal; medals from previous years will be available only while stocks last. Entry fees are non-refundable, but 50% of the amount paid can be credited toward the entry fee for a future race, following prior arrangement. Awards, race-pack collection and safety services will be available at the event, and participants can transfer or amend their registration. Necessary equipment and support will be provided on site.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
location: Bisinger József park, Győr, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The Büchl Night Half Marathon is a traditional nighttime running event in Győr, offering running enthusiasts several distances, including a children’s race, individual races, and relays. The event hub is Tulipános Primary School, and participants can expect a well-organized event with chip timing, refreshment stations, medical support, and police supervision. Entrants receive a unique finisher’s medal, and a race pack is also provided for the 14 km and 21 km distances. The event aims to offer runners of all ages an enjoyable and safe running experience.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.3 km children’s race; 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km individual races
Three-person half-marathon relay and 7 km Nordic walking distance
Marked route with marshals and police supervision
additional: Advance bib pickup is available at two times: on the day before the race and on race day. Early registrants receive a unique finisher’s medal. Chip timing, a downloadable certificate, refreshment stations, and medical support are provided. Once the entry fee has been paid, registration is final and non-refundable, but 50% of the payment may be credited toward a future race by prior arrangement. The event provides chip timing, a finisher’s medal, refreshments, route marshals, and medical support. Advance registration is recommended.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
location: Majális park, Miskolc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County, Hungary
description: The Bükk Mountain Marathon–Ádám Kisgyörgy Memorial Race is Hungary’s oldest trail marathon. It will take place on June 6, 2026, at Majális Park in Miskolc. The race offers a range of distances, from the marathon to the minimarathon, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. Runners compete amid the scenic natural beauty of the Bükk Mountains, while the race unfolds continuously at the event center, known as the “forest stadium.” The event aims to foster friendships through sport, promote a healthy lifestyle, and showcase the natural values of the Bükk.
course_highlights: Forest roads of varying quality and paved sections in the Bükk Mountains
330 meters of elevation gain per lap on the 10.6 km course
Competitors return to the forest stadium after each lap, allowing spectators to follow the race throughout
additional: The race center is at Miskolc, Majális Park–Királyasztal, where relay team members send their teammates on their way from the forest stadium. The course consists almost entirely of forest roads of varying quality; the marathon time limit is 6 hours. The minimarathon distance can be completed either running or hiking. Competitors return to the race center after each lap, allowing spectators to follow the race throughout. A trail-running race with multiple distances for amateur and professional athletes in a nature-rich setting.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
location: Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő, Cegléd, Pest County, Hungary
description: The 5th Ceglédfürdő Running Festival will take place on June 6, 2026, at the Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Szabadidőközpont. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and introduce people of all ages to the joy of running. Participants can choose from several distances, from a 300-meter toddler race to a half marathon and relay races. Runners can enjoy views of the beautiful lake and the spa as they make their way along the synthetic-surface running track. Related activities, awards, and admission to the spa add to the experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő és Aquapark grounds, along a synthetic-surface running track.
Runners circle the lake several times, with six opportunities to admire the spa.
Music stations and a variety of musical styles add to the running experience.
additional: On race day, the 300 m toddler race and 800 m children's race start at 8:20, the 2 km fun run and leisure walk at 8:40, and all other distances (from 3.5 km to 28 km, as well as relays) at 9:30. The cut-off time for the half marathon and 28 km distance is 2 hours 45 minutes. Participants can change, shower, and use lockers in the beach changing rooms. Runners receive a finisher's pack and medal, as well as admission to Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő on race day. Entry fees are non-refundable if an entry is cancelled, and the fee depends on when payment is made. Payment by bank card or bank transfer is accepted. Participants can choose from several distances in a family-friendly atmosphere, with wellness and leisure activities also on offer. The organizers place particular emphasis on ensuring that everyone enjoys themselves and spends the day actively.

name: Crazy5K
location: Budaörsi Repülőtér, Budaörs, Pest County, Hungary
description: CRAZY5K is a unique 5 km obstacle race featuring 10 enormous inflatable obstacles. The event is about having fun rather than performance, making it a great day out with friends, family or colleagues. A dedicated family race is also available for families with children under 10, with a surprise in store for the kids. The event takes place at Budaörs Airport, where parking is available. The entry fee includes a race bib, T-shirt, finisher’s pack, custom medal, refreshments, use of the bag drop and medical supervision.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 10 huge inflatable obstacles
Fun and playful challenges alongside the run
Family race for children under 10, with a surprise
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, T-shirt (available for collection at the venue), finisher’s pack, custom finisher’s medal, refreshment point, free use of the bag drop, medical supervision, and access to the men’s and women’s changing rooms. Parking is available at the venue for 1000 Ft per car. Obstacles may be bypassed, but for safety reasons participants must go around them in a wide arc. Group entries receive a 10% discount for 10–19 people and a 15% discount for more than 20 people; the discount applies only to participants starting in the same time slot. Entries can be transferred for a modification fee of 2000 Ft per person. On-site transfers are also possible, subject to availability. Inflatable obstacles, family race, fun, registration available

name: MOKÜ Run

The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak

The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Courses of 40 km, 27 km, and 12 km with elevation gains of 2,000, 1,300, and 600 meters
