Participants can choose from several distances, and the organizers send automatic confirmation of registration and payment. Bib production and safety pins are provided, and payment is also possible by card via SimplePay. The race offers several distances and RFID timing, with varied terrain including forest and asphalt sections. Registration takes place on korido.hu.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sport Festival is a traditional community sporting event in Kecskemét, near Benkó Hill. The event promotes recreational exercise and sport, welcoming participants in a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running activities. Alongside running, the festival also features charity events and community activities, bringing sport and social responsibility together. The organizers warmly invite everyone who wants to run to enjoy the pleasures of exercise and the closeness of nature together.
course_highlights: Running route near Benkó Hill in pleasant natural surroundings
Community running events with a family-friendly atmosphere
Charity running programs and additional sporting events
additional: The event also includes charity activities, with proceeds supporting local foundations. There is usually a raffle for runners, and the organizers provide refreshments and food for participants. The event may include ultramarathons, easy runs, and other sporting activities that encourage active participation by the venue and the community.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra-distance event that winds through the scenic vineyards and hills of Tokaj-Hegyalja. The race offers three different distances, giving both beginners and experienced runners the chance to find the challenge that suits them. The event is more than just a running race: it is an experience set amid the landscapes of one of Hungary’s most beautiful wine regions. Races start in mass-start format, and refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra distance through vineyards and hills
Legendary Tokaj-Hegyalja route
Refreshments along the course and at the finish
additional: Both individual and team categories are available, with teams of 2, 3, or 4 members. Starts are mass starts; team start times will be published no later than June 5, 2026. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer. Participants receive a downloadable electronic certificate, and related programs and discounts are also available. Cutoff times: Ultra 8 hours, Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3 hours. Age limits vary by distance, from 12 to 18 years. There are three different distances; registration details have not been provided. The event venue is in the vicinity of Fesztiválkatlan.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: Brutálfutás is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, offering an unforgettable muddy, water-filled experience over distances of 2.3 and 7 kilometres. The race is a mix of a military training course and an obstacle race, with fun and community spirit at its heart. Participants arriving from hundreds of towns and villages across the country can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The race is not about taking things seriously, but about fun and challenge, so everyone can find a distance that suits them.
course_highlights: A mix of a military training course and an obstacle race
Muddy, water-filled 2.3- and 7-kilometre courses
A unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud. The event welcomes participants with online registration, charitable elements and a festival atmosphere. The race offers both challenges and a community experience.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sporting, environmental, and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition, in 2026, celebrates the area’s nature, history, and cultural heritage, offering a variety of routes for runners of all levels. Races include a marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and children’s race, on courses that combine mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes on mountain trails and local roads
A mix of mountain and road running
Natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The event takes place from 19–21 June 2026, with race-kit pickup at Central Square on the day before the race. The programme also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are designed for both mountain and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects, and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race in the Bucegi Mountains, along the Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera route. The event takes place in the first ten days of June, when the landscape is dominated by ridges tinged red with rhododendron. The race offers runners a combination of intensity and natural beauty, and at the finish participants are treated to grilled bulz and jintiță. It is an authentic mountain experience, starting at the Peștera cable car, with a friendly, traditional atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route: Peștera - Vf. Omu - Peștera
Scenery with rhododendron flowers and red-tinged ridges
Participants are treated to grilled bulz and jintiță at the finish
additional: The start area is at the Peștera cable car. The event has been held since 2015. The organizers welcome participants with a warm, traditional atmosphere. Breathtaking mountain routes, start and finish at Peștera, mandatory equipment, cutoff times for the 41 km and 24 km races

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Harghita, Romania
description: Maraton Scaunul Domnului is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Bistra Mureșului. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon with more than 2,100 m of elevation gain, a half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, as well as races for families and children. The marathon route passes through spectacular scenery, with aid and checkpoint stations, and includes sections of forest road, unmarked trails, and lookout areas. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and time limits for each race. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and a bonfire after the race.
course_highlights: A 42 km mountain route with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Spectacular views toward the Călimani Ridge and areas with exposed viewpoints
Multiple aid, hydration, and checkpoint stations along the route
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00, and on Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. Mandatory equipment is checked at the start. Each race has time limits and intermediate checkpoints. Competitor parking is arranged on a forest road 1.3 km from the start/finish area. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00, and the Mini MSD ceremony at 17:00, followed by a bonfire. The event also includes family races and mini races, with registration details available on the official website.

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held amid the spectacular scenery of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is aimed at mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race offers a passionate community and opportunities to socialize and push personal limits. On June 13, 2026, participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of Retezat.
course_highlights: Technical trails along steep ridges and mountain paths
Spectacular scenery of valleys and alpine lakes
Aid stations with water, energy drinks, and fruit
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup are available from 16:00 on the day before the race and between 7:00 and 8:30 on race day. The kit includes a personalized race bib and a technical item for the first 800 participants. Aid stations with water and food are available along the routes. The awards ceremony takes place at 17:30. DJ Cătălin Sănătescu provides the atmosphere throughout the event. There is also a children’s race, Retezat SkyRace Kids Race. Spectacular mountain trails, online registration, categories and prizes, annual event.

name: Maratonul Sării

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Contributia de participare este 200 de lei pentru oricare traseu

description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event combining running and mountain biking, held amid the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in Piața Primăriei. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km stretch through the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and respect for nature, and also includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.
course_highlights: Routes through forests, hills, and the underground galleries of Târgu Ocna Salt Mine
A 7 km underground stretch at a depth of 240 m, with ionized air
Elevation gains: 250 m for 10 km, 740 m for the 21 km trail race, and 800 m for the 30 km mountain-bike race
additional: Start and finish in Piața Primăriei, Târgu Ocna. The mountain-bike race takes place on Sunday, 14 June 2026, and the trail-running races on Saturday, 13 June 2026. Payment is by card only at registration. The event includes plogging activities to clean up the routes. The routes include trail-running and mountain-bike sections; registration is available online, with payment by card.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race set in the picturesque landscapes of Baia Mare and its surroundings on June 13, 2026. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of the Firiza Dam, and areas with impressive panoramas of local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.
course_highlights: A sustained 7–8 km climb with 560 meters of elevation gain
Views of Firiza Dam and Igniș Peak
A spectacular trail along the dam shore with memorable views
additional: GPX files for the routes are available to download. The marathon route includes a 21 km loop through scenic areas such as Limpedea, Groapele Chiuzbăii, and Fântâna cu borcut. There are refreshment and control points along the route, and the routes are marked with distinctive signs. Volunteers guide competitors along shared and branching sections of the routes. The trail routes include mountain terrain, technical trails, and climbs, highlighting the area's natural beauty. Participation includes official materials and access to event facilities.

name: Maraton Tarcău
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area, Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and appropriate equipment, providing a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can collect their race kits the day before the competition and must comply with the official race regulations. Time limits are set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country routes in the Tarcău area, Neamț
Course time limits: 7 hours for the marathon, 4 hours for the half-marathon, and 2 hours for the cross-country race
Race kit provided the day before the competition
additional: Race kits are provided on Friday, June 12, 2026, and participants must sign a liability waiver. A technical briefing is held before the start. Course time limits are: 7 hours for the marathon (start at 9:00), 4 hours for the half-marathon (start at 10:00), and 2 hours for the cross-country race (start at 11:00). Registration takes place on June 12, with a race kit and liability waiver; races have time limits; spectacular mountain routes.

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului (Deda)
location: Rezervația Naturală Scaunul Domnului, aproape de Deda, Mureș, Romania
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, near Deda, Mureș. The event offers several races, including a 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, and races for families and children. The courses combine sustained climbs, forest roads, and sections with spectacular views, making them suitable for mountain runners seeking adventure and nature. Safety is a priority, with mandatory gear checks and checkpoints along the course.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Sections with spectacular views of the Călimani Ridge
Multiple aid stations and checkpoints, including on the Scaunul Domnului Plateau
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00 and on Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. The main races start at 09:00, while the Family and Mini races start at 09:15. Gear checks are mandatory for safety. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, followed by a campfire. Competitor parking is provided in a specially designated area beside the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the locality of Bistra Mureșului. Mountain trails, registration details, and the event schedule; registration closes on June 6, 2026.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is an outdoor running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sporting competition: it is a call to live life fully in body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message of direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes “the place of encounter,” where sport, community, and faith meet in an authentic way that is relevant to today’s generation.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the Bistrița area, set in nature
Half marathon for experienced runners
Accessible 5 km and 10 km races for all levels
additional: The event includes races for children (Cross Kids). Technical details and course maps will be updated on the website at a later date. Event T-shirts are provided, with a size guide. Trail running in nature, promoting health, community, and faith, with multiple race categories for all ages.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championships for under-14 athletes in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents the opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Events at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo
Classic track and field events for under-14 athletes
Two-day format with more than 300 participants from across the country
additional: Held at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo, the event is part of the national sports calendar for 2026.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Otvad Mosta is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech, combining a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants pass over four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It is an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.
course_highlights: Crossing four iconic bridges in Lovech
Muddy and rocky trails on the Devetashko Plateau
Historical landmarks such as the Kakrina Inn and Hisarya Fortress
additional: Registration is available online or in person on certain days. During the last two weeks before the event, registration is available with restrictions: no personalized race bib, and merchandise is available in on-site sizes. The fee is determined by the time of payment. A medical examination is not required for the 5 km run. Included are aid stations with food and drinks, a finisher’s medal, product prizes, and discount vouchers from partners. Duathlon: 40 km cross-country cycling + 12 km running; charity campaign; historical routes; nature views.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 метра, 3000 метра, 1500 метра, 0.8 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km, 0.1 km
description: The “Nikola Valchanov” athletics tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprints and shot put, for age groups ranging from under-14s to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and begins with an official opening at 11:00.
course_highlights: Events at Aprilov Stadium in Gabrovo
17 events, including sprints and shot put
Participation across age groups, from under-14s to men and women
additional: The tournament’s official opening is at 11:00 at Aprilov Stadium. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event features events for different age groups. The tournament includes 17 events, with participants from 23 clubs, and has a record number of over 170 athletes.

name: Sunrise Marathon
location: Bačka Palanka, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka is an event that supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children facing this illness through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.
course_highlights: Enjoy a drive through the beautiful natural surroundings of Bačka Palanka
A choice of race distances (marathon, half marathon, 10K, 5K)
Support charitable causes for children with cancer
additional: Race participants can join Team Sunrise and receive a personalized fundraising page, a Team Sunrise T-shirt, and tools for collecting donations. Registration is handled directly through the race organizer, and participants arrange their own travel. Charity race bibs are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is often linked to charitable donations and fundraising for children with cancer; registration details and dates are available from the organizer.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its untouched nature and crystal-clear water. The course runs through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural splendor and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Gradac River canyon, with its crystal-clear water
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky banks, and stream crossings
Abundant wildlife and the natural beauty of an untouched landscape
additional: The race is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia. It is inspired by the otter, a symbol of vitality and playfulness. No specific information was found about the race start time, registration, or prices. This trail race features varied terrain along the Gradac River and focuses on natural beauty and adventure. It takes place in June 2026.

name: 9. Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series of events held in the beautiful natural landscapes of western Serbia. The race offers 10 km and 19 km courses that run alongside the Gradac River, one of the cleanest rivers in Europe, known for its unspoiled nature. Participants have the opportunity to experience Serbia’s unspoiled nature, running through forested and mountainous areas that are often accessible only to pedestrians. This event is ideal for running and nature enthusiasts who want to test their abilities in an authentic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km and 19 km courses
Running alongside the Gradac River with its clear waters
Unspoiled nature and mountain scenery accessible only to pedestrians
additional: The organizers provide refreshments along the course, with drinks and snacks at several points. Comfortable sportswear suitable for running in nature is recommended. The event is part of a series of races and hiking tours held throughout the year in western Serbia. Trail running and hiking in the scenic landscapes of western Serbia, with experiences of local culture and nature.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 trail-running race will take place in the scenic surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya on June 14, 2026. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild landscapes of the Sopron Hills. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km and 25.9 km. One of the distances is part of the Alpokalja Trail King running series. The race also offers a special extra challenge: a timed uphill section, with special prizes for the fastest male and female runners. Race headquarters will be at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Centre, which has toilets and showers.
course_highlights: Wild, scenic trails in the Sopron Hills
A separate timed uphill section on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km courses
Aid stations on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km courses; cups will not be provided for environmental reasons
additional: The start and finish are on Brennbergbánya’s main square. The awards ceremony is scheduled for Sunday at 12:30 at the finish. Showers and toilets/WC are available at race headquarters. Cups will not be provided at aid stations for environmental reasons, so runners are advised to bring their own bottle or cup. Registration is through e-nevezés, with a deadline of June 13, 2026, at 12:00. Challenging uphill sections receive special awards; registration is online through the E-nevezés system; the organizers use environmentally friendly solutions.

name: Lussonium Trail 1 / 5 / 14
description: Lussonium Trail is a family-friendly trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering wonderful panoramas and challenging climbs. The race has a friendly, cheerful atmosphere where runners can meet again year after year. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal, but it is also possible to register without a medal. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and redeem them for rewards. The start area is at the Lussonium Roman Ruins, where parking, toilets, a playground, and a first-aid point are available.
course_highlights: Wonderful panoramas among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging climbs and varied terrain
Impressive start/finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Ruins
additional: The race will be held if there are at least 100 registrants. Entries are capped at 400, including a maximum of 100 preschool and lower-primary-school children. Parking, toilets, a playground, and a first-aid point are available on site. The finish medals can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program. The race takes place at the Lussonium Roman Ruins in Dunakömlőd and offers sporting opportunities for families and individual runners alike.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a trail-running event offering a variety of distances in the picturesque surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race features four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), middle (13.5 km) and mountain half marathon (21.7 km), each starting with a 1 km lead-in lap in the castle park. The courses cross varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and participants can refuel at aid stations. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and the organizers pay particular attention to runners’ safety and medical care.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 7 km, 13.5 km, 21.7 km (mountain half marathon)
Significant elevation gain: 85 m+ on the mini course, 595 m+ on the mountain half marathon
Two aid stations on the course; three aid stations on the mountain half marathon. Bringing your own soft cup is recommended.
additional: The race has two starts: the Mountain Half Marathon at 9:00 and the School, Mini, Short and Middle distances at 9:30. Mountain half marathon participants must use their own soft cup at the aid stations. The race uses electronic timing, and the rescue system is supported by off-road vehicles and medical staff. Registration is via SPORTNAPTAR.HU; pre-registration opens on December 6, 2025. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Multiple distances, aid stations, medical services, parking, car-free start/finish area.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: Lussonium Trail is a trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning views, tough climbs and an impressive start/finish venue. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, with participants of all ages able to test themselves over several distances. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined together with the Feldwar Trail medal, but a lower-priced entry without a medal is also available. The event is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid station are available at the venue.
course_highlights: Stunning views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Tough climbs on the trails
An impressive start and finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Garden
additional: The race will be held if there are at least 100 entrants, and entries are accepted for a maximum of 400 people, including a maximum of 100 preschool- and primary-school-aged children. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid station are available at the venue. The finisher medals can be joined together with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Several distances, family and children’s categories, hilly trails, medals and refreshments are available to participants.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race taking place on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Șoseaua Kiseleff. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The courses are accessible and beginner-friendly, with an energetic atmosphere full of fun and solidarity, where every kilometer run contributes to a worthy cause. Participants receive superhero-themed race kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners
A dedicated route accessible to people with disabilities
A welcoming atmosphere for families, children, and pets
additional: The race kit includes an official T-shirt, superhero cape, themed accessories, a goodie bag, a race bib, and a medal. Medical assistance and hydration stations are available along the route. The event offers dedicated areas for families, children, pets, and people with disabilities, as well as secure bag storage, a security team, and volunteers to provide guidance. After the race, participants can enjoy sports and wellness activities, children's workshops, themed photo booths, and relaxation areas. Charity event, recreational activities, areas for families and children, kits with T-shirts and accessories, hydration and first-aid stations.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is Romania’s largest multi-sport event, held in Cluj-Napoca from June 11 to 14, 2026. The festival combines sporting competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. The Superheroes Run, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause and support the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, fans, and sports enthusiasts in a festive, friendly setting.
course_highlights: Superheroes Run: 5 km and 10 km races on dedicated courses
The Via Transilvanica route, a long-distance tourist trail with markers and sculpted mileposts
Sports events and demonstrations in Prof. Dr. Iuliu Hațieganu Sports Park
additional: Taking part in the Superheroes Run supports the Via Transilvanica social project, with part of the entry fee donated to the community. The festival includes areas for children, a food zone with healthy menus, concerts, and dance demonstrations. Participants receive a race kit, and the event promotes sport as a way of life and social engagement. The event features activities for all ages, sporting competitions, and support for social causes.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy a ride outdoors or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully planned to protect the natural environment, and markings will be limited to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a reserve date.
course_highlights: Route carefully marked to protect forests and natural areas
Route markings will be shared in the Participant Guide during event week
Start location accessible via Google Maps
additional: The event is limited to 1,000 starting places. The reserve race date is June 20, 2026. Children aged 5 to 13 must have a personal account on the Riders Club platform and be registered; they are recommended to be accompanied on the route. Families receive a 20% discount for a minimum of 3 people. E-MTB races allow electric bikes with motors that provide pedal assistance only, with a single battery for the entire race. Advance registration is required. The event is open to all experience levels, with the option to compete in electric races and prizes for participants.

name: Triglav Skyrun
location: село Тъжа, Национален парк Централен Балкан, България
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes an ascent of Golyam Kadamliya (2,275.4 m), the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains. The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event for lovers of mountain running and nature combines a challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sokolna Reserve, with its pristine nature
Ascent of Golyam Kadamliya Peak — 2,275.4 m
Passage through three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
additional: The race starts in the village of Tazha. There are three distances with different start times: 7:30 for 34K, 8:30 for 20K, and 9:00 for 12K. Race packs can be collected both on the evening before the race and on race day, from 6:00 until 15 minutes before the start. The awards ceremony begins at 14:00. All winners receive a singlet bearing the race logo. A designer singlet can be ordered during registration. Participants under 18 may enter only the 12K and 20K, with a parental consent form. Refunds are available until 30.04.2026, subject to a 20% fee; no refunds are available after that date. The organizers are looking for volunteers to help with the event. Courses: 12K, 20K, 34K; registration is open until the limit of 300 places is reached; designer singlets can be ordered during registration; the event includes social events and a camping option.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment in nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in a beautiful and inspiring setting.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on natural terrain
Scenic views of the Belogradchik Rocks
A unique atmosphere of freedom and smiles

name: У Царството на ТрибАлете
description: The mountain race “In the Kingdom of the TribAlletes” is a unique event in the heart of the Vratsa Balkan, offering a challenging 12.7 km distance with almost 1,000 metres of elevation gain. The course passes through beautiful natural landmarks such as Borov Kamak Waterfall and the peaks of Dudil and Buk, combining tough climbs with technical descents. The race is for those who appreciate natural beauty and mountain running, and prizes are placed along the course, including special surprises from the heart. Organized by BG Events & Guiding, it is part of a series of events promoting Northwest Bulgaria as a destination for sport and tourism.
course_highlights: 12.7 km with almost 1,000 m of elevation gain
Passes beneath Borov Kamak Waterfall, which is over 70 m high
Technical, steep descent from Buk Peak, with views of the Vratsa Balkan and the Iskar Gorge
additional: The start is at the entrance to the Borov Kamak eco-trail, and the finish is in the pine forest. The first 5 km are the toughest, with the biggest climb. Prizes are placed along the course. Register by calling 0878 259 772. The course features waterfalls, climbs, descents, technical sections, and natural beauty.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
price_range: 50 € donacija po disciplini, startnina 50 € za strane državljane, smeštaj od 30-50 € po noći
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The event features several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, with the start and finish at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathoners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the event offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.
course_highlights: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races
50 km and 100 km races
Start and finish at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: Accommodation is arranged in hotels and motels, with a shared tent also available for competitors who do not need overnight accommodation. A well-stocked aid station is available during the race, followed by a communal lunch for all participants. Prizes are awarded in the overall and age categories, including special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants. The event includes recreational training sessions, competitions and the promotion of ultramarathoning in the region, and takes place in June 2026.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
location: Kula, South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continuously improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.
course_highlights: Promotes sport and friendship
Large-scale regional event
Long-standing tradition since 2009
additional: The Friendship Race is the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula and brings together runners from across the region. The organizers are committed to continuously improving the event and the running community. The Kula Running League is a related activity that brings runners together throughout the year and has a significant history and number of participants. Participants can run on a 5 km or 10 km course, with special safety measures in place during the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization also includes support with registration locations and transport from Belgrade.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 1st Midsummer Night Run is a night-time running festival in the Lakeside Park in Balatonszárszó, held on Midsummer’s Eve. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the shore of Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes families and community sports enthusiasts as well as runners. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers the opportunity to collect points for valuable rewards.
course_highlights: Night running along the shore of Lake Balaton
400 m children’s race on a traffic-free route in Lakeside Park
Refreshment point at approximately 2.6 km on the 5.25 km course
additional: Race number collection starts at 10:00 in Lakeside Park. Relay handovers take place at the finish arch by passing on the chip-equipped race number; using a race number belt is recommended. The entry fee includes refreshments (dextrose tablets, biscuits, salted pretzels, mineral water, squash, and gummy sweets). Balatonszárszó residents receive a 30% discount, and a season discount is also available based on previous participation. A technical T-shirt can be purchased separately (8,500 HUF). The event supports the Ötpróba program and offers discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running options and prizes.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Szent László Trail Run is a traditional trail-running race in the Gerecse Mountains, near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint Ladislaus, the patron saint of the infantry and the firearms branch. It has taken place regularly since 2010, with only one cancellation, in 2013, due to flooding. Runners test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly routes. This friendly community event is recommended for anyone interested in both nature and sport.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Gerecse Mountains
Forest trails and hilly sections
A scenic, challenging course close to nature
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which has several departments, including athletics and triathlon, orienteering, hiking, sport shooting, and other sports. The race is traditionally held in June, and the 2026 edition will be the 16th. Maps and past results are available to competitors on the organizer’s website. Mountain trail running, annual event, multiple distances and categories; detailed information is not provided

description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race set amid the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique vertical running experience and an intense descent. It is Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs while the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course, with 1,833 m of elevation gain, tests runners’ endurance and technique across forest roads, woodland trails and alpine pastures. The event is for those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, with one partner climbing while the other descends
Varied terrain: forest roads, logging roads, trails through deciduous and coniferous forests, and alpine pasture
additional: A revolutionary awards system with individual and team rankings, cash prizes for teams, and bonuses for individual performances. The race kit includes a personalized race number (for early registrations), a finisher’s medal engraved in stone, a superlight technical singlet for the first 300 registrants, aid and hydration stations, medical support, and access to educational sessions and workshops. Parking is available for 360 cars. Payment is by bank card only, and registration is valid only after full payment. The event includes race-kit pickup, tent accommodation and accommodation suggestions, as well as the race start and awards ceremony on race day.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Târnava Marathon is a trail-running event organized by the Târnăveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnăveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature, aiming to improve environmental education and raise awareness of the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition offers several trail-running courses for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of athletes passionate about running and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail-running courses: half marathon 21 km, 10 km cross-country race, 4 km cross-country race, and Kids Trail Running
Event held in the Transylvania region, surrounded by nature
additional: Race kits can be collected on the day before and on race day, on the premises of the Ruck Ventilatoare factory. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Children’s races are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Gulaș Party, a concert, and an awards ceremony. Participants can choose from the 21 km, 10 km, and 4 km courses, as well as children’s races, with activities including kit collection, races, and awards ceremonies.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The courses include a 14 km Cross with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain and a Half Marathon of approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain. Participants receive a race kit, access to hydration points, and medical support. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.
course_highlights: Cross course: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, sustained climbs, and technical descents
Half Marathon course: approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, offering an additional challenge
Spectacular scenery and hydration points along the route
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the base of Lake Firiza. The routes are marked with ribbons, signs, and paint. The race kit includes a chip-equipped bib, T-shirt, medal, access to refreshment points, medical support, and a guide. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. The courses are on mountain terrain. Registration closes on June 9, 2026. Participation includes a kit with a bib, T-shirt, medal, and hydration points. The event takes place on June 20, 2026.

description: The Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the shady trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. Organizers Runners Club promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Held in June, the race swaps urban asphalt for nature and offers an outdoor running experience.
course_highlights: Route along the shady trails of Hoia Forest
15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, plus a family race
Outdoor event in a natural setting
additional: The registration package includes a race bib and other benefits. Awards are presented by category. The event is organized by Runners Club, which supports free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The event takes place in Hoia Forest, with online registration and medals for participants. The route includes natural trails and is suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
location: Centrul istoric al Roșia Montană, Alba, Romania
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both trail runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Kids’ Race, which follows age-appropriate routes in the town’s historic center. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.
course_highlights: Varied routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
Natural scenery in the Apuseni Mountains and Roșia Montană’s historic architectural heritage
The Kids’ Race follows age-appropriate routes in the historic center
additional: The Kids’ Race has different routes depending on age, from 700 m for children aged 0–10 (with a parent/guardian required for ages 0–6) to 2.3 km for children aged 13–16. The start and finish are in Piața Centrală in Roșia Montană. The event also includes other races: Marathon 42.16 km, Half Marathon 25.2 km, and 10 km Cross-Country Race. Race kits can be collected in Piața Centrală the day before, and the program also includes cultural activities and concerts. The Kids’ Race includes three different routes (700 m, 1.3 km, and 2.3 km), with prizes and medals for participants. The event takes place on June 21, 2026, in the commune’s historic center, and promotes the area’s cultural and ecological values.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The 16th Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, singing, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folk performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances by traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunities to take part in or observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants submit applications through an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, covering different folk genres in a competitive format. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO to provide advisory services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from across Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities to exchange traditions.

description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Kosmaj mountain, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and breathtaking views. The race is a great opportunity for an outing and socializing in the race village located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages; participants under 18 need parental consent. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.
course_highlights: Trails through the dense forests of Kosmaj mountain
Beautiful viewpoints and natural landscapes
A race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 1,000. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but participation can be gifted or transferred to the following year. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. The race is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Registration is open until June 10, 2025. The start is scheduled for 08:00 in the morning, and the race takes place near the monument to the Kosmaj Partisan Detachment. Participants will be able to enjoy nature and visit local attractions after the race.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances suited to skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience amid Bulgaria’s natural scenery, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site
Stunning views and a skyrunning course
A range of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points, respectively, from a previous race are required to register. Registration and gear checks are mandatory and take place at designated times before the start. Transport to the start area is provided for the 25 km distance. The awards ceremony takes place at Central Square in Bansko. A multi-distance race featuring an ultramarathon and mountain routes, with exceptional natural views.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop of around 5 km with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose from three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop of around 5 km
Held in Vrana Park, on the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation gain along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is one loop of around 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The minimal elevation gain makes it suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and offers different distances. It is held in Vrana Park, Sofia.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
location: Паметник 'Създатели на българската държава', Шумен, Шумен, Bulgaria
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park, with the start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Veloclub Ilchov Bair, the event includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Courses in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park with varied terrain
Start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State
Includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running
additional: Registration and race number pickup take place on 21.06.2026 from 06:00 to 08:00 and from 16:00 to 20:00 at the information center next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State. Wearing a helmet and gloves is mandatory for cyclists. For eMTB participants, bicycles must meet EU requirements, with a speed limit of 25 km/h and a power limit of 250 W. The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on site.

name: Noćni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most attended races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is the 42 km marathon, which demands dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich experience on the course and after the race.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Novi Sad
A 42.2 km marathon as the main event
A half marathon with mass participation and a unique atmosphere
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. Participants receive a technical shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, and a post-race massage. Registration is available only through the trka.rs portal; registration on race day is not allowed. Participants under 18 cannot enter the marathon, and parental consent is required for the mini-marathon and half marathon. The event includes several race distances and a Nordic walk, with registration through the trka.rs platform. It is scheduled for late June 2026, with registration and program details available on the official website.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the opportunity to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the natural surroundings of Ovčar Banja
Three categories: 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
A challenging and varied running route
additional: The event is connected with local cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty, and takes place within Ovčar Banja’s broader tourism and sporting setting.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are designed for all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to protecting the environment through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses through Tornik’s natural landscapes in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging Race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles suited to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Competitor registration is on Friday from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 09:00. The Plogging Race combines running with an environmental cleanup activity. Registration is required for the children’s races, and participation is free. All participants receive race T-shirts and medals, while the top finishers receive gift packages. Trail and environmental activities, multiple course distances, a children’s obstacle race, registration required for the children’s race, date: 27.06.2026.

An organized aid station and post-race massage

The race includes participant packs, medals, aid stations with water and fruit, and rules for fair and safe competition.

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, taking place at the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can compete in quarter-marathon, half-marathon, pairs and trios, while enjoying the city’s magical nighttime atmosphere. Thousands of runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack. The race starts at 21:00 on the evening of June 27, 2026, giving runners the chance to experience running amid the city lights.
course_highlights: Run through Budapest’s historic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
A night run through the illuminated city, with a special play of light and shadow
Join thousands of runners and receive a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race with a voluntary entry fee, held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they may also run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is in Dióskert, in a natural setting
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to run fewer
A friendly, family atmosphere, with a voluntary entry fee per lap
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 Ft per lap. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The half-marathon is 4 laps; runners can do fewer laps. Registration is on site. Refreshments and commemorative medals.

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodnei Mountains, in the Borșa area of Maramureș. The event offers three distinct courses suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor course, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău course, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta course, a fast route with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and focuses on the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to enjoy an active weekend outdoors.
course_highlights: Puzdrelor course: 29.5 km with 2200 m of elevation gain, recommended for experienced runners
Gărgălău course: 21 km with 1300-1500 m of elevation gain, suitable for well-prepared but less experienced runners
Musceta course: 16 km with 500 m of ascent and 1500 m of descent, a fast and technical route
additional: The race takes place in Borșa, in the Rodnei Mountains, a mountainous area with spectacular scenery and a tradition of mountain sports. There are several accommodation options near the start, from guesthouses to campsites, between 190 m and 17.6 km from the start. The courses combine marked and unmarked trails, forest roads, and steep slopes, offering an authentic mountain-running experience. The race is part of the Carpathians Mountain Running Circuit. The mountain course requires a mandatory equipment check and starts at the base of the Borșa gondola. GPX downloads and information about accommodation and registration are available. Entry fees include hydration stations, photos, goulash, and parking access.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
location: Piața Primăriei Sinaia, Sinaia, Prahova County, Romania
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through picturesque areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a race number, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.
course_highlights: Mountain route with climbs up to Cota 1000 and Cota 1400
Passes through tourist areas marked with red and yellow trail markers
Start and finish in Sinaia Town Hall Square, on Bd. Carol
additional: Race kits can be collected in person only, upon presentation of an identity document. The time limit for completing the 10K route is 4.5 hours, and for the 21K it is 6 hours. Minors aged 14 to 18 may participate only when accompanied by an adult and with written consent. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for 50 RON, while the special children’s T-shirt is free. Only participants with a valid race number, officials, and authorized personnel are allowed on the route. The routes feature varied mountain terrain, with details about the races and cultural and historical attractions in the area, such as Peleș Castle and Sinaia Monastery.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the energy of the city, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course in the heart of Cluj-Napoca
Races for children with distances adapted to their ages
International and Romanian elite athletes
additional: Children’s races take place on Saturday, June 27, and adult and elite races on Sunday, June 28. Children’s distances: 800 m (ages 6–9), 1,200 m (ages 10–13), 3,000 m (ages 13–15). Amateur races: 5 km (minimum age 14), 10 km (minimum age 16). The event is organized by the team behind Brașov Running Festival. All participants in the children’s races receive medals and surprises. The event includes children’s races, open categories, and an international elite competition with a World Athletics label; it takes place in Cluj-Napoca and promotes urban running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: The Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from children aged 3 to seniors aged 78, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses, as well as special races for little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances, making for a day dedicated to health, community and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania and UHU Romania.
course_highlights: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses in Mioveni’s Civic Center
Special “DINO” races for children
A vibrant atmosphere with music, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances
additional: The event includes raffles with prizes and surprises for participants, provided by sponsors such as UHU and WD-40. Participants include both adults and children; the youngest runner was 3 years old, and the oldest was 78. Courses of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, races for children, an event promoting health and sport, and support from sponsors TEMAD, WD-40 and UHU Romania.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Hoia Forest, Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run on cool forest trails. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, foster a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race is a great opportunity to trade urban pavement for fresh air and the beautiful scenery of the forest.
course_highlights: Routes along cool trails in Hoia Forest
A range of races: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and the family race
An event suitable for all ages and running levels
additional: The registration package includes a technical T-shirt and race bib. Prizes are awarded to winners in each race. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. Route along the trails of Hoia Forest; online registration; the fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
location: Centrul civic, Mioveni, Argeș County, Romania
description: The Mioveni City Cross-Country Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus România, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in support of the values of honor and respect, in a friendly and motivating setting.
course_highlights: Course through the civic center of Mioveni
Event dedicated to wounded military personnel and war veterans
An atmosphere of solidarity and community support
additional: The event includes several sporting activities, but details about the course and registration are not specified

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together lovers of sport and nature, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Healthy Spirit Festival, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Trails through the forested and mountainous areas of Ovčar Banja
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful views
Challenging terrain suited to trail running
additional: The event is part of the Healthy Spirit Festival, which highlights healthy living, sport, and outdoor activities.

name: Columbia Triton Trail
description: Columbia Triton Trail 2026 is an exciting trail running race in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary, organized by Trailrun.hu and Andrew Erdei. The race offers a unique experience for runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking on a challenge. The event takes place on June 28, where participants can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail running through varied natural surroundings
Beautiful forest and mountain sections
Challenging climbs and technical sections
additional: The race takes place in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is characterized by its closeness to nature and its community atmosphere.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
location: Jankovich Kúria, Rácalmás, Tolna County, Hungary
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a friendly, family-oriented trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy Island and along the banks of the Danube. The varied terrain features shaded forest trails, views across farmland, riverside routes and paved sections, with minimal elevation gain. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide accessible sporting opportunities for all ages, whether running, walking or cycling. The event centre is the historic Jankovich Manor, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities. Participants can look forward to custom medals and T-shirts, and a friendly atmosphere close to nature.
course_highlights: Routes on the protected Nagy Island and along the Danube
Varied terrain: forest trails, views across farmland and paved sections
Minimal elevation gain; routes pass beneath shady trees and beside a picturesque boat harbour
additional: Race number collection is from 8:00 to 10:00. Several aid stations are available along the courses. Participation is free for RSE members, but registration is required. On-site registration is available in limited numbers only; advance registration is recommended. Various accompanying activities, health checks and food and drink options are available on race day. Custom medals and T-shirts can be ordered in advance. Participants can also look forward to finisher medals, aid stations, medical services and family activities. Registration is online via Köridő.hu, with favourable prices and early-bird registration options.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings, near Koprinka Reservoir in Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: 2 km swim along the sandy shores of Koprinka Reservoir
60 km cycling through the forests of Sredna Gora over rugged terrain
15 km run through the forest and along the reservoir shore, with panoramic views
additional: Cutoff times: swimming — 1:40 hours; cycling — 5:30 hours; running — 2:30 hours. Any time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is limited to people over 18. The day before the race, there is a children’s race for different age groups. Courses: 2 km swimming, 60 km cycling, 14 km running; registration at different prices; included: medals, aid stations, professional timing, medical support, bicycle service, prizes, and photos.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a waste-free race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: A 9-stage loop around Vitosha, passing through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultramarathon with varied terrain and elevation
Start and finish in front of Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the ALPI store in Sofia and at the start, up to 60 minutes before the race. The race emphasizes environmental protection: participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. A special SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels is available. The awards ceremony takes place on race day after the finish. The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon disciplines. The course includes remote parts of the mountain, with a total elevation gain of over 2,000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of a mountain ultramarathon and cycling event.
