description: The Ócsa Cellar Row Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail-running event that takes runners past landmarks in the town of Ócsa. The race is run on a 10.5 km course, which can be repeated for the longer distances of 21 km and 42 km. The event uses individual chip timing and aims to bring sport and community together in memory of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre, and the course includes a variety of paved and dirt paths.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km course passes Ócsa landmarks, including the Öreghegy cellar row and the Reformed Church
The 21 km distance consists of two laps, and the 42 km distance four laps, of the 10.5 km course
Varied terrain: paved streets and dirt paths; 100% trail running through the cellar row
additional: The race uses individual chip timing, recording both net and gross times. Placings are determined by gross time. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee upon presentation of proof of address. Entry is free for people born in 1960 or earlier. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. The start and finish are on the street in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event features multiple distances, including commemorative runs and community events in keeping with the local spirit; it is open to participants and takes place on varied terrain.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Bajina Bašta, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The trails pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable nature experience and a challenge for body and mind. Alongside the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.
course_highlights: The TUT 62 course runs from Rača Monastery through hidden parts of Tara National Park to Bajina Bašta, with 2,600 m of elevation gain
The Crnjeskovo and Sokolarica viewpoints and the Rača Canyon offer spectacular views during the race
Varied terrain includes singletrack, gravel roads, paved sections, and technical descents
additional: Registration opens at midnight on January 1, 2026. Participants under 18 cannot take part in TUT 62, and children under 14 may run only when accompanied by a parent. An all-day outdoor festival and the Bašta Fest short film festival take place at the finish. The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and adapted for the youngest competitors. Online registration opens on January 1, 2026, and the races include various distances and categories, with activities for all ages and ITRA points.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will take place from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition features four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The varied and challenging courses offer spectacular scenery and technical climbs, providing a true challenge and an opportunity to enjoy nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Mountaineering Club Tara. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Mountain Uphill: 6 km with over 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at the Sjenič viewpoint with panoramic views of Tara
Mountain Classic: 13.6 km with 550 m of elevation gain, starting at Rača Monastery, passing through the Rača Canyon, and finishing in Bajina Bašta
Mountain Trail: 36 km with about 1,900 m of elevation gain, a technically challenging course with two climbs to the Tara plateau and spectacular viewpoints
additional: The races are for runners born in 2008 or earlier for Mountain Uphill and Mountain Classic, while Mountain Trail is for runners born in 2006 or earlier. Mountain Uphill is the only race that neither starts at Rača Monastery nor finishes in Bajina Bašta. The courses include technical single-track sections, fast descents, and challenging climbs, with final sections suited to a strong finish. Several race categories, including U18, focus on mountain terrain and natural beauty; the event is organized by regional and local mountaineering and sports organizations.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Tara Mountain, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Serbia, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different levels of runners, from a vertical climb to a 62 km ultradistance with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and beautiful parts of the mountain, offering unforgettable scenery and challenges. In addition to the races, an outdoor festival and accompanying events for all ages and fitness levels take place at the finish. The event is an opportunity to experience the mountain in all its beauty and grandeur.
course_highlights: A 62 km course with 2,600 m of cumulative elevation gain through Tara National Park
Spectacular viewpoints such as Crnjeskovo, Sokolarica, and the Rača Canyon
Varied terrain including technical singletrack sections, gravel roads, and asphalt
additional: The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and tailored to the youngest participants, with parents and guardians welcome to join them. An all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events are held at the finish in Bajina Bašta, including the short film festival “Bašta Fest.” All races award ITRA points and count toward the ITRA National League. Multiple distances, Balkan Championship, outdoor festival, children’s race, registration via prijavise.net

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

description: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Banská Štiavnica and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 stages that pass through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park, with abundant natural and cultural attractions along the way. Runners can take part in teams of different sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.
course_highlights: Passes through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park
18 stages, 8–16 km long, with varied terrain and difficulty
Historical and natural attractions, including Drégely Castle, Esztergom Basilica, and Prédikálószék
additional: The race is open to teams of 3–8 runners and individual runners. Teams take turns over 18 stages, each 8–16 km long. Individual runners may complete the full distance at their own risk and with their own support, and may use the refreshment stations. The course passes through protected natural areas and historical sites. The race route includes sections through Duna-Ipoly National Park and other nature reserves, highlighting both natural beauty and cultural heritage.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
location: Népkert sor, Szeged, Csongrád County, Hungary
description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running event in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night half marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy the pleasures of community sport. It takes place on Népkert sor, an ideal setting for both running and family activities. The event is traditionally popular, with more than 1,100 participants.
course_highlights: Night half marathon distance
Family-friendly sports day activities
The green surroundings of Népkert sor, Szeged
additional: The event is held for charity and is organized as a family sports day, offering night running. More than 1,100 participants took part in a previous year. The event takes place on Népkert sor in Szeged, and the program includes the half marathon and the family sports day.

description: The 6th Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route is 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails, offering runners varied terrain and exceptional views. There are five different distances, and those up to 22 km can also be completed as hikes. The race welcomes participants with unique finisher medals, refreshment stations and a hot meal, while the organizers aim to make it an environmentally friendly, green event.
course_highlights: 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails
Beautiful views across the Balaton Uplands
Refreshment stations, including at wine cellars
additional: Every runner who starts receives a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are available along the route and in the start/finish area: water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruit, pretzels, wafers and lard spread on bread. A hot meal is served at the finish, with a meat-free option. The race is a “green” event, so participants should bring their own cup or bottle. Chip timing; the chip deposit is 1,000 HUF. At the awards ceremony, the top three women and men receive medals, trophies and gifts from sponsors. Online registration; refreshments and food provided; environmentally friendly event; registration fee; green approach.

description: The Teliholdfutam is a night running race in Esztergom, following a scenic route through Castle Hill, Víziváros and along the riverside cycle path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km and 15 km; the 15 km route also takes in Prímás Island. Runners must use a headlamp or another light source, as some sections of the course are unlit. The event is organised by the Esztergom Futóművek Amateur Sports Association and is also a points-collecting event in the Ötpróba program.
course_highlights: Route through Esztergom’s Castle Hill, Víziváros and riverside cycle path
15 km distance passing through Prímás Island
Cobblestone sections and unlit stretches of cycle path
additional: A working headlamp or other light source is mandatory. The participant limit is 200 per distance. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, where the 4 km distance earns 1 point, the 10 km distance 2 points and the 15 km distance 3 points. For online entries, the invoice is sent as an attachment to the confirmation email; for on-site entries, it is sent within 5 days after the race. T-shirt sizes and an ECO entry option without a T-shirt, with an old medal, are available. Race details include course conditions, entry information and event rules; the event is also part of the Ötpróba program.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira Massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course featuring wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suited to experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with wild natural scenery
90% tourist-trail marking, with additional signage in difficult sections
Significant elevation changes, with spectacular climbs and descents
additional: The routes include a marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, with positive elevation gains ranging from 700 m to 2400 m. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The routes are 80–90% runnable, with sections of forest road, alpine trails, and rugged terrain. The organizers recommend mountain experience and appropriate equipment. There is also a children’s race to encourage running in nature. The event also includes routes for children, with an emphasis on ecotourism and community involvement, and offers information about registration, accommodation, and routes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the spa resort of Călimănești-Căciulata. The event, organized by the Pegas Triatlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require mountain experience and skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.
course_highlights: Unmarked mountain routes with significant elevation gain (e.g. 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain)
Routes passing through villages, alpine pastures, wooded areas, and mountain ridges
Routes including sections with fixed ropes and rough terrain, requiring mountain experience
additional: Race bibs are distributed in two sessions: Friday evening and Saturday morning. The Cozia (30 km) and Stănișoara (21 km) routes start at 08:00, while the Turnu route (4 km) starts at 09:00. There is an 8-hour time limit for the Cozia and Stănișoara routes. The children’s race takes place at Turnu Monastery Camping, starting at 16:00, and registration for children is free. After the race, all participants are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery after the Holy Liturgy. Mountain routes, an 8-hour time limit, participants over 18 years old, an emphasis on running and hiking, and the promotion of local natural and cultural attractions

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. It is organized by the Troyan in the Future Association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km and 70 km, with varying elevation gain
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan, featuring natural and historical landmarks
Open to both professionals and enthusiasts
additional: Race packs are collected on site, with priority given to participants in the longer distances. Participants must carry their race number, a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and a mobile phone with the organizers’ number. The program includes a technical briefing and an awards ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events promoting an active lifestyle

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced ultramarathon runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose from an ultra-distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for an active holiday in the national resort of Varshets.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a range of distances
Start in front of Hotel Medicus in the town of Varshets
Routes through scenic natural surroundings
additional: Race packs can be collected at Varshets Municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12–13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start at Hotel Medicus; online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach between Kamchia Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and aids provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River.
The distances are 10 km and 21.1 km, with aid stations approximately every 5 km.
Runners can run barefoot, and rescue equipment is provided for the river crossing.
additional: The start is in the evening. Race numbers are distributed from 15:00, and baggage storage is available. The time limits are 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3 hours 30 minutes for 10 km. Children can take part in the 2.2 km children’s run for free. Participants must bring a water container for the aid stations. Timing uses RFID chips. In unfavorable conditions, the river crossing may be made by boats provided by the organizers. Registration is available online and on site. Fees can be paid via EasyPay or ePay. Accompaniment is available, and children under 7 may participate with an accompanying adult.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour from Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, with beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, offering a chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours with transport to the trailhead are available to all accommodation guests.
course_highlights: A 52-meter ascent from 1,570 m to 1,622 m above sea level
Panoramic views of Pančićev Vrh, Radočelo, Golija, and the surrounding mountains
The trail is well marked and safe for hiking
additional: Transport to the trailhead is arranged in the host’s van for accommodation guests. The return trip takes about 30 minutes in total. The tour is available only to guests of Kežman Mountain Houses. Participants can expect a guided tour, a short walk with spectacular views, a steep ascent, and a well-marked trail.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
description: The Around Avala Athletics Race is a traditional event organized by the Athletics Veterans Association of Serbia. The race takes place in Avala’s beautiful surroundings and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It offers an opportunity for sportsmanship and to promote athletics among veterans and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both a challenge and the chance to enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Course around Mount Avala
Natural surroundings and woodland scenery
Race suited to veterans and recreational runners
additional: Participants can expect races over various distances, including a half marathon, with the possibility of scoring points toward national and international series. Registration is open to a large number of competitors, and the event is supported by local sponsors and the community.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race combines the excitement of relay running with the beauty of nature, giving participants the chance to test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers an enjoyable experience for spectators as well as runners. It is open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike, and is an important event in local sports life.
course_highlights: Relay race on varied terrain around Tata
Nature-close course with forest and agricultural sections
Welcoming, friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports several sports. The race is part of Sprint Running Club events, and traditionally several divisions take part in organizing it. Maps and past results are available on the website, but no specific prices or start times are listed on the page provided. In addition to the relay race, the event offers other sporting activities; detailed registration and participation information is available on the organizer’s website.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the scenic resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a 48 km ultra distance
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
A 1 km distance for children and beginners
additional: The start is in front of Hotel Medicus. Race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of Hotel Medicus; registration at www.runbulgaria.org

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together nature lovers and fans of endurance and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races cater to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race packet with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, and the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.
course_highlights: Three races of different distances: Maxi (60.9 km), Midi (24.8 km), Mini (14.6 km)
The courses are entirely new and do not repeat those from the previous ultramarathon
Time limits: Maxi 12h, Midi 7h, Mini 5h
additional: The race packet includes a T-shirt (size guaranteed for entries paid by June 20, 2026), promotional materials from the Prijepolje Tourist Organization, finisher’s medals for everyone who completes the race, and medals and trophies for category winners. Free accommodation is available in the gymnasium of “Valter” Elementary School (sleeping bags are required). The organizer reserves the right to make course adjustments, with timely notice. Participants can expect details about registration, medals, T-shirts, and timing on the official platforms. The event also includes services such as timekeeping and event promotion.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to highlight the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers hope to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mount Jadovnik, rich in flora and fauna
The race takes place in unspoiled nature with a distinctive mountain setting
A unique opportunity to discover a lesser-known mountain in Serbia
additional: Participants must carry mandatory equipment. The race is limited to 100 runners, and the route includes forest roads and paved sections.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The 7th Csillagok útján… night run is a unique running experience at Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach, where runners and walkers are welcomed on July 11 in a summer setting on the shores of Lake Balaton. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor, a firm surface throughout, and full street lighting along the route. Participants can choose from 3.5, 7, and 10.5 km distances, while walking and a 500-meter children’s distance are also available. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of running at night together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach in a beautiful lakeside setting
A wide start-finish corridor and a firm surface throughout
Street lighting along the entire route for a night-running experience
additional: Walking is also available on the 3.5 km distance, and children can test their strength over 500 meters. Street lighting along the entire route supports safe night running. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor and a firm surface. The event is part of the summer events on Lake Balaton, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, and men and women compete in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, creating a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course between Barcs and Heresznye
Varied route that has seen record times
Runners from six counties take part in the race
additional: The event includes several sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and the races are usually held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running event is a traditional race with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, in the scenic surroundings of Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural setting and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: A nature-rich course around Köcsi Lake
A friendly, community atmosphere
Several distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for the 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, broken down by age group. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Photos are available for participants on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment facilities, the opportunity to swim at the beach, finisher medals.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. Held at a stadium in Sofia, it offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talent in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Stadium competition in Sofia
Participation by the best athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, which has a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will bring together young athletes from across the country.

description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The race offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and has aid stations, while the atmosphere is filled with camaraderie and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycling, 21 km run
Turbo: 0.9 km swim, 52 km cycling, 10 km run
Legend Relay: the same distance as Legend, completed by a team of two or three
additional: Marked course, aid stations, and limited places for each distance (Legend - 120, Turbo - 60, Legend Relay - 20 teams). The race fosters community and camaraderie among participants. Distances: Legend (1.9 km swim, 90 km cycling, 21 km run), Turbo (0.9 km swim, 52 km cycling, 10 km run), Relay (the same as Legend, in teams). Registration with different prices and places. The event is part of a legendary experience in the Rhodope Mountains and is suitable for both advanced athletes and beginners.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
location: Lázbérci Természetvédelmi Terület, Lázbérc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The Lázbérc Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationally organized running race in Hungary, held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and gives participants a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in a picturesque setting. The race has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature
Picturesque surroundings in the Lázbérc landscape
An event held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy
additional: The event will take place in 2026, and the organizers aim to bring together the community of peace and running.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional track and field race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of different fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free, organized running. It gives everyone the opportunity to take part in a sporting atmosphere that embraces diversity and community.
course_highlights: Middle and long distances
Organized but non-professional race
Takes place in Sofia
additional: The event is part of an initiative to promote running and a healthy lifestyle in Bulgaria.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: Lussonium Trail is a trail running race among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering wonderful views, challenging climbs and a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The race offers several distances for participants of all ages, with unique finisher medals that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The race headquarters are at the Lussonium Roman Ruins, where parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid point are also available. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and redeem them for rewards.
course_highlights: Wonderful views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging trail climbs
Impressive start and finish venue at the Lussonium Roman Ruins
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 valid entries. Entries are accepted for a maximum of 400 runners, including no more than 100 preschool- and primary school-aged participants. Parking, toilets, a playground and a first-aid point are available on site. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be joined with the Feldwar Trail medal. It is also possible to register at a lower price without a medal. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program. Medals and refreshments await participants, and the event has a friendly atmosphere and is ideal for families.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Dochia Race, with approximately 1500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Bate Toaca Race, with approximately 2700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gains (1500 m and 2700 m)
Spectacular scenery in the Durău area, including Vf. Toaca and Cabana Dochia
Marked courses with various symbols (red stripe, yellow triangle, red cross, red dot)
additional: The courses are well marked with different symbols and include climbs and descents on stairs at Vf. Toaca. The Bate Toaca Race is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The organizer is Asociația SPORT.NATURA Piatra Neamț. Telephone contact is available for logistics and the secretariat. The event also includes results and rules from previous editions, as well as information about registration and participation.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place on July 18, 2026, in Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a range of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in Buila-Vânturarița National Park
Spectacular scenery and protected nature
A range of events: children’s races, an 11 km cross-country race, and 18 km and 36 km courses
additional: The event promotes ecotourism, nature, and local culture, offering an opportunity for trail running and mountain hiking enthusiasts.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
price_range: semi-maraton 200 Lei, cros 175 Lei, cursele copiilor 50 Lei
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running race held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu, on 18 July 2026. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation gain, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.
course_highlights: Scenic subalpine routes with elevation gains ranging from +30 m to +1000 m
14 km cross-country race with +900 m elevation gain and 21 km half marathon with +1000 m elevation gain
Routes for children and teenagers with modest elevation gain, adapted to age
additional: Race bib pickup is from 06:30 to 07:30, the technical briefing is at 07:45, the adult race starts at 09:00, and the children’s race starts at 11:00. Hydration stations are available every 5 km along the route. Parking is available at the school in the village centre and in the Beberani area, approximately 100 m from the start. After the race, participants are invited to a brunch featuring local products, and the entry fee includes a donation of 50 lei to support the Țara Colibelor project. mountain routes, online registration, donation included, post-race brunch

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon offering challenging distances amid the beautiful Balkan Mountains scenery around the town of Tryavna. The event includes 100 km, 42 km and 21 km races, as well as cycling routes and a duathlon. The courses have varied terrain and include numerous aid stations to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. It is organized by the iRun association, which has many years of experience staging sporting events and building a sports community.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances from 21 km to 100 km
Varied mountain terrain with elevation profiles exceeding 1,500 m
Numerous aid stations along the courses
additional: The event includes running, cycling and duathlon with combined distances. The organizer, iRun, is an association with more than 50 sporting events held. The website has information about accommodation, the event’s history and results from previous years. Multiple distances for running, cycling and duathlon; an event with technical conferences and race packs; held in the town of Tryavna, Bulgaria.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, nonprofit running race taking place in Dunabogdány on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00. The race offers two challenges: 6.1 km with 205 m of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 m of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and top finishers are awarded prizes in age-group and overall categories. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and registration allows for on-site changes. Places are limited to a maximum of 200 participants.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with 205 m of elevation gain
14 km distance with 356 m of elevation gain
Unique 60 × 60 mm metal finisher’s medal
additional: On-site registration is also available for an increased fee. The distance can still be changed before the start, but only participants who do not switch distances during the race will be included in the results. There is no time limit. When registering, participants must provide their year of birth, chosen distance, and, if they have one, the number of a race bib brought from home. Participants without a race bib will receive a paper bib. Competitors’ names will appear in the start and results lists, and photos and videos taken during the event may be used on the website. Two distances, elevation gain, prizes, age-group categories, unique metal finisher’s medals, online and on-site registration, limited capacity (200 participants).

name: FUTABUDA
description: FUTABUDA is a running race held in the Danube Bend, starting at 10:00 a.m. on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at the Kisoroszi Ferry Port in Dunabogdány. The race offers two distances, 6.1 km and 14 km, with significant elevation changes that challenge runners. Participants who finish receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and the top finishers receive awards. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, but is an independent event. Registration is available online or by email, and on-site registration is also possible for a higher fee.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with +/- 205 m elevation change
14 km distance with +/- 356 m elevation change
Unique 60 x 60 mm metal finisher’s medal for those who finish
additional: When registering, participants must provide their name, year of birth, chosen distance, and any preferred bib number. The chosen distance can still be changed before the start, but only runners who do not change distance during the race will be included in the results. There is no time limit. The race is a non-profit, self-funded event, with a limit of 200 participants. Awards will go to those who break the men’s and women’s course records, the overall 1st–3rd-place finishers, and the 1st–3rd-place finishers in each age group. On-site registration is available for a higher fee. Bibs can be collected at the venue, or after 9:30 a.m. in the case of advance bank transfer. Participants can look forward to medals, prizes, and awards in various categories. Registration is available online and on-site, offering a varied experience depending on weather conditions.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
Trail race Kopaonik 2026
description: Trail Race Kopaonik is a traditional event that brings together trail-running and nature enthusiasts in Kopaonik National Park. With three courses of different lengths—7 km, 15 km and 24 km—the race gives both beginners and experienced runners the chance to enjoy beautiful forest and meadow scenery, fresh mountain air and pleasant temperatures. In addition to the race, participants can enjoy a music programme, organised walks and a children’s race. The organisers provide fully marked courses, electronic timing, T-shirts, medals, refreshments and medical assistance.
course_highlights: The Kopaonik 7K course passes through the Crvene Bare area and by the Markov Kamen picnic site
The Kopaonik 15K course goes over Gobelja peak, Meka Presedla and Likina Česma
The Kopaonik 24K course has 900 m of elevation gain and a time limit of 6 hours
additional: All courses start in Dolina sportova at 10:00. Course time limits are: 7K – 3 hours, 15K – 4 hours, 24K – 6 hours. Refreshment stations and medical assistance are available on the courses. Participants who register by 6 July 2026 receive the official race T-shirt. Chip-based electronic timing, online results and certificates are available. The race is individual; registration is online only via njuko.com. Race-day registration is not available. Entry includes electronic timing, finisher medals, refreshment stations, medical assistance and GPS navigation. Register via njuko.com; on-site race-day registration is not available.

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: Gaja Valley Trail is a trail-running event organised by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on 25 July 2026 in Fehérvárcsurgó, near Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances. The focus is not on competition, but on the joy of exercise, a shared community experience and being close to nature. The event aims to promote running at every level, from beginners to experienced runners, in a pleasant summer woodland setting. The start and finish are at the Károlyi Castle Visitor Centre, while the sound of Gaja Stream and the quiet of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: A route featuring the castle, reservoir and the babbling Gaja Stream
Scenic woodland trails in Gaja Valley
The Károlyi Castle Visitor Centre is the start and finish venue
additional: Gaja Valley Trail is not a race and has no timing, so beginner, amateur and recreational runners can all take part. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. The event offers a friendly community atmosphere, a healthy lifestyle and an experience close to nature. Alongside trail running, the event also features hikes and cycling challenge tours. The venue is easy to reach, and the varied terrain is rich in natural features.

name: GULYATERELŐ FUTÓVERSENY
location: Tápiógyörgye Falumúzeum, Béke utca 2, Tápiógyörgye, Hungary

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the surroundings of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 9 to 56 km, with different difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both experienced runners and cyclists and enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race package includes a medal, a souvenir bearing the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. Additional and mandatory equipment is not included. Registration at lower fees is available until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59; payment is due by May 2 at 12:00. Registration at early-bird fees is available until April 30, 2026, with medals, race packages, and aid stations included.

name: Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain skills. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and challenging mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including passages over peaks such as Botev and Mlechnia Chal.
course_highlights: Technical sections with significant elevation gain and a climb to Botev Peak
A route along the mountain ridge with varied terrain and steep descents
A long ridge run passing numerous mountain huts and checkpoints
additional: Participants in the Ultra distance must have valid mountain insurance and must have finished two races with at least 4,000 meters of elevation gain in the past 3 years. Entry to the Sky distance is open to all. A GPS device is mandatory for navigation using the provided GPS track. There are checkpoints with cut-off times, for example, at Petolachkata—10 hours. The courses include technical sections; accommodation options include Pleven Hut, camping, or staying in Apriltsi. The race is approximately 78 km long, with a record under 13 hours.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National Championships for boys and girls under 18 are one of the largest events in the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition features a range of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Track and field events for boys and girls under 18
Discus and hammer events at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad
Competition held at Vasil Levski National Stadium
additional: Venue: Pravets; events: long jump and triple jump; date: 25 July 2026

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Makkos Park, Monorierdő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented running event held every year in Makkos Park in Monorierdő. Participants can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes in Makkos Park. A special feature of the event is a live-music refreshment station, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes the runners twice. The event aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.
course_highlights: The race starts and finishes in Makkos Park
Live-music refreshment station featuring the band "The Little Pea"
A choice of distances to suit runners' preferences
additional: The railway station is just 200 metres from the event centre, making the venue easy to reach by train. Participants are advised to choose a train that will get them there in time to collect their race numbers. The event is part of the Ötpróba series. Online registration is available until July 18, and other sports and leisure events are also offered in connection with the races.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness regions. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval shepherd settlements, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometer offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.
course_highlights: Routes through Slătioara Forest, a UNESCO candidate
Steep climbs and technical trails in the Carpathian Mountains
Spectacular natural landscapes: Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei
additional: The Ultra Rocks race (114 km) starts just before midnight in Câmpulung Moldovenesc. The route includes an initial loop through the town, followed by stretches through wilderness and checkpoints with facilities such as Live Cooking. The event takes place in the Ultra Trail Village at the Central Plateau in Câmpulung Moldovenesc, next to City Hall. Multiple mountain race distances, technical trails, the location in Romania, and details about registration and rules are available on websites and social media.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race taking place on July 26, 2026, in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running along routes that pass through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the start line is provided by coach. Race kits can be collected on Saturday and on Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Historic route along Avram Iancu’s road
Water stations at km 5, 12.5, 17.5, and 20
Total ascent of 178 m and total descent of 332 m on the 22 km course
additional: Coach transport from 7:00 from the center of Câmpeni to the start line; race kits can be collected on Saturday between 14:00 and 20:00 and on Sunday until 07:00; water stations along the route; meeting and registration from 05:30 to 07:30 at the Avram Iancu Statue in Câmpeni. Participation includes multiple starts, transport to the start with partner Arieșul SA, race-kit collection, and an artistic and traditional program as part of the event.

name: FAGARAS ROCKS!
organizer: A C U M - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event offering a unique experience on spectacular trails in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic scenery and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, include multiple peaks above 2,500 m and more than 50 km of running at altitudes above 2,000 m, and are run in semi-autonomous conditions. The event includes several races of varying distances, for experienced runners as well as younger participants and amateurs, with a friendly atmosphere and related activities for participants and their families. The organizers provide facilities such as aid stations, medical assistance, a hot meal on the course, finisher medals, and cash prizes for the mountain races.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of marked routes in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks above 2,500 m and 15 peaks above 2,200 m
50 km of running at altitudes above 2,000 m
additional: Participants receive a personalized race bib (non-personalized bibs after July 15), live satellite tracking for #TheWildTruth, a hot meal on the course for #TheWildTruth, engraved stone finisher medals, a superlight technical shirt for the first 300 entrants in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and themed workshops, aid and hydration stations, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, massage tents, and post-race feedback. Multiple route categories, information about camping and parking; the event includes an ultra and a skyrace.

name: Fagaras Rocks ~ 2026
organizer: ACUM - Asociația Copiii universului Magic și ACS Sport Verde
description: Făgăraș Rocks! is a mountain running event held in semi-autonomous format, offering a unique experience on spectacular trails in the Făgăraș Mountains, with majestic landscapes and impressive panoramas. The routes total approximately 184 km, reach peaks over 2,500 m, and include 50 km of running at elevations above 2,000 m. The event features several races of varying distances and difficulty levels, for experienced runners as well as younger participants and amateurs. Participants receive a comprehensive registration package, with services and amenities designed to make the experience complete and safe.
course_highlights: Approximately 184 km of marked trails in the Făgăraș Mountains
4 peaks over 2,500 m and 15 peaks over 2,200 m
50 km of running at elevations above 2,000 m
additional: The participation package includes a personalized race bib (for registrations by July 15), live satellite tracking for the #TheWildTruth race, cash prizes for the mountain races, a hot meal on the course for #TheWildTruth, a stone-engraved finisher medal, a superlight technical singlet for the first 300 registrants in the main races, ITRA & UTMB points for finishers, Q&A sessions and themed workshops, medical assistance, refreshment and hydration points, parking for 360 cars, massage tents, and post-race feedback. The event includes camping and parking, along with details about the competition schedule, and offers an opportunity to experience a mountain adventure and discover the area’s natural beauty.

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Novi Sad, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three routes of different lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 9 p.m. by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the route, giving even the slowest runners enough time to finish. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy Fruška Gora at night.
course_highlights: Three routes: 7 km, 11 km, and 19 km
9 p.m. start by the Na Vencu restaurant
Time limit: 4 hours and 15 minutes
additional: The routes have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes, allowing even the slowest participants to finish. The event is intended for hikers, runners, and lovers of nature and Fruška Gora. It features trails for different fitness levels, suitable for both hikers and runners. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle in nature.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriško venac, Fruška gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Freedom Monument at Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which run through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Lake Ledinci. The race combines adrenaline-fueled obstacles with beautiful scenery and ends in an atmosphere of community and celebration at the end of the season. This event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Courses through the dense forest of Fruška Gora
Water obstacles at Lake Ledinci
A night race requiring a headlamp, with an adrenaline-fueled journey through the dark
additional: The start and finish are at Iriški Venac, by the “Na Vencu” restaurant. A headlamp is mandatory for the night race. The competition is part of the Invictus OCR League, with scoring at three locations. Every competitor receives a medal at the finish. The race is adapted to different fitness levels. The event is part of a challenge combining obstacle races and trail races, offering a unique experience in the nature of Fruška Gora.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: Csernye Trail is a trail running race that will be held for the sixth time in Bakonycsernye in 2026. Starting from the area beside the sports field, runners can choose from various distances that pass through varied terrain, forests and hills. The organizers promise excellent event management and an enjoyable running experience, while participants can admire the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Trail running on varied forest and grassy routes
Beautiful views of Bakonycsernye and the surrounding area
Various distances, including a half marathon on strictly off-road terrain
additional: Toilets, washbasins and showers are available at the race center. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the football field. A technical T-shirt or singlet can also be ordered at registration for a fixed price of 4600 HUF. Places are limited: a total of 300 runners can enter the three longer distances, with a separate limit of 100 for the Fun Run. Registration for the race runs from March 12 to July 30, 2026. The race starts at 09:00 on August 1, 2026. Race packs can be collected at the venue or at the Cultural Center between 07:00 and 08:30. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the official website.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
location: Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló, Orfű, Baranya, Hungary
description: The Orfű Lake Show Run is a traditional running race organized by the Melitta Recreation Sports Association, held around the large car park by Lake Orfű and the beach. During the race, participants must run once or twice around Lake Pécs on public roads, clockwise, not on the promenade. The event is family-friendly, and everyone takes part at their own risk. Both professionals and amateurs are welcome. The event is held with the support of Barta Textilház and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on their finishing times.
course_highlights: 6.2 km lap around Lake Pécs on public roads
12.4 km distance, running twice around Lake Pécs
The race takes place on public roads, not on the promenade
additional: Timing and an awards ceremony are provided only for the running races, and the top finishers receive trophies. Other prizes are awarded by drawing, giving every participant an equal chance. The event also offers family activities, and children can enjoy well-equipped playgrounds at the venue. Participants run at their own risk. The venue is around the large car park by Lake Orfű and the beach. The event takes place on August 3, 2024.

name: TATAI MINIMARATON ÉS FÉLMARATON - Tata, Váralja út 13,5-21km. eredmények
Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș

description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to an Everesting challenge. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until available places are filled.
course_highlights: Mountain course with Everesting-style elevation gain
Option to compete individually or in teams
Scenic location at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș
additional: Participants can compete individually or in teams (minimum 5 members). Team rankings are determined by adding together the number of laps completed by all team members. Entry fees are non-refundable. Registration confirmation is emailed immediately after payment is processed. An official T-shirt and partnerships to support participants are available. Endurance cycling event, with a schedule on July 31 and August 1, 2026; entry fees, rules, and results are available on the website.

name: MOGOȘA EVERESTING
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition taking place on August 1, 2026, in Mogoșa, Maramureș. Participants can compete individually or in teams, with team rankings based on the total number of laps completed by all members. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers an authentic mountain running experience focused on effort and team spirit. Entry fees are affordable, and there is a special category for children and juniors under 18.
course_highlights: Mountain running on a multi-lap course
Team rankings based on the total number of laps completed
Individual and team participation (minimum 5 members)
additional: Participants receive a race kit. After July 26, registration is subject to availability. Teams must have at least 5 members officially registered under the same team name. Registration confirmation is sent by email immediately after payment is processed. Entry fees are non-refundable. Participation includes a kit and official T-shirt. The event has multiple categories and takes place on mountainous terrain with repeated climbs; entry fees vary depending on the date.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through the forest, marked clearly during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for outdoor activity.
course_highlights: 10.5 km trail course with 215 m of positive elevation gain
Mostly through the forest on the Cornești Plateau
Marked with visible tape during the day and reflective signs at night
additional: The event includes 24-hour individual MTB and trail running events, as well as four-member relay teams, an individual 12-hour run, and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The time limit for completing a lap is 2 hours for MTB and 3 hours for running. Participants can store their personal equipment in tents in the start/finish area. Rankings are based on the distance completed within the allotted time. The event features multiple categories and prizes for the top finishers, and takes place in the natural setting of the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara on August 1, 2026, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and supports the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor run in an urban natural setting, suitable for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation to encourage people to take up running and get involved in the community.
course_highlights: Route through Franz Joseph Park, Timișoara
Night event starting at 20:30
Friendly atmosphere and an active running community
additional: The event is part of the Alergotura series, which gives club members free access to Politehnica Timișoara’s running base and organizes team-building activities. No information was found about participation fees or online registration for this edition. The event also includes weekly runs and other sports activities in Timișoara, promoting health and social connections in the community.

name: Национален шампионат по шосейни бягания
