description: The first national road running championships in Bulgaria will take place in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The event features distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as races for children and beginners. It is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over 4,000 BGN. This is an important opportunity for recreational and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 mile (1,609 m), 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21.1 km)
The race takes place in Plovdiv, one of Bulgaria’s major cities
Includes 1 km races for children and beginners
additional: The 1 km mass participation run is free for everyone. Before the championships, there will be Kids’ Athletics activities and a press conference with awards for the best runners of 2024. The race is part of the Run Bulgaria series and serves as preparation for the European Road Running Championships. Distances: 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and 1 km for children and beginners; online registration; a 40 BGN entry fee for some distances; free 1 km mass participation start.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area of Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from courses of varying difficulty and technical features, running amid stunning mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of achievement on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and note that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of varying difficulty and technical features
Stunning views in northwestern Bulgaria between the Iskar and Timok rivers
The opportunity to climb peaks and run in nature
additional: A reservation must be made at least one week before the chosen date. The races do not include transportation to the venue. Participants must wear specialized trail running shoes. The voucher is valid for one participant. The race may be canceled in bad weather. Information about the course, registration, and participation requirements is unavailable; the event is part of trail running races in northwestern Bulgaria.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event in the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, in the Western Rhodopes. The start and finish are at Olympic Square, at an elevation of 1,062 m. The courses pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic ridge trails, reaching a maximum elevation of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
Panoramic ridge trails reach a maximum elevation of 1,872 m
Three distances with elevation gain of up to +1,887 m and descent of up to −1,885 m
additional: Free parking opens at 05:00 at Vasil Dechev Secondary School. Registration and race-pack collection are from 6:30 to 8:00 at Olympic Square, with on-site payment available via Revolut, PayPal, or ePay. Mountain biking and running starts are separated by distance and begin between 8:30 and 9:30. There is a children's run and a children's program with yoga, games, and cake. The children's awards and awards for all distances are scheduled for the afternoon. The event includes different distances and packages for combined participation, with the mountain biking start scheduled for 08:30 on August 1, 2026.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúri Self-Transcendence Running Festival is a friendly, family-oriented race that combines being close to nature with the spirit of self-transcendence. The race takes place in Keresztúri Forest, near Budapest, and offers challenges over several distances, including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, 31.6 km and marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. The event is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported running enthusiasts since 1977. The aim is for every participant to experience camaraderie in sport and the joy of going beyond their limits.
course_highlights: A nature-filled running route in Keresztúri Forest
A forest nature trail and running loop, with short sections on roads
The Yes, I can! event consists of hourly starts, one lap at a time, with each lap covering 5,274 m
additional: On-site registration is available on race day between 6:30 and 7:30. The entry fee does not include a T-shirt, but a commemorative technical T-shirt can be ordered in advance. The Yes, I can! event consists of 6 laps, with one lap starting every hour; the lap starting at 13:00 is devoted to self-transcendence. Participants support one another in completing the race; starting late results in disqualification. Several distances are available, and on-site registration is also possible. Detailed information about fees and T-shirts is available on the organiser’s website.

name: Balkaniada West

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: От 05.01.26 до 31.01.26 включително ще можете да се възползвате от 10% намаление при регистрация с промо код "BALKANIADA10"!

description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race taking place on 2 August 2026, starting at 06:00. The event includes several distances of varying lengths and elevation gain, with routes through scenic mountain areas around Gorski Rai Hut. The event has a limited number of participants, and applications require prior approval. The organizers provide transport, accommodation and food, as well as branded clothing for those who finish within the cut-off time.
course_highlights: Vertical Kilometer: 3.8 km with 830 m of positive elevation gain
Distances: 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
A 10 km prologue with 900 m of positive elevation gain from the village of Chuprene to Gorski Rai Hut (untimed)
additional: The race has a limited number of participants (30 for the first edition). You must have completed races with cut-off times in 2025 or provide evidence of similar achievements. Transport is arranged from Sofia to Kom Hut and from Kom Hut to the village of Chuprene. Accommodation, dinner and breakfast at Kom and Gorski Rai huts are included. Everyone who finishes successfully receives branded clothing. The event includes a prologue, organized transport, accommodation, breakfasts and branded clothing for finishers. Limited to 30 participants; selection is based on experience.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run takes place in Kecskemét at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre, offering a running experience as a sporting complement to the jazz festival. Traditionally, the event puts the joy of running and the sense of community first, and is open to all ages and types of runners. It is not only a sporting event but also strengthens the local community, while participants can enjoy exercising in beautiful surroundings and fresh air. The organisers also value charity, so the run is an opportunity to support a cause.
course_highlights: The run takes place beneath beautiful trees in a pleasant natural setting
The race is a sporting companion event to the jazz festival
The run is also a community and charity event
additional: The event is open to everyone, and community activities and charity initiatives accompany the run. Runners can enjoy exercising in pleasant natural surroundings and fresh air. Participants can choose from several distances and register online or on site. Participants receive a T-shirt bearing the event logo, as well as a snack and mineral water at the finish. Festival programmes are free for runners.

name: Retezat Mountain Run
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Râușor area of Hunedoara, offering four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the Easy Run to the Marathon. The routes cross the wild and hard-to-reach landscapes of Retezat National Park, with aid stations in spectacular natural settings, including Bucura glacial lake. The event is organized by a non-profit association dedicated to mountain conservation and involves a team of volunteers and professionals to ensure safety and the smooth running of the race. Participants enjoy an authentic mountain running experience, with cash and in-kind prizes, as well as a friendly, festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with significant elevation gain, up to 3340 m D+ for the marathon
Aid stations in remote areas accessible only on foot or by air
The route passes by Bucura glacial lake, the largest glacial lake in Romania
additional: Registration and race-kit distribution take place on Friday between 15:00-23:00 and Saturday between 6:00-9:00 at Apres Ski, at the base of the ski slope. There is a technical briefing and a Pasta Party before the race. Mandatory equipment includes mountain running shoes and a windstopper/rain jacket. The routes are marked and monitored by volunteers, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between aid stations. It is recommended that participants leave their cars in the car park at the end of the paved road; the competition area is a 10-minute walk away. Various distances, extensive logistical support, online registration available, an event with a long tradition and recognition in the mountain community.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event includes marathon, half-marathon and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local figures, offering an experience immersed in nature on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the atmosphere, creating a warm and welcoming community. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.
course_highlights: Easy trails and dirt roads through Homu Forest
Varied scenery, from old-growth forest to colorful agricultural fields
No asphalt or concrete, making the routes ideal for natural running
additional: The event includes children’s races “In Memoriam” Professor Liviu Marinescu, Latin dancing and a campfire (weather permitting). Participants must send proof of payment of the entry fee by email or WhatsApp. The fee can also be paid by bank transfer or Revolut. The routes are accessible, with no major difficulties and no asphalt or concrete. The event is dedicated to the memory of local figures and supports Mia’s Children Association. Routes include a half-marathon (21 km), cross-country race (10 km) and children’s races (4.2 km), with staggered starts and social and cultural activities.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
location: Rausor, Retezat Mountains, Hunedoara County, Romania
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with courses climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to the nearly 40 km Marathon, with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The courses cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term continuity plan.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gain, up to 3,340 m D+ for the marathon
Aid stations in wild areas accessible only on foot or by air
The marathon course passes by Bucura glacial lake, the largest in the country
additional: Registration and race-kit distribution take place Friday from 15:00 to 23:00 and Saturday from 6:00 to 9:00 at Apres Ski, at the base of the Râușor ski slope. A technical briefing and a Pasta Party are held before the race. Mandatory equipment includes trail-running shoes and a windproof/rain jacket. The courses are marked and monitored, and runners must manage their own nutrition and hydration between aid stations. It is recommended to leave your car in the parking area at the end of the paved road, a 10-minute walk from the start. Courses have significant elevation gain and difficult mountain terrain, with limited support in some areas; mountain weather conditions should be taken into account.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized by the Enthusiastic Team of Szigethalom Ultrarunners every second weekend in August. The 2026 event, the 20th anniversary festival, will take place in Tököl Park Forest and features a variety of distances, including an ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter races, and hiking. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, with plenty of activities for children as well as runners. Its aim is to promote sport and support the local community, with particular emphasis on helping people with disabilities.
course_highlights: A 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Park Forest, with 30 m of elevation gain
A 52 km relay race for teams of 2–4 runners
Aid stations every 3 km with a generous selection of refreshments
additional: The event uses chip timing. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, refundable at the finish or available to donate to charity. Starts are staggered, and on-site registration opens at 7:00 on race day. Activities for children include face painting, glitter tattoos, a creative corner, and a bouncy castle. The event closes at 15:00, which is also the time limit. Aid stations are located every 3 km and offer a generous selection of refreshments. Online and on-site registration are available. Events include ultrarunning, a half marathon, and shorter distances. The festival puts community and a love of sport at its heart.

name: RossbRUNn Trail
location: Lókút Sportközpont, Bem utca, Lókút, Hungary
distance_verbose: 56 km, Maraton, 28 km, 14 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: RILA RUN
description: Ride Or Run - Rila is a popular and unconventional race held in the Rila Mountains, starting in the village of Pastra and finishing at Kalin Reservoir. The course is a 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road, with more than 1,800 meters of elevation gain. The race attracts both cyclists and runners, who face a serious challenge in mountain conditions. After a hiatus of several years, the event once again brings together the top athletes in this discipline.
course_highlights: 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road
More than 1,800 meters of elevation gain
Route from the village of Pastra to Kalin Reservoir in the Rila Mountains
additional: The course is a 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road, with aid stations at 5, 10, and 15.3 km. The event offers running, cycling, and duathlon races.

name: Ultra Race Romania

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Avans de 500€ urmat de 5 rate lunare de 475€ fiecare

description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route in the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary landscapes and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After finishing the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event emphasizes the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.
course_highlights: A 250 km route split into 6 stages in the Carpathian Mountains
Legendary places such as Lake Vulturilor and Cașoca Waterfall
Wild landscapes and local mysteries in the Buzău area
additional: The race is self-sufficient, with tent accommodation during the 6 stages. Medical assistance, water at checkpoints and camps, hot meals, bus transportation before and after the race, finisher medals, and T-shirts are provided. After the race, a 2-day cultural tour of Brașov, Bran, and Sinaia is organized, with hotel accommodation and meals included. SPOT satellite live tracking is available for competitors. Participants must be prepared for wilderness conditions, with mandatory equipment and strict safety rules; the event also includes a cultural excursion after the race.

name: Oltenia Forest Run
description: Oltenia Forest Run is a running and orienteering competition held in the wooded area of Băile Govora, for running and orienteering enthusiasts of all ages. The running course is marked and suited to participants in good enough health to undertake physical exertion. The event promotes respect for the environment and participant safety, and provides a race kit with a race bib and a gift. It combines sport and nature and is suitable for children, young people, adults, and veterans.
course_highlights: Marked running course through wooded areas
Orienteering section for all age categories
Compliance with environmental protection and safety rules
additional: The race kit contains a race bib to be worn visibly and a gift. Registration is available online via a form or on site, subject to availability. Participants must follow environmental protection rules during the race. Trail running and orienteering in forest terrain; online or on-site registration (limited places); event in August 2026, with prizes and certificates for participants.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race combines technically challenging sections with fast descents and requires strength, speed, and skill. In addition to the individual races, there is a team race, as well as the option to take part in a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain, passing over Yastrebets, Aleko, Musala, and Mancho
16 km Yastrebets Trail Run with 1,000 m of elevation gain on a marked course
Technical, rocky, and steep sections with panoramic views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains
additional: Start and finish on the ski slope in front of Hotel Rila. Race pack collection on the evening before the race and on race morning. Awards for the winners at 11:00 for the Yastrebets Trail Run and at 15:00 for Musala Extreme. The team race has no limit on the number of participants per team. Duathlon with cycling the following day on a route through Lakatiska Rila. The course has technical sections requiring mountain-running skills; registration and an entry fee are required; mandatory equipment applies; shorter-distance races and a team race are available; duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, covering 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Balkan Mountains. The race requires technical skills on rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and care. The shorter Yastrebets Trail Run, covering 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, takes place alongside it and is suitable for runners looking for an easier route. The organizers also offer a team race and a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain over the peaks of Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho
Technical rocky and steep sections requiring skill and care
Panoramic views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Balkan Mountains
additional: Start and finish on the ski slope in front of Hotel Rila. Race-pack collection takes place the evening before the race and on race morning. Awards are presented after each distance. Participants can also enter the team race or the duathlon with cycling the following day. The course is 38 km long with 2,200 m of elevation gain, including a climb to Musala Peak and sections through mountain shelters and trails. The registration deadline is August 10, and the race supports initiatives to restore vegetation.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. It is a trail running event on a varied and challenging route that combines being close to nature with the thrill of sport. The event has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all age groups, and fosters a sense of community among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth event management and participant satisfaction.
course_highlights: Trail running on a varied route close to nature
Challenging sections and varied terrain
A friendly race with a strong community atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the county running race series, with trail running and trail categories over various distances.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kătina is a mountain running race in the XLkmrun series, held in the area around the village of Kătina, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths, suitable for different fitness levels. The routes follow natural trails and cart roads, offering a challenge amid beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: Mountain running in the area around the village of Kătina
Three distances: 4.8 km, 9.6 km and 14.4 km
Routes on natural trails and cart roads
additional: The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities. Each event offers a choice of several distances. Results and photos from previous editions are available on the website. No specific information is available about start times, fees or participant caps. The event includes three distances and takes place in August 2026.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The course starts and finishes at the modern Krepost Stadium and passes the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The race offers two main distances: 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and teenagers. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with the region’s cultural and historical landmarks.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Krepost Stadium
The course passes the Roman fortress wall
The course runs through two beautiful parks in Hisarya
additional: Both professional athletes and children and teenagers take part in the race. Lectures and an athletics academy for children are also included. The event is part of the larger RUN BULGARIA initiative. The next race is scheduled for August 16, 2026. As part of the RUN BULGARIA series, it offers prizes for the winners and participation opportunities for all ages.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique running experience on specially prepared outdoor trails surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running as a community.
course_highlights: Night course in Dumbrava Sibiului, outdoors
Running on natural terrain with forest scenery
Event with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu
additional: Marked and illuminated course, races for children, prizes and medals for participants

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
location: Muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului, Sibiu, Romania
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is the most beautiful night cross-country race in Romania, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked courses after dark. Adult races are available over 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children’s races over 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age categories from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the open category winners in the 9 km race.
course_highlights: Fully marked night course at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum
Adult race distances: 4.5 km and 9 km; children’s distances: 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,300 m
The races start after dusk, with the children’s races beginning at 20:00
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited: 150 in the children’s races, 300 in the 4.5 km race and 300 in the 9 km race. Race kits are handed out after signing a declaration of personal responsibility, which will be sent by email and must be brought signed when collecting the kit. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place across the 22 men’s and women’s categories. The event includes outdoor trail races and prizes for the top performers, and takes place at locations such as the Open-Air Museum, the Zoo and Astra Museum. Registration is online, and the event promises an experience full of energy and fun.

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
location: Planinarski dom u Rastištu, Tara, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the mountain lodge in Rastište. The event features three different technically demanding and physically challenging courses designed for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.
course_highlights: Technically demanding and physically challenging courses in Tara National Park
Three races of different distances and elevation gains: 46 km with 3300D+, 24 km with 1700D+, and 10 km with 700D+
Start and finish at the mountain lodge in Rastište
additional: Registration opens on February 1, 2026. The courses are certified to ISF, ITRA, and UTMB standards. The race counts as the 5th round of the PSS National Mountain Running Series. Sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish area. The competition includes three races of different distances and difficulty levels, focusing on technically demanding and physically challenging terrain. In addition to the races, sports and recreational activities for all ages will be organized in the start/finish area.

description: Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, taking place on August 22–23, 2026, in the rear park of Festetics Palace. Participants can choose from several distances, from 3 km to the half marathon, and compete individually or in a relay. There are also children’s races for the youngest runners, with different distances for each age group. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and its lakeside setting offers runners a special experience.
course_highlights: Held on the shores of Lake Balaton, in the rear park of Festetics Palace
Distances from 3 km to the half marathon, with individual and relay events
Children’s races by age group in a family-friendly program
additional: The race office is on site by Lake Balaton, at the pier, where runners can collect their race numbers and register on the day. A separate registration desk is available for the children’s races. Runners are advised to arrive early because of traffic restrictions and parking difficulties. The children’s races cover different distances by age group, and the youngest participants may run accompanied by a parent. The awards ceremony takes place after the races. Multiple distances, children’s and adult races, relay races, on-site registration, parking and traffic restrictions, start times subject to weather

name: 2X2 Race
price_range: 500,00 lei (X1 Race), 250,00 lei (X2 Race), 350,00 lei (2X2 Race)
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course with 4,200 m of positive elevation gain passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m D+) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m D+), are also highly technical and intense, intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.
course_highlights: Entire course above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains
Passes over Moldoveanu (2,544 m) and Negoiu (2,535 m)
Significant elevation gain: 4,200 m D+ for 2X2 Race, 2,400 m D+ for X1 Race, and 1,900 m D+ for X2 Race
additional: Race kits can be collected at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac on August 23 between 18:00 and 22:00, with collection on Saturday morning possible in exceptional circumstances. Participants must present their ID card and complete a declaration of responsibility. Race entries cannot be transferred, but the kit may be collected by another designated person. Limited number of competitors: 200 for each race. The race follows the principle of total self-sufficiency, with no aid stations provided along the course (except for the aid stations for 2X2 Race). Trail ultramarathon, registration at Cabana Salvamont Bâlea Lac, kit collection on August 23, technical high-altitude mountain terrain

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event celebrating Romania’s unique nature and heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a 39.3 km challenge with 1,292 m of elevation gain, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.
course_highlights: 39.3 km route with 1,292 m of elevation gain
Checkpoints and hydration stations with water and snacks every 5–10 km
Panoramic landscapes and passages through the villages of Ciosa and Lunca Ilvei
additional: The 2026 edition T-shirt can be purchased as an add-on during registration. The event also includes races for children, with a special 1 km race supported by volunteers and entertainers. The marathon has 5 checkpoints and hydration stations, and visiting all of them is mandatory for the race to be validated. Participants can purchase T-shirts and other merchandise. The event also includes activities for families and children, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a connection with nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of Bulgaria’s leading trail running races, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event brings together runners from around the world, who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: 50 kilometers through the heart of the Rhodope Mountains
Passes by the Wonderful Bridges and the Chimneys
The route includes Tsirikova Church and wild natural scenery
additional: The race is a benchmark for wilderness and natural beauty, combining sport and culture in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run a 6.8 km course in repeated loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-oriented experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.
course_highlights: A 6.8 km course run once every hour
Spectacular scenery in the Brebu area, Dâmbovița, Romania
A continuous format that lasts until only one runner remains in the race
additional: The race consists of 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, and continues until only one runner remains. Community is central to the event, and the organizers provide participants with support throughout. Registration is open after July 21 if places are still available; volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on 29 August 2026 on Mount Avala. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the unique atmosphere of a nighttime adventure with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks, and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with awards for the top male and female finishers in both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on Mount Avala, starting in front of the Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: Headlamps are required. The total number of participants is limited to 500. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be gifted. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. Distances of 6 km and 10 km, headlamps required, limit of 500 participants, start at 20:30, in Belgrade, race village for visitors

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci that combines running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program lasting throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and sporting challenges.
course_highlights: Running and cycling along the banks of the Danube
Orienteering and water jumping
Hiking and outdoor sports activities
additional: The event also includes film screenings, live music, and volleyball matches, creating a rich and varied program for participants and visitors. Registration is open for the Inđija Trejl 08 trail race, which is part of the Dunavske Čarolije event series, with the possibility of early registration discounts.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1-3, Telki, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Budai Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night on the scenic forest trails of the Buda Hills. Participants run with headlamps, enjoying a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two challenging distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly, intimate atmosphere, and the start is in Telki, at the Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Night trail running on the forest trails of the Buda Hills
Headlamp running across varied terrain
Marked route with significant elevation gain (490 m+ and 527 m+)
additional: Start times: 19:30 for the 17.3 km distance and 20:00 for the 13.5 km distance. Race-pack pickup: 18:00–19:15 (M distance), 18:00–19:45 (S distance). Cutoff times: 23:00 (S distance), 23:30 (M distance). Registration is online only; on-site registration is not available. The participant limit is 600 across the two distances. The race takes place outdoors in the dark, with headlamps, offering participants a unique experience.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race held in Szombathely’s main square, offering children and amateur runners alike the opportunity to take part. The sunset and the atmosphere of the city centre give the race its special character, making for a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all age groups while also providing a shared community experience.
course_highlights: Run in Szombathely’s main square
Evening atmosphere after sunset
Distances suitable for children and amateurs
additional: The race is special because it is an evening and night run, something that has not previously been held in Szombathely. The organisers also share training tips for the 6 km distance, highlighting the importance of gradual progress and training 3–4 times a week to complete it successfully. Night running race, venue: Fő tér, Szombathely; starts at 17:00 and 19:00.

description: SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and helps fund the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletic Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible in 6 hours on a flat, accessible 3.5 km loop. The race starts at midnight, and participants are guaranteed to see the sunrise. You can enter individually or in teams of 2–10, with unlimited relay changes allowed. The Éj Félmaraton (Midnight Half Marathon) also starts at midnight and takes place on the SUHANJ! 6 course; it is limited to 200 participants.
course_highlights: A 3.5 km-long, completely flat, accessible loop
2,500 metres of paved path along Margaret Island’s central road
A 400-metre synthetic track loop at the Margaret Island Athletic Centre
additional: Bib pickup is available August 25–29, 08:00–20:00, at SUHANJ! Fitness (6 Tátra Street, District XIII, Budapest). Headlamps are mandatory until dawn during the race. Using your own cup or bottle at the refreshment stations is recommended. The race centre has changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage and a dedicated refreshment zone. Before the race, from 22:00 to 23:00, the SUHANJ! Handbike Grand Prix for athletes with mobility impairments takes place on the MAC track. After the race, participants can enjoy breakfast and a charity raffle. Completing the race supports the work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. Participation requires online registration; the programme also includes a course map, breakfast and a raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, loop-based running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. Runners complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, but they can also choose to run fewer laps. The entry fee is voluntary: 500 Ft per lap, which helps cover the costs of the race. Every participant receives an apple, hot tea, mulled wine and a commemorative medal. The top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, Törökbálint
The half-marathon consists of four laps, but runners may choose to run fewer
Friendly race with a voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. Apples, hot tea and mulled wine will be provided. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Participants may run fewer laps.

name: OSLEA RUN
description: Oslea Run is a mountain-running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs. Organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului, the event continues the local tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with challenging routes and impressive scenery. The event also includes a children’s race, as well as related social and cultural activities.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains
Routes through nature where two national parks meet
Four main races and a children’s race
additional: Race kits can be picked up from 16:00 to 22:00 on the day before the event and from 7:00 to 8:00 on race day. The Scorota route starts at 8:00, while the Paltina, Oslea and Șarba routes start at 9:00. All participants who finish within the time limit receive a finisher’s medal and a limited-edition cap. There are support stations along the route and at the finish, individual timing with online results, access to a wine tasting and a traditional dinner, an ambulance at the start/finish, and access to workshops and a social area with a campfire and live music. The event takes place on mountain and nature trails, with accommodation available in the Valea Iarului area and other facilities for participants.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the tradition of mountain running in the area, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes surrounded by nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits and related activities such as tastings and socializing.
course_highlights: Spectacular mountain routes in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains
Aid stations and individual timing with online rankings
Access to Retezat National Park and traditional culinary experiences
additional: Race kits can be collected between 16:00 and 22:00 on the day before the race and between 7:00 and 8:00 on race day. Starts are scheduled for 8:00 for the Scorota route and 9:00 for the Paltina, Oslea and Șarba routes. Participants receive a limited-edition cap, a finisher medal, aid stations along the route, individual timing, wine tasting, access to the campsite and a traditional dinner. Practical first-aid courses and photography exhibitions are also organized. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the men's and women's open categories, as well as in the age categories. The race is 26 km long, with approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain, and is recognized as a landmark trail-running event in Romania. Participation includes access to accommodation areas and information about the race kit.

name: Adventure Sky Run
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, offering three distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km trail course, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers impressive natural scenery and the chance to push beyond your limits.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through ancient Rila pine forests
25 km single-track course climbing toward Zeleni Preslap, with panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
The 55 km course connects the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa, climbing Musala Peak and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Race packs can be collected on August 28, 2026, from 13:00 to 20:00 at Hotel Rila, Borovets Resort, and on the morning of August 29, 2026, before the start. Separate starts: 06:00 for 55 km, 09:00 for 12 km and 25 km. Award ceremony after the race and organized transport for 55 km participants to Samokov and Borovets. Distances: 12 km, 25 km, and 55 km; registration and equipment requirements; held in Borovets and Malyovitsa; mountain running in the Rila Mountains.

name: Adventure Skyrun 2026
location: Malyovitsa Sports Center, Bansko Ski Resort, Samokov, Bulgaria
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, with three distances passing through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km route with climbs and single-track trails, and a 55 km ultramarathon connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa, with technical and rocky sections. The race offers impressive natural scenery and challenges for runners with different levels of experience. The organizers provide aid stations and transport after the finish of the longest distance.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through centuries-old Rila pine forests
25 km of single-track trails and a climb toward Malyovitsa Peak with panoramic views
55 km ultramarathon climbing Musala Peak and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Race packs are distributed on 28.08.2026 in front of Hotel Rila in Borovets resort and on 29.08.2026 in front of the Malyovitsa Central Mountain School for the shorter distances. The time limit is 14 hours for the 55 km and 9 hours for the 25 km. Participants must bring their own water container, as there are no bottles at the aid stations. Valid mountain insurance is mandatory for the 25 km and 55 km distances. After the 55 km finish, organized transport to Samokov and Borovets is available. Advance registration and payment are mandatory; equipment is required for 55 km participants; the race is intended for advanced runners; there is no race-day registration except for the children's run.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race, part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in the Western Balkan Mountains. The start is at Yordan Radichkov Square in Berkovitsa, at an elevation of 405 m, and the courses climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), with impressive views of the Danubian Plain, the Rila Mountains and the Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children’s race and a rich program for children after the race.
course_highlights: Climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), the westernmost peak in Bulgaria above 2,000 m
Views of the Danubian Plain, the Rila Mountains and the Rhodope Mountains
Three distances with substantial elevation gain, starting at 405 m above sea level
additional: Free parking at Yordan Radichkov Square, next to the Municipality building. On-site payment by bank transfer, Revolut, PayPal or ePay during registration from 6:30 to 8:00. Children’s yoga, games and cake after the race. Mountain running and mountain biking starts over different distances, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The race is part of an ultramarathon series and is intended for runners seeking a serious mountain challenge.

description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race taking place on August 29, 2026, on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower in Belgrade. The race starts at 8:30 p.m. and offers a unique nighttime experience on Mount Avala, with a race village for entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is required. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top finishers in the men’s and women’s categories at both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: A headlamp is required. The total number of participants is limited to 500. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but entries can be gifted. Changing and storage of belongings are self-service. The race pack includes a T-shirt. Use of a headlamp is mandatory. The number of participants is limited to 500.

description: The Nyakvágó Marathon is a challenging trail-running race in the Kiskunság region, near Ballószög. It offers the marathon distance, but in tougher conditions. Distances include 14 km, 22.5 km and 42 km, as well as a mountain-bike race. The course runs through natural surroundings on agricultural dirt roads, with aid stations every 4–5 kilometres. The event aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local community together. Competitors must protect the environment and follow the rules; mountain bikers are required to wear helmets.
course_highlights: Natural terrain, agricultural dirt roads and woodland sections
Aid stations every 4–5 kilometres with water, fruit and glucose tablets
Red cinder running track for the children’s races, with no elevation gain
additional: Refreshments are provided every 4–5 kilometres, including water, glucose tablets and fruit; alcoholic refreshments are available at the finish. Wearing a helmet is compulsory for mountain biking. T-shirts can be ordered until August 10 and cost 5,000 HUF. The race runs on agricultural dirt roads, and participants must observe traffic rules. Competitors must protect the environment; littering will result in disqualification. The event includes chip timing, various running and cycling races, and hikes, giving participants the opportunity to explore the natural scenery and take part in sports.

description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city race held in Ócsa, around the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event offers several distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km races that pass through the town’s landmarks. The race uses a unique chip timing system, and places are ranked by gun time. With an informal, family-friendly atmosphere, age restrictions and a limited number of places, the event welcomes runners.
course_highlights: Urban setting, with a route passing Ócsa’s landmarks
10.5 km loop, completed multiple times on the longer distances
Varied terrain: asphalt, dirt road and cellar row
additional: The race uses a unique chip timing system that records both net and gun time. Placings are determined by gun time. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee, which must be verified with a proof-of-address card. Registration is free for anyone born in 1960 or earlier. The race is part of the Ötpróba points-collection program, and participants can support the local community and promote physical activity at the event.

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain-running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic nature experience for runners of all levels. The competition includes two main races: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both follow varied, unprepared routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with the support of Păulești Town Hall and promotes respect for the natural environment and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting the rehabilitation of Romania’s wildlife.
course_highlights: 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 2.5-hour time limit
21 km half marathon with approximately 550 m of elevation gain and a 4-hour time limit
Unprepared routes marked with tape, colored spray paint, and signs, crossing wilderness areas and forest roads
additional: The routes are not closed to traffic, and participants must observe traffic rules. Each race has a time limit: 2.5 hours for the cross-country race and 4 hours for the half marathon. The organizers provide mountain-running training guides. The first 350 participants received free registration at previous editions. The start and finish are on the plateau next to the Păulești Mountain Rescue Base. Mountain routes with 350 m D+ of elevation gain for the cross-country race and 550 m D+ for the half marathon; online registration and results; event supported by Păulești Town Hall.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
location: Parcul Zăvoi, Râmnicu Vâlcea, Vâlcea County, Romania
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing connections between participants and shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.
course_highlights: Running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint courses in Zăvoi Park
An event for sociable athletes, with an emphasis on motivation and connection
A friendly atmosphere and support for nature and sustainability
additional: In-person races in Râmnicu Vâlcea on 30–31 August 2026, and a virtual race available anytime, anywhere for participants around the world.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the world’s most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their endurance and perseverance. The race is traditionally the pinnacle of multi-day ultrarunning, and world records have been set there. Competitors face a unique challenge that tests both physical and mental strength.
course_highlights: Six days of continuous running on the Balatonfüred course
Venue for world records in multiple categories
A challenging multi-day ultramarathon
additional: The event focuses on setting multi-day ultramarathon records; details of the race and the type of terrain have not been specified.

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
location: Kisfaludy tér, Sümeg, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The Sümeg Trail running race is a major sporting event in the city of Sümeg, attracting running enthusiasts for the fifth year. The race offers a challenge across four distances, which participants can complete in the city’s distinctive and beautiful surroundings. The event also features a range of sports activities and health screenings, so alongside the running, visitors can enjoy yoga classes, meditation, and other forms of exercise. Sümeg Trail is a lively community event that promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The distinctive and beautiful course in Sümeg
Four distances: sweet, gourmet, spicy, and strong challenges
Sports activities and health screenings in the courtyard of the Memorial House
additional: On race day, the program will also include morning yoga, a warm-up, health screenings, singing bowl meditation, skill games, jiu-jitsu training, and performances by local dancers. The event will also offer environmental and cultural activities, and the venue will showcase the natural beauty of the surrounding area.

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Alba County, Romania
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering races for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The varied routes feature significant elevation changes, providing a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, and is intended both for experienced runners and for those looking to make the transition to ultramarathon running. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: 69.4 km ultramarathon with +2730 m of elevation gain
23.9 km half marathon with 918 m of elevation gain
10 km Silviu Pîclișan Cross-Country Race, held in memory of Cugir runner Silviu Pîclișan
additional: Staggered starts: Ultramarathon at 07:00, Half Marathon at 09:00, Cross-Country Race at 09:30, Children’s Race at 12:00. Multiple refreshment points along the routes. Technical briefings are held before the starts. After the competition, a Gulaș Party and award ceremonies for all races are organized. Cut-off times and safety rules are communicated and enforced. The routes include trails, forests, hills, and areas with beautiful natural scenery. Mountain routes, a trail-running event, various races for different levels, promotion of outdoor exercise.

description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each featuring spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport, nature, and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.
course_highlights: Popular Race (5 km) on an accessible route through the forest and along the Milcov River
Cross-Country Race (12 km, +500 m elevation gain) with challenging climbs through the vineyards of Crama Sârba Odobești
Half Marathon (22 km, +850 m elevation gain), combining mountain running with vineyard and historic scenery
additional: Race pack pickup and participant registration take place between 07:30 and 09:30. The starts are staggered: Half Marathon at 10:15, Cross-Country Race at 10:30, and Popular Race at 10:40. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:30, and the event officially closes at 14:30. The start location is in Odobești’s recreation area, with parking available. You can travel by train to Focșani station and then take local transport or a taxi. Participation is by donation, and the event includes prizes for the fastest participants and for those who demonstrate team spirit and perseverance. Full course routes and details are available on the official website.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at beautiful Lake Vlasina near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, which are suited to different ages and levels of ability. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Every participant receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the shore of Lake Vlasina, surrounded by beautiful natural scenery
Distances for different age groups, from the Mini Kid to the Olympic triathlon
Changing rooms close to the start and finish
additional: Registration is complete only from the date the entry fee is paid. Exceptions allowing payment when collecting the race pack must be approved in advance. International participants may pay when collecting their race pack due to difficulties making payments from abroad. A changing room is provided close to the start and finish. Participants compete at their own risk. Participation includes various competition categories, registration information, water conditions, drafting rules, and accommodation suggestions in the area.

name: 41. Wizz Air Budapest Félmaraton
location: Budapest, Pázmány P. rakpart, Budapest, Hungary
description: The 41st Wizz Air Budapest Half Marathon is Hungary’s largest half marathon and will take place in Budapest on September 6, 2026. The race follows a beautiful and varied route through some of Budapest’s most scenic areas, with more than ten thousand fellow runners taking part. The course is fast and scenic, and the atmosphere is electric, with music points and enthusiastic spectators cheering on the runners. The half marathon is an ideal distance for both beginners and experienced runners, with a unique finisher’s medal waiting at the finish line.
course_highlights: Fast course through some of Budapest’s most scenic areas
Varied, scenic route
Fun music points and enthusiastic crowds of spectators
additional: Registration is currently open only for the individual 21.1-kilometre race, but the 10 km, pairs and trio events will be available soon. Online registration is available exclusively with card payment at nevezes.futanet.hu. A BSI account registration is required to enter. The unique finisher’s medal can be collected at the finish line. Advice is available on preparing for warm weather, hydration and race preparation, and virtual participation is also an option.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
price_range: 100 lei (Early Bird), 150 lei (normal), 180 lei (Last Minute), 119 lei (tricou tehnic)
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historic treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, cash prizes, and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.
course_highlights: Course through the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, with unique historic scenery
Start and finish in Piața Cetății, the city’s central square
Accessible, dynamic course for all levels, including an Up Stairs race
additional: All participants in the 5K and 10K races are automatically entered into the prize raffle. The race kit includes a race number, timing chip, and products provided by sponsors. The technical T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on during registration for 119 lei. Kit pickup is recommended on Saturday, 6 September, but is also possible on race morning. There are 5 age categories for the 10K and 7 categories for the 5K. Cash prizes and medals are offered by the main partner, AS World Cargo. Appeals may be submitted to the designated jury members within 15 minutes after finishing. The course includes areas of the city’s historic centre, with the chance to win cash prizes and medals, as well as the option to purchase a personalised technical T-shirt.

description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A variety of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a tradition spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied trails, with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Varied mountain trails: Babeș Vertical, 3.8 km with +624 m elevation gain
A 21.6 km half marathon and an 8.8 km cross-country race in the Ciucaș Mountains
The Ridge, a 38.5 km race for experienced runners
additional: Race kits can be collected before the races. The event includes children's races (Kids Race) with separate starts. There are checkpoints and refreshment stations along the routes. The detailed start schedule is available on the website. Registration is open from April 15 to August 20, 2026, giving participants the opportunity to prepare for an unforgettable mountain experience.

name: Teteven's Peaks
price_range: от 39 EUR до 115.39 EUR в зависимост от периода на регистрация
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and hiking enthusiast amid the beautiful scenery of the Teteven Balkan. The event features several distances: a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical climb, an easy 6 km route, and a walk with a mountain guide. Participants can enjoy fresh air, picturesque views, and well-organized aid stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, and provides medals, T-shirts, and personalized race numbers with timing chips.
course_highlights: Start in front of the municipality building in Teteven, followed by a climb to Mount Petrahilya
Aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and food at key points along the route
Impressive views of the Balkan Mountains and the Teteven Balkan
additional: All participants receive a personalized race number with an RFID timing chip and can be tracked in real time. Medical teams and volunteers are present on the course and in the start/finish area. Aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, energy bars, and fruit. After the race, participants can explore the natural beauty around Teteven. Changing rooms and baggage storage are available in the start/finish area. Terrain: mountain trails. Registration includes a T-shirt, medal, insurance, an RFID chip for accurate timing, aid stations, and medical assistance.

description: The Via Pontica cross-border marathon takes place annually and offers a unique running experience through Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route beside Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai, crossing the border without stopping. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with the finish on the beach near the village of Krapets. It is organized by the Zелена стъпка (Green Step) club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The route follows unpaved and farm tracks, with sandy sections beside Lake Durankulak and toward Cosmos campsite
Crossing the state border between Bulgaria and Romania without stopping
A coastal promenade through the Romanian settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai
additional: Children run free of charge and do not cross the border into Romania. Cutoff times: 4:30 hours for 28 km and 3:00 hours for 16 km. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and picturesque terrain.

Picturesque scenery and Transylvanian cultural heritage
Historic location in the town of Râșnov, Romania

description: The dm Balaton RUN will take place in Zamárdi on September 19, 2026, offering runners the chance to run along one of the most beautiful stretches of the Balaton shoreline. The race is family-friendly and suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with several distances: 2.3 km, 5.25 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and half-marathon relay. The race pack includes a premium Mizuno T-shirt, a custom-designed finisher’s medal awaits participants at the finish, and environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshments are provided. The route runs mostly along the lakeshore, allowing participants to enjoy the atmosphere of the Balaton and the early autumn sunshine.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along the Balaton shoreline
Panoramic views of Tihany on the opposite shore
Environmentally friendly, cup-free refreshment stations along the course
additional: The race provides cup-free, environmentally friendly refreshment points, where no single-use plastic or paper cups are used. dm products will be available to runners at the refreshment stations, with several opportunities to refuel on the longer distances. Runners must bring their own soft cup or water bottle, but a soft cup can be borrowed at the race center in exchange for a deposit. The race offers various distances and categories; participants can register online, and timing and medals are provided during the race.

name: BAKONYALJA FUTÁS
location: Tárkány és Ászár, Veszprém megye, Hungary
description: The Bakonyalja Run is a traditional trail-running race held around Tárkány and Ászár. It is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports running and orienteering through several departments. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain in a natural setting while enjoying the scenic landscapes of Bakonyalja. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is open to all age groups.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around Tárkány and Ászár
Varied trail-running routes
Scenic Bakonyalja landscape
additional: Participants can enter several distances. Details are available on the registration page, and the event is held with the support of the local community.

name: DOMB42X (2.)
location: Benkó Domb, Kecskemét, Bács-Kiskun County, Hungary
description: DOMB42X is a unique running race at Kecskemét’s highest point, Benkó Hill, where participants run up and down the nearly 50-metre-high hill several times. One lap of the course is 1.0047 km, and runners complete between 3 and 42 laps, depending on the distance, making the event span from half-marathon to ultramarathon. The race is distinguished by its substantial elevation gain, which exceeds 2,000 metres over the marathon distance. The event is family-friendly: entry is free for spectators, and the recreation park offers them a variety of activities and sports facilities.
course_highlights: Repeated ascents and descents of nearly 50-metre-high Benkó Hill
One lap is 1.0047 km, with substantial elevation gain
More than 2,000 metres of elevation gain over the marathon distance
additional: A display shows the number of completed laps after each lap, so runners do not have to keep count in their heads. The event is family-friendly, with free entry for spectators. The recreation park has a playground, beach volleyball, beach football, a basketball court, hiking trails, lakes, fishing facilities, a snack bar and a restaurant. The different distances have age limits and participant caps, and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each gender category. Trail running, multiple distances, family-friendly activities, a commitment to sustainability, children’s races, elevation gain, multi-lap courses

name: Șiria Vertical Loop
description: Șiria Vertical Loop 2h is a short-duration mountain running competition for both amateur and professional runners, promoting the tourist heritage of Arad County, especially Șiria Fortress. The race follows a vertical race-style course, with a 2.5 km loop and approximately 240 m of elevation gain per loop, and lasts a total of 2 hours. Participants must complete at least one full loop to be considered finishers. The race is known for its difficulty and the mental challenge it involves. The event is part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.
course_highlights: 2.5 km loop with 240 m of elevation gain
Vertical race lasting 2 hours
Two food and hydration stations on the course
additional: Participants can also compete in teams of 3, with separate standings for men's and women's teams. Team registration is free, and teams are made up of runners who are already registered individually. On-site registration is available while places remain, with no guarantee of a race kit. The race kit includes specific items, and registration can be cancelled with a partial refund until July 15, 2025. Trail running, high difficulty, hydration stations, mountain-running experience recommended, part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and ITRA National League.

name: Gușterița Trail Run
description: Gușterița Trail Run (GTR) is a mountain running race held in Gușterița Forest in Sibiu, offering accessible and varied routes for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The routes cross a rich natural area, with dirt paths and spruce forests, offering an authentic trail-running experience close to the city. The event promotes both competition and community, bringing together mountain-running enthusiasts in a spectacular natural setting. GTR is an ideal opportunity to push your limits and enjoy nature in the company of other runners.
course_highlights: Routes in Gușterița Forest, with approximately 1,000 hectares of natural diversity
Dirt paths with no stones on the surface, ideal for speed and technique
Varied elevation gains, from 200 m to 700 m, suitable for all levels
additional: The start of all main races is in Gușterița Forest, Sibiu, at GPS coordinates 45.81281, 24.20190. The day’s schedule includes kit pickup from 08:00 to 09:30, the Heroes Race and Cross Boss starts at 10:00, Dream Team and Sprint King & Queen at 10:30, the awards ceremony at 13:00, and the Junior Joy children’s races at 14:00. Route elevations range from 500 to 600 m, with positive elevation gains between 200 m and 700 m, depending on the race. Mountain trails, online registration, equipment recommended for rough terrain; adverse weather conditions may affect the route.

description: OMU Marathon is a 41 km mountain race that climbs to Vf. Omu, the highest point in the Bucegi Mountains, at an elevation of 2,505 m. The route crosses wind-exposed plateaus, dark forests and ancient trails, finishing at Bran Castle and offering an authentic, spectacular mountain experience. The event also includes two shorter races: the 24 km SCARA Skyrace, with over 1,800 m of elevation gain, and the 11 km POARTA Cross, with +/- 420 m of elevation change. All are organised by the Transylvania 100 team. The race promises professional-level support and infrastructure, making for a memorable adventure in the classic Transylvanian landscape.
course_highlights: 41 km route with +/- 3,000 m of elevation change, climbing to Vf. Omu (2,505 m)
Varied mountain trails: exposed plateaus, ancient forests and old trails
Finish at Bran Castle, an iconic landmark and tourist attraction
additional: Registration requires presentation of an identity document. Mandatory equipment includes a race bib with chip, mountain running shoes and a charged mobile phone. For OMU Marathon and SCARA Skyrace, a headlamp, personal cup, water reservoir of at least 1 litre, backpack with waterproof protection, emergency blanket, waterproof hooded jacket, warm long-sleeved clothing and long trousers or suitable combinations are also mandatory. OMU Marathon starts at 08:00, SCARA Skyrace at 09:00 and POARTA Cross at 10:00, all from Bran Castle. Race kits can be collected on Friday and Saturday before the race. Difficult mountain route; mandatory equipment; start and finish at Bran Castle. Registration includes a T-shirt if completed by 15 July 2026.

location: Domeniul Mogoșa, Baia Sprie, Maramureș, Romania

The event offers a variety of courses, from a 4 km route open to all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km race, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The competition promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area, in a vibrant, community-focused atmosphere. It is organized by Asociația Baia Mare în Mișcare, which supports physical activity and health in the community.

21 km half marathon with demanding climbs and technical descents
Accessible and engaging 11 km Cros route, ideal for pushing your limits
additional: GPX maps of the routes are available to download. There are also races for children and families (Family Race), as well as an accessible 4 km race for everyone (Mogosa Fun Run). The event is organized by Asociația Baia Mare în Mișcare, which promotes a healthy, active lifestyle. Mountain routes, registration from March to September 2026, multiple race categories, including the fun run and family race.

description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.

Trails include windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trackways

Registration and kit pick-up available the day before and on race morning at Bran Castle and Sports Hall in Bran. Participants receive a sports T-shirt if they register by 15 July 2026; the course has mandatory equipment and specific safety rules.
