name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathons in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, and passes through the city’s most beautiful areas, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods, with the start in front of City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers 7 km and 14 km races, Nordic walking and a 3x7 km relay, allowing runners of different levels and ages to take part. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, and runners become part of the story of a big-hearted city and its generous hosts.
course_highlights: The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, with no major climbs
Three laps through the most beautiful areas of Zrenjanin, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods
Start in front of City Hall in the city center
additional: The events include a 21.1 km half marathon, a 14 km race, a 7 km fun run, 7 km Nordic walking and a 3x7 km relay. Registration is through the trka.rs portal. The organizer provides medical assistance and aid stations along the course at intervals of up to 5 km. Participants take part at their own risk, and written consent is required for underage participants. Different age categories are available, and registration is through the trka.rs portal. The race is known for its good organization and friendly atmosphere.

The event is about the experience, not competition: smiles and shared adventures matter most. Participants receive a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack, making for an unforgettable day. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a fun, community-oriented experience in the magical surroundings of City Park.
course_highlights: More than 20 special obstacles in the heart of City Park
The 7 km course features a start through a water pipe, climbing, crawling, carrying and pushing
A family-friendly community run, with smiles and a unique finisher’s medal

The race takes place on safe, traffic-free routes, and every finisher receives a finisher’s medal and a surprise finisher’s pack. The event also offers accurate timing, refreshments every 5 km, and an online photo gallery. At the end of the race, the organizers treat participants to beef stew prepared on site, ensuring a welcoming community experience after the run.

Relay options are also available, and the event aims to promote sport and a healthy lifestyle.

The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and team spirit, particularly through the relay race dedicated to company employees. The route includes the city's streets, bridges, and scenic areas; online registration; kit collection on September 19 and 20; no refunds after payment.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest teambuilding event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a running race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. Organizers Runners Club ensure a friendly, professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.

Event dedicated to corporate teams for teambuilding
Dynamic, friendly atmosphere supported by Runners Club

The event takes place on September 20, 2026, in the town of Elena and promises autumn colors, fresh air, and unforgettable experiences for all participants. Registration is mandatory for everyone over 18, while younger participants have special conditions for taking part.
course_highlights: 12 km – panoramic views, suitable for beginners
21 km – technical forest trails with impressive scenery
33 km – combines the dynamic nature of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route

Online registration, different categories by age and distance, and a scenic route in the Elena Balkan.

Three races suited to different fitness levels and ages

The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule up to September 20, 2026. The event also includes the 23 km race, with special conditions for minor participants, and is expected to take place in temperatures of 16–18°C. Rules for multiple races and details about registration and participants’ responsibilities are provided.

description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual trail running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Mureș Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes (ASCOTID). The courses include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a social and health-focused purpose.
course_highlights: Trail course in the Cornești Plateau area, the highest point in the city
Approximately 584 m of elevation gain for the half marathon and 256 m for the cross-country race
Various events: 21 km half marathon, 10 km race, 5 km race, and races for children and families
additional: Online registration is open until 14 September 2026. After this date, registration is available only on the day before or on race day, without a participation kit. The entry fee can be paid by bank card or bank transfer, and registration is validated within 3 working days after payment is confirmed. Participants may transfer their place to another competitor if they withdraw. Changing events is possible for an additional fee of 50 lei until 16 September 2026. The children’s and family events have short distances and adjusted time limits. Online registration is open until 15 September 2024, with on-site registration possible after that date; the event includes several race categories, and details about fees and registration procedures are available on the website.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charitable sporting competition held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, in the Sucevița area. The event aims to support palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of people going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately challenging races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The routes offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.
course_highlights: Routes through the forests of Bucovina, with views of the Sucevița Valley and the monastery
Steep climbs on Dealul Furcoi, continuing along the Obcina ridge
Checkpoints, hydration, and food stations along the route
additional: The event offers three races: 20 km, 9 km, and a children’s race. The routes are moderately challenging, with checkpoints and hydration stations. The time limit for the 9 km race is 2.5 hours. Participants are encouraged to run regardless of experience, and registration closes 4 days before the event. A closing ceremony is organized for all participants. Participation includes multiple race distances, online registration, and a festive closing event with music and traditional food.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
location: Alba Carolina, Alba Iulia, Alba County, Romania
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a running community. The event is a festival of running, combining a passion for sport with exploration and appreciation of local values. The organizers focus on providing a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through the Alba Carolina Citadel, a restored and iconic historic monument
Star Transmission Half Marathon (21 km) and Star Assembly Cross-Country Race (11 km)
Support stations along the route with water, energy drinks, and fruit
additional: The race kit includes a personalized race bib, a personalized technical shirt for the main races and a cotton shirt for the Family Run, electronic chip timing, hydration stations along the route, a refreshment pack at the finish, metal and wooden finisher medals, cash and equipment prizes, official photographs, a DJ at the event, surprise prize drawings, an ambulance for emergencies, and a post-race recovery workout. Multiple race distances are offered, including a half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, a 2.7 km Family Run, and a Kids Race; the event includes activities promoting health and tourist exploration of the city and the Alba Carolina Citadel.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
location: Castrul Roman Porolissum, Moigrad, Sălaj, Romania
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event taking place on September 26, 2026, in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, welcoming both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race-kit pickup available in the days before the event and on race day.
course_highlights: A spectacular course starting and finishing at the Porolissum Roman Fort
Mountain running amid historic and natural scenery
Multiple races: 23 km, 12 km, and 1.6 km for different levels of fitness
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday, September 25, from 15:00 to 20:00 at the Sports Hall of Avram Iancu Sports High School in Zalău, and on Saturday, September 26, from 07:30 to 11:30 in the start area at the Amphitheatre in the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, followed by the 12 km and 1.6 km races. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule until September 20, 2026. The event includes multiple race categories, with registration information and rules available on the official website.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: a marathon, a half marathon, and a cross-country race, set amid the picturesque landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, combining physical challenges with storybook scenery and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and refreshment stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.
course_highlights: The marathon route passes through the Plaiului Gorges Geological Reserve and Huda lui Papară Cave
The half marathon includes the steep climb up Piatra Secuiului and a section along Creasta de Cocoș
The cross-country race offers an accessible mountain experience, with peaceful scenery in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif
additional: Registration is free for people with disabilities. Places are limited: 100 for the marathon, 250 for the half marathon, and 200 for the cross-country race. Race kits are distributed in Cluj-Napoca and Rimetea in the days before the race. There are technical briefings for each event before the start. Medals are awarded only to those who finish within the time limit. Participants are automatically entered into the raffle held after the awards ceremony; attendance is required for the draw. Marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country routes, mountain and cultural scenery, event in September 2026

name: RUN FOR LIFE
location: Dumbrava Vlăsiei, Snagov, Ilfov County, Romania

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place at the end of September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and earns points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.
course_highlights: Routes cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains
Minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails
Aid stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, and Rhodope specialties
additional: The entry pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts. A medical examination before participation is mandatory. Medical assistance and mountain insurance are provided. Aid stations offer water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The course has minimal asphalt sections. Electronic timing of results. Information about accommodation, tents, and campers. Professional photography and video coverage. The race takes place at the end of September in Zlatograd and Madan, highlighting nature, history, and adventure, while supporting environmental causes.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gain; all qualify for the UTMB Index and earn points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the fairytale-like Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 13 to 100 km through the Rhodope Mountains
Total positive elevation gain of up to 4,170 m on the 100 km course
UTMB Index-qualifying race with marked and secured routes
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, gifts, and a special surprise. Medical examinations are mandatory and are conducted on site at no extra cost. Aid stations offer water, hot and refreshing drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides mountain insurance and medical assistance during the race. A medical certificate is not required; participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, transport to the start points is provided, the event supports green initiatives, and it is well organized.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive long-distance race of 10.25 km and a short 2023-meter distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining seaside scenery with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.
course_highlights: Long-distance 10.25 km course along the Black Sea beach
Short 2023-meter distance for beginners
Return on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake
additional: In the days before the race, “Children’s Athletics” activities are held to recruit new talents for the Atlet 2004 athletics club in Pomorie. The course includes running along the Black Sea beach and returning on the dirt road beside Pomorie Lake; distances are 10.25 km and 2023 m for beginners.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba na Rajcu is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk tradition.
course_highlights: Hand-mowing grass on plots measuring 20 × 6 meters
Mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire
International team competition in hand-mowing grass
additional: The competition takes place on plots measuring 20 × 6 meters, which the mowers cut in two swaths. Mowing is judged on speed and quality, and the winner receives an award. Mowers must bring their own mowing equipment and wear the required traditional attire. The program also includes an exhibition of tools, folk performances, and a concert by a brass band. Events include traditional activities, hiking tours, and trail-marking courses, with a focus on preserving and promoting the natural and cultural values of Rajac.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
location: Kis-Duna sétány, Esztergom, Komárom-Esztergom County, Hungary
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a running event with a variety of distances, held across Esztergom’s historic districts, including Castle Hill, the Watertown district, and the riverside cycle path. Individual and relay runners can choose from several distances, and shorter races are organized separately for children. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also serves as a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. The event’s patrons include the mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, adding to its prestige.
course_highlights: The course has a mixed surface, with cobblestone and asphalt sections.
The course runs through Esztergom’s Castle Hill, Watertown district, and riverside cycle path.
The relay consists of three laps, each approximately 7 km long.
additional: Children’s races are free, but registration is required. The first relay runner may also compete in the individual half marathon. The event is a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program; participants can earn points by completing the distances. The relay exchange zone is located in the start/finish area in front of the Basilica. Distances: half marathon, 14 km, 7 km, relay, children’s races; terrain: mixed surface; registration online and on-site; the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: HÍRÖS FÉLMARATON
description: The Hírös Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kecskemét, taking place on September 27, 2026, at the Benkó Center. The event offers several distances, including 0.3 km, 1 km, 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 42 km, so runners of all ages and abilities can find a suitable option. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide a shared community sports experience. Participants receive a custom finisher medal, and qualified first-aid providers are on hand during the race. Race bibs can be collected on race day and beforehand.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.3 km to 42 km, with individual and relay events
Time limits: 2 hours 45 minutes for 21 km and 5 hours 45 minutes for 42 km
Start times: the marathon at 9:00 and the 300 m race at 10:45
additional: Race bib pickup is available on race day and beforehand, on September 27 from 15:00 to 17:00. The entry fee includes participation in the course finish event and a pre-race pasta party. Race bibs must be worn visibly and may not be exchanged. Qualified first-aid providers will be on standby during the race. Participants can collect their race pack, attend the pasta party, receive finisher medals, and visit local attractions.

The experience continues after the finish, with awards and a large event tent where spectators can comfortably cheer on the runners.

description: Crosul Arenelor is a unique running event in Bucharest, taking place on a 10-kilometer course between two iconic arenas: Stadionul Național Arcul de Triumf and Arena Națională. The race runs in one direction, with no turns, along some of the capital’s most beautiful streets, offering a fast and smooth experience. The event also includes a 2 km Family Run and a wheelchair race, and is open to all running enthusiasts. The organizers focus on creating an energizing atmosphere, with cheering points along the course and a complete race kit for runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km course measured and certified by World Athletics
Start at Stadionul Național Arcul de Triumf and finish at Arena Națională
Refreshment and hydration points at km 1.8, 5 and 7.5
additional: Race kits can be collected at Running Expo, Arena Națională, VIP terrace, on Friday 19 September from 16:00 to 20:00, Saturday 20 September from 10:00 to 20:00, and on Sunday 21 September in the morning for participants from outside Bucharest/Ilfov. The complete kit includes a technical T-shirt, products and services from partners, a finisher medal, and the opportunity to be included in the rankings and prize awards. The course has refreshment and hydration points at km 1.8, 5 and 7.5, offering water, isotonic drinks, fruit and glucose. The minimum age for participation is 14; minors must be accompanied by an adult. The event includes social causes, volunteering opportunities, and distribution of the race kit at the finish. The course is prepared with participants’ safety and comfort in mind.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation and taking place on September 27, 2026. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition; it is a call to action for exercise and community involvement.
course_highlights: Course starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium
Passes through Crâng Park and along the city’s main boulevards and streets
A vibrant event in the heart of Buzău
additional: The Sport Expo for race-kit collection takes place on Saturday, September 26, from 10:00 to 20:00. There is a time limit for completing the first lap of the 21k race, with a cutoff time of 10:30. The awards ceremony takes place from 14:00 to 15:00 on race day. The event includes children’s races and activities promoting health and community involvement.

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The international road race “Run of the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.
course_highlights: International route between Ruse and Giurgiu
Road course with scenic views
Race promoting friendship between Bulgaria and Romania

It offers distances for several age groups, from preschoolers to adults, on paved roads and short dirt sections. The quarter-marathon features chip timing, refreshment points, and medals. All distances are free. The event aims to promote community sport and running, and is held in memory of István Maróti.
course_highlights: A mostly paved route with short dirt sections

Refreshment points and chip timing on the quarter-marathon distance
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 13:00 and closes 15 minutes before each race starts. Quarter-marathon finishers receive a finisher’s package and a medal. The top three finishers in each age group and gender category receive medals. Bibs must be worn visibly on the front. Each participant may enter only one distance. Medical supervision is provided. The event offers several distances on paved and dirt roads, with online and on-site registration. The organizers provide medical supervision and refreshment points.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
location: Club Tihany, Tihany, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a range of distances for everyone from beginners to experienced runners. The race stands out for the beautiful panoramas of the Balaton Uplands and its challenging, varied terrain, which takes in some of the peninsula’s most scenic areas. Many runners choose the half marathon as their first, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a Baby Run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments and a running T-shirt.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route takes in some of Tihany’s most scenic stretches and varied panoramas, including the shore of Lake Balaton and the northern tip of the peninsula.
The 12 km route is the “Tihany Loop,” offering a challenge with elevation changes and varied terrain.
The 3 km and 5 km routes are easy-to-complete paved courses, ideal for beginners and those returning to running.
additional: All distances include a finisher’s medal and a running T-shirt. The 3K starts at 11:00, and the 5K, 12K and 21K start at 12:00; the 21K has a wave start. The 400-metre Baby Run takes place at the race centre, with refreshments at the finish. Age-group awards are presented, and participants under 18 need a parental consent form. Field sizes are limited to 1,500 participants, except for the Baby Run. The race follows paved roads on the Tihany Peninsula, with varied elevation and panoramic views. Distances: 400 m, 3 km, 5 km, 12 km and 21 km. The race takes place on October 3, 2026, at Club Tihany.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance and strategy race, where each 6.7 km lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour. Participants start running at the top of every hour, and those who fail to finish in time or withdraw are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, testing competitors’ physical and mental limits. The event is part of Zalău Ultra Trail, a platform that brings sport, community, and nature together.
course_highlights: Set course of 6.7 km per lap
Each lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour
Immediate elimination for finishing late or withdrawing
additional: The race is run in hourly laps, with each lap starting at the next fixed hour after the previous one ends. It is a test of mental and physical endurance, where the opponent is time, the course, and your own mind. The event includes distances such as 12.5 km, 24 km, 44 km, and 103 km, promoting solidarity and respect for nature.

description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain-running race in Bucovina, held in the town of Vatra Dornei. The event offers two moderately difficult races, 12 km and 22 km, on routes consisting mainly of mountain trails, with sections through forests and open meadows. The start and finish are at the base of the Veverița ski slope, and the route reaches Vârful Diecilor at an elevation of 1,301 meters. Participants must be prepared for nighttime mountain running and bring suitable equipment, including a headlamp and mobile phone.
course_highlights: Moderately difficult route with 95–100% mountain trail
80% forest and 20% open meadows on both races
The route reaches Vârful Diecilor, elevation 1,301 m
additional: Participants must carry a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and a headlamp with spare batteries. Equipment for adverse weather conditions is required, such as a long-sleeved shirt or waterproof shell. There are hydration points and two feeding points, at the start and at Vârful Diecilor. Medical assistance is provided by mountain rescuers; no ambulance is stationed at the start/finish. The entry fee is non-refundable in the event of withdrawal. Registration is valid once payment has been confirmed. Minors must provide a statement from a parent or guardian. Mountain, nighttime, hydration and feeding points, mountain rescue assistance, strict participation rules.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a community sports event that promotes a healthy lifestyle through running and is open to all ages and fitness levels. The event takes place in Vladimirescu, Arad, and includes races for children, families, and recreational or experienced runners. Each edition supports social causes, turning running into an act of solidarity and support for the community. Participants enjoy a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with courses suited to all ages and performance levels.

An event for all ages, from 6-year-olds to adults and families
Location in Vladimirescu, Arad, with an active community and support for social causes

Friendly atmosphere and support from the local running community

description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain skyrunning race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the town of Karlovo. The race offers challenging courses with impressive natural views and varied terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. Following its successful hosting of the 2025 Masters Skyrunning World Championships, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose from several distances with varying lengths and elevation gain, offering a unique experience amid the wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses in Central Balkan National Park, with its extensive network of hiking trails
Distances with significant elevation gain: Vertical Kilometer (3.8 km / 830 m D+), 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
Scenic views and challenging terrain, including mountain peaks and the Balkan Range ridge
additional: From 05.01.26 to 31.01.26 inclusive, there is a 10% discount on registration with promo code "BALKANIADA10". The event has several start times for the different distances on 4 October 2026 in the town of Karlovo. Registration is through the Tracksport.live system. Distances: 3.8 km / 830 m D+, 12 km / 595 D+, 27 km / 1600 D+, 44 km / 2570 D+; registration with promo code; mountain event; various initiatives

description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional event held in Varna’s Sea Garden, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The race includes various distances suitable for men, women and young athletes, offering athletes from different age groups and clubs the opportunity to compete. The event is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Course in Varna’s Sea Garden
Various distances for men, women and young athletes
Participation by leading Bulgarian runners and clubs
additional: Held in the Sea Garden; various distances for men, women, junior men and junior women; results for different age groups

name: Brașov Running Festival
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an energetic atmosphere filled with music and fun. The festival features a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and children’s races to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of the Tractorul district in Brașov and offers a complete experience, with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.
course_highlights: tRUNsylvania 10K — the flagship race, certified with a World Athletics Elite Label
A variety of races: 5K Open, Wheelchair Race 5K, Kids Races, Fun Race 3K, Trail to Road
Cheering zones with live performances along the course
additional: Spectators can attend free of charge throughout the event. The tRUNsylvania 10K is broadcast live on national TV channels and online. All participants receive the official race shirt provided by technical sponsor Joma. A cloakroom is available for personal belongings, but bulky items are not accepted. Race bibs are personal and must be worn throughout the race. Includes an earlier 5 km race during the day, with courses of approximately 3.5 km in the Tractorul district of Brașov.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
location: Bd. V. Pârvan 4, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running event held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to the full marathon of 42 km. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.
course_highlights: A full 42 km marathon course for experienced runners
A 21 km half marathon for those ready to take on half the challenge
Fun runs and children’s races, with distances from 200 m to 1 km
additional: The event includes races for all ages and experience levels, with age categories from 4 years old through adulthood. Facilities include checkpoints, medical staff, and portable toilets. Training programs are available for the 5, 10.5, 21, and 42 km distances, created by an experienced university coach. The maximum time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 3 hours for the half marathon. Participants can choose from several distances, including the marathon, half marathon, relay, and children’s races; the event promotes freedom and health in the community; registration and race details are available on the official website.

name: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv
description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv is a corporate relay race and team-building event held at the LIEBHERR plant in Plovdiv. The race features teams of 4, with each participant running 4 km by completing two laps of the flat 2 km course. It is the largest corporate running event in southern Bulgaria, combining sport, fun and charity. The event has been held in Plovdiv since 2017 and attracts companies from across the country.
course_highlights: Flat course around the LIEBHERR plant
2 km lap, completed twice by each participant
Relay race with teams of 4
additional: Each company can add laser engraving to the medals for an additional fee. A branded marquee can be set up in the relay handover area. Participants receive race packs with gifts and a medal. The event supports a charitable cause, with donations made directly to the beneficiary. Corporate relay race, team building, online registration, charitable initiatives, prizes and certificates for companies.

description: Neofit Rilski Marathon and Cycling 2026 offers a unique adventure, with courses passing through beautiful Bulgarian countryside from the village of Neofit Rilski to Ovech Fortress. The races include running and cycling over various distances, starting and finishing at Historical Park. Participants will face challenges with varying elevation gain and cut-off times, suitable for different levels of fitness. A children’s run with treats is planned for kids. The event is suitable for sports and nature lovers looking for a serious challenge and adventure.
course_highlights: Courses with total elevation gain and loss of up to 870 meters
Start and finish at Historical Park
A variety of running and cycling distances: 42 km, 25 km, 13 km, and a children’s run
additional: A 700 m children’s run with treats for all children. Cut-off times for the different distances range from 2 to 7 hours. Mandatory equipment and participation declarations are required. All finishers receive a unique medal. Online registration, checkpoints, GPX tracks, medical support, and aid stations along the course. The start is at 9:00, the awards ceremony begins at 14:30, and the event closes at 17:00.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The 41st SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a running event held over an entire weekend, taking place on October 11 in Budapest. Participants can enter races ranging from 5 to 42.195 km, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The event aims to offer runners an unforgettable experience, from beginners to experienced marathoners. With the support of its chief patrons and patrons, the marathon is a true bucket-list challenge that takes runners past Budapest’s iconic landmarks.
course_highlights: A variety of distances, from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km)
A route passing Budapest’s iconic landmarks
A weekend-long running festival with events and activities
additional: The event features races over several distances on Saturday and Sunday, including pairs, relay, 30 km, 14 km, 10 km, minimarathon, relay and school relay events. The registration office provides contact details and several registration options (guest registration, school registration and corporate registration). The event’s chief patrons are the Mayor of Budapest and the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Runners can enjoy activities, prize draws and health advice throughout the weekend. Registration is open for distances from 5 to 42.195 km; registration has opened only for the individual marathon, with registration for the other events opening soon.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a two-day running event taking place in Budapest on October 10–11, 2026. Participants can run past Budapest’s most beautiful World Heritage sites while enjoying the city’s panoramas and enthusiastic crowds. The festival celebrates running, with distances to suit everyone, from 5 km to the marathon. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal and race T-shirt, while a range of accompanying activities and musical experiences will make the weekend unforgettable.
course_highlights: A route passing World Heritage sites
Some of Budapest’s most beautiful panoramas and districts
Numerous bands and cheering spectators create an electrifying atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from 18 different distances, from 5 km to the marathon, and can also enter in pairs or as part of a relay. The event features a range of accompanying activities, musical experiences, and enthusiastic spectators. Finishers receive a unique medal and race T-shirt. Contact details for the race office and the option to amend entries are also available. Distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay, walking, family run, city tour, equal-opportunity run; schedule, start list, results, online registration, team and school registration, awards

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event held in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, organized by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The competition includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) races on mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains and connecting the area’s 39 hamlets. It is one of the region’s first mountain marathons, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid spectacular natural scenery. The event is for runners passionate about mountain terrain and adventure.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connects 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) distances
additional: The routes pass through scenic areas and may include varied mountain terrain; registration details are not specified

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: The Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for runners of all levels. The courses include the full marathon of 42 km, the half marathon of 21 km, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting in Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course passing important landmarks of the capital, with hydration and support points along the way.
course_highlights: Urban course through Bucharest’s iconic landmarks
A variety of races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, popular race, and 4x relay
Start and finish in Constitution Square
additional: Race kits are collected before the race at the designated location. The event includes hydration points and medical support along the course. Pacemakers are available for the main races. After the race, participants receive prizes and medals. The organizers support charitable causes through the registration of partner NGOs. The event includes charitable partnerships, exhibitions, and prizes for winners, with details about registration and kit collection available on the official website.
